    "content":"-- Synchronous FSM executor for the SoraMech runner.\n-- Walks the graph from the entry box, invokes language drivers for each\n-- box in dependency order, and threads output values through wires.\n-- Each box call is isolated in run_task() — the future thread pool swap point.\n\nlocal DIR = \"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech\"\n\npackage.path = DIR .. \"/libs/?.lua;\" ..\n               DIR .. \"/src/?.lua;\" ..\n               package.path\n\nlocal json = require(\"dkjson\")\nlocal M    = {}\n\n-- {{{ eval_predicate\nlocal function eval_predicate(pred, value)\n    -- structured predicates only; no arbitrary lua eval\n    local op  = pred.op\n    local lit = pred.value\n\n    if op == \"eq\"       then return value == lit\n    elseif op == \"lt\"   then return value <  lit\n    elseif op == \"gt\"   then return value >  lit\n    elseif op == \"lte\"  then return value <= lit\n    elseif op == \"gte\"  then return value >= lit\n    elseif op == \"contains\" then\n        return type(value) == \"string\" and value:find(lit, 1, true) ~= nil\n    elseif op == \"matches\" then\n        return type(value) == \"string\" and value:match(lit) ~= nil\n    end\n    return false\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ shell_quote\nlocal function shell_quote(s)\n    -- wrap a string in single quotes, escaping any embedded single quotes\n    return \"'\" .. tostring(s):gsub(\"'\", \"'\\\\''\") .. \"'\"\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ driver_path_for\nlocal function driver_path_for(ref, drivers)\n    -- binary callers (no extension mapping needed — they are executable directly)\n    -- source callers: look up extension in driver table\n    local ext = ref:match(\"%.([^./]+)$\")\n    if not ext then return ref end  -- no extension: treat as binary\n    local driver = drivers[\".\" .. ext]\n    return driver\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ run_task\n-- The task boundary. In v1: synchronous. Future: hand this signature to\n-- the thread pool. Returns outputs table and ok/err.\nlocal function run_task(box, inputs, drivers, map_dir)\n    local ref = box.ref\n    local fn  = box.fn\n\n    -- locate the driver for this ref\n    local driver = driver_path_for(ref, drivers)\n    if not driver then\n        return nil, \"no driver found for ref '\" .. ref .. \"'\"\n    end\n\n    -- resolve ref relative to map_dir\n    local abs_ref = map_dir .. \"/\" .. ref\n\n    -- build argument list: file fn arg_count [args...]\n    local args = {}\n    for _, port in ipairs(box.inputs or {}) do\n        local val = inputs[port.name]\n        if val == nil then\n            -- nil input becomes JSON null\n            args[#args + 1] = shell_quote(json.encode(nil))\n        else\n            args[#args + 1] = shell_quote(json.encode(val))\n        end\n    end\n\n    local cmd\n    if fn then\n        -- source caller: driver file fn arg_count [args...]\n        cmd = driver .. \" \" .. shell_quote(abs_ref) .. \" \" ..\n              shell_quote(fn) .. \" \" .. #args\n        for _, a in ipairs(args) do cmd = cmd .. \" \" .. a end\n    else\n        -- binary caller: run ref directly with args\n        cmd = abs_ref .. \" \" .. #args\n        for _, a in ipairs(args) do cmd = cmd .. \" \" .. a end\n    end\n\n    -- invoke driver; capture stdout; errors go to stderr (visible in terminal)\n    local handle = io.popen(cmd .. \" 2>&1_STDERR_REDIR_NOT_SUPPORTED\", \"r\")\n    -- io.popen doesn't support stderr separation in standard lua; run via sh -c\n    -- and capture both, then split on a sentinel\n    handle:close()\n\n    -- run properly: use sh -c with stderr redirected to a tmp file\n    local tmpfile = map_dir .. \"/tmp/driver-stderr-\" .. box.id .. \".txt\"\n    local full_cmd = \"sh -c \" .. shell_quote(cmd .. \" 2>\" .. tmpfile)\n    local ph = io.popen(full_cmd, \"r\")\n    local stdout = ph:read(\"*a\")\n    local ok_close = ph:close()\n\n    -- read stderr if any\n    local sf = io.open(tmpfile, \"r\")\n    local stderr_text = sf and sf:read(\"*a\") or \"\"\n    if sf then sf:close() end\n    os.remove(tmpfile)\n\n    if not ok_close then\n        local err_msg = \"driver failed for box '\" .. box.id .. \"'\"\n        if stderr_text and #stderr_text > 0 then\n            err_msg = err_msg .. \": \" .. stderr_text:gsub(\"%s+$\", \"\")\n        end\n        return nil, err_msg\n    end\n\n    -- parse output JSON array from stdout\n    local result_arr, _, jerr = json.decode(stdout)\n    if not result_arr then\n        return nil, \"box '\" .. box.id .. \"': driver stdout is not valid JSON: \" ..\n            tostring(jerr) .. \" (got: \" .. tostring(stdout):sub(1, 80) .. \")\"\n    end\n    if type(result_arr) ~= \"table\" then\n        return nil, \"box '\" .. box.id .. \"': driver output must be a JSON array\"\n    end\n\n    -- map positional results to named output ports\n    local outputs = {}\n    for i, port in ipairs(box.outputs or {}) do\n        local raw = result_arr[i]\n        if raw ~= nil then\n            -- each element in the outer array is itself a JSON-encoded value\n            local val, _, aerr = json.decode(raw)\n            outputs[port.name] = aerr and raw or val\n        end\n    end\n\n    return outputs, nil\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ inputs_satisfied\nlocal function inputs_satisfied(box, store)\n    -- a box is ready when all its declared input ports have a value in the store\n    for _, port in ipairs(box.inputs or {}) do\n        if store[box.id .. \".\" .. port.name] == nil then\n            return false\n        end\n    end\n    return true\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ collect_inputs\nlocal function collect_inputs(box, store)\n    local inputs = {}\n    for _, port in ipairs(box.inputs or {}) do\n        inputs[port.name] = store[box.id .. \".\" .. port.name]\n    end\n    return inputs\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ fire_connections\nlocal function fire_connections(box, outputs, store, queue, boxes, retry_counts)\n    -- for branch boxes: evaluate predicates and fire the first matching port\n    -- for call boxes: push all wired output values directly\n    if box.kind == \"branch\" then\n        local input_val = outputs[\"_branch_input\"]\n        local fired = false\n        for _, port in ipairs(box.ports or {}) do\n            if port.name == \"else\" then goto next_port end\n            if port.predicate and eval_predicate(port.predicate, input_val) then\n                -- find and fire connections from this port\n                for _, c in ipairs(box.connections or {}) do\n                    if c.from_box == box.id and c.from_port == port.name then\n                        store[c.to_box .. \".\" .. c.to_input] = input_val\n                        queue[#queue + 1] = c.to_box\n                    end\n                end\n                fired = true\n                break\n            end\n            ::next_port::\n        end\n\n        if not fired then\n            -- fire \"else\" port\n            for _, c in ipairs(box.connections or {}) do\n                if c.from_box == box.id and c.from_port == \"else\" then\n                    store[c.to_box .. \".\" .. c.to_input] = input_val\n                    queue[#queue + 1] = c.to_box\n                    fired = true\n                end\n            end\n\n            if not fired then\n                -- unwired else: return signal to re-queue the upstream box\n                return \"retry\"\n            end\n        end\n\n    else\n        -- call box: push each output value to connected input ports\n        for _, c in ipairs(box.connections or {}) do\n            if c.from_box ~= box.id then goto next_conn end\n            local val = outputs[c.from_output]\n            store[c.to_box .. \".\" .. c.to_input] = val\n            -- enqueue target if all its inputs are now satisfied\n            local target = boxes[c.to_box]\n            if target and inputs_satisfied(target, store) then\n                queue[#queue + 1] = c.to_box\n            end\n            ::next_conn::\n        end\n    end\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ write_last_run\nlocal function write_last_run(map_dir, run_state)\n    local tmp_dir = map_dir .. \"/tmp\"\n    local path    = tmp_dir .. \"/last-run.json\"\n    local f, ferr = io.open(path, \"w\")\n    if not f then\n        io.stderr:write(\"executor: cannot write last-run.json: \" .. tostring(ferr) .. \"\\n\")\n        return\n    end\n    f:write(json.encode(run_state, { indent = true }))\n    f:close()\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ execute\nfunction M.execute(graph, map_dir)\n    local boxes    = graph.boxes\n    local drivers  = graph.drivers\n    local entry_id = graph.entry\n\n    -- store: keyed by \"box_id.port_name\" -> value\n    local store = {}\n\n    -- per-box retry counters (for branch box else-retry)\n    local retry_counts = {}\n\n    -- seed entry box: if it has inputs, they must come from data files;\n    -- for v1, entry boxes with inputs are the user's responsibility to pre-seed\n    -- via a data box or by starting with a box that has no inputs\n    local entry_box = boxes[entry_id]\n    if entry_box and #(entry_box.inputs or {}) == 0 then\n        -- no inputs needed; ready immediately\n    end\n\n    local queue   = { entry_id }\n    local visited = {}  -- boxes that have been run (prevent double-execution)\n    local run_log = {}  -- per-box execution records for last-run.json\n    local map_ok  = true\n    local map_err = nil\n\n    while #queue > 0 do\n        -- dequeue\n        local id = table.remove(queue, 1)\n\n        local box = boxes[id]\n        if not box then\n            map_ok  = false\n            map_err = \"unknown box in queue: '\" .. id .. \"'\"\n            break\n        end\n\n        -- skip boxes whose inputs are not yet satisfied (they'll be re-enqueued)\n        if not inputs_satisfied(box, store) then\n            goto next_iter\n        end\n\n        if visited[id] and box.kind ~= \"branch\" then\n            goto next_iter\n        end\n        visited[id] = true\n\n        local inputs = collect_inputs(box, store)\n\n        -- branch box is handled specially: it doesn't invoke a driver,\n        -- it routes based on its single input value\n        local outputs, task_err\n        if box.kind == \"branch\" then\n            -- the branch input is the value wired to its single input port\n            local branch_val = inputs[(box.inputs or {})[1] and box.inputs[1].name or \"value\"]\n            outputs = { _branch_input = branch_val }\n            task_err = nil\n        else\n            outputs, task_err = run_task(box, inputs, drivers, map_dir)\n        end\n\n        run_log[id] = {\n            inputs  = inputs,\n            outputs = outputs or {},\n            status  = task_err and \"error\" or \"ok\",\n            error   = task_err,\n        }\n\n        if task_err then\n            map_ok  = false\n            map_err = task_err\n            io.stderr:write(\"executor: \" .. task_err .. \"\\n\")\n            break\n        end\n\n        -- fire connections and enqueue newly-ready boxes\n        local signal = fire_connections(box, outputs, store, queue, boxes, retry_counts)\n        if signal == \"retry\" then\n            -- unwired else: find the immediate upstream box and re-queue it\n            -- retry_vary is applied in run_task on the next invocation\n            local max_retries = box.retry_limit or 3\n            retry_counts[id] = (retry_counts[id] or 0) + 1\n            if retry_counts[id] > max_retries then\n                map_ok  = false\n                map_err = \"branch box '\" .. id .. \"' exceeded retry limit (\" ..\n                    max_retries .. \")\"\n                break\n            end\n            -- find the box that wired into this branch box and re-queue it\n            for src_id, src_box in pairs(boxes) do\n                for _, c in ipairs(src_box.connections or {}) do\n                    if c.from_box == src_id and c.to_box == id then\n                        visited[src_id] = nil\n                        queue[#queue + 1] = src_id\n                    end\n                end\n            end\n        end\n\n        ::next_iter::\n    end\n\n    -- write last-run snapshot to tmp/\n    write_last_run(map_dir, {\n        ok     = map_ok,\n        error  = map_err,\n        boxes  = run_log,\n    })\n\n    return map_ok, map_err\nend\n-- }}}\n\nreturn M\n",

          "content":"-- SoraMech runner — entry point for FSM execution.\n-- Loads a map directory, validates the graph, then executes it synchronously.\n-- Run: luajit soramech-runner.lua <map-dir>\n-- Output goes to map-dir/tmp/last-run.json; logs to map-dir/tmp/logs/.\n\nlocal DIR = \"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech\"\n\npackage.path = DIR .. \"/libs/?.lua;\" ..\n               DIR .. \"/src/?.lua;\" ..\n               package.path\n\nlocal loader   = require(\"003-loader\")\nlocal executor = require(\"004-executor\")\n\n-- {{{ main\nlocal function main(args)\n    local map_dir = args[1]\n    if not map_dir then\n        io.stderr:write(\"usage: luajit soramech-runner.lua <map-dir>\\n\")\n        os.exit(1)\n    end\n\n    -- ensure tmp/logs/ exists (tmp/ is the /tmp/<name>/ symlink from create-map.sh)\n    os.execute(\"mkdir -p \" .. map_dir .. \"/tmp/logs\")\n\n    local graph, load_errs = loader.load_map(map_dir)\n    if not graph then\n        io.stderr:write(\"runner: load failed:\\n\")\n        for _, e in ipairs(load_errs) do\n            io.stderr:write(\"  \" .. e .. \"\\n\")\n        end\n        os.exit(1)\n    end\n\n    local ok, val_errs = loader.validate_graph(graph)\n    if not ok then\n        io.stderr:write(\"runner: validation failed:\\n\")\n        for _, e in ipairs(val_errs) do\n            io.stderr:write(\"  \" .. e .. \"\\n\")\n        end\n        os.exit(1)\n    end\n\n    local run_ok, run_err = executor.execute(graph, map_dir)\n    if not run_ok then\n        io.stderr:write(\"runner: execution failed: \" .. tostring(run_err) .. \"\\n\")\n        os.exit(1)\n    end\n\n    print(\"runner: OK — \" .. map_dir .. \"/tmp/last-run.json written\")\n    os.exit(0)\nend\n-- }}}\n\nmain(arg)\n",
          "file_path":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/soramech-runner.lua"

          "new_string":"-- Hello function for the hello example map.\n-- Reads the name from data/state.json and returns a greeting string.\n-- No inputs: name comes from the map's data file at runtime.\n\nlocal json = require(\"dkjson\")\nlocal M    = {}\n\n-- {{{ read_name\nlocal function read_name(map_dir)\n    -- walk up from this file's location to find the map root's data/state.json\n    local state_path = map_dir .. \"/data/state.json\"\n    local f = io.open(state_path, \"r\")\n    if not f then return \"world\" end\n    local raw  = f:read(\"*a\")\n    f:close()\n    local obj, _, _ = json.decode(raw)\n    if not obj then return \"world\" end\n    local name_field = obj.fields and obj.fields.name\n    if not name_field then return \"world\" end\n    return name_field.value or \"world\"\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ hello\nfunction M.hello(map_dir)\n    local name = read_name(map_dir)\n    return \"Hello, \" .. tostring(name) .. \"!\"\nend\n-- }}}",

          "file_path":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/maps/hello/src/hello.lua"

then\n    echo \"lua.sh: missing file-path or fn-name\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n\nif ! command -v luajit > /dev/null 2>&1; then\n    echo \"lua.sh: luajit not found on PATH\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n\nif [ ! -f \"${FILE_PATH}\" ]; then\n    echo \"lua.sh: file not found: ${FILE_PATH}\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# build a JSON array of the raw argument strings for passing into lua\nARGS_JSON=\"[\"\nSEP=\"\"\nfor ARG in \"$@\"; do\n    ARGS_JSON=\"${ARGS_JSON}${SEP}${ARG}\"\n    SEP=\",\"\ndone\nARGS_JSON=\"${ARGS_JSON}]\"\n\n# set LUA_PATH so dkjson is findable before the shim runs its first require\nexport LUA_PATH=\"${DIR}/libs/?.lua;${LUA_PATH:-;}\"\n\n# run luajit with the driver shim inline;     "originalFile":"-- Hello function for the hello example map.\n-- Reads the name from data/state.json and returns a greeting string.\n-- No inputs: name comes from the map's data file at runtime.\n\nlocal json = require(\"dkjson\")\nlocal M    = {}\n\n-- {{{ read_name\nlocal function read_name(map_dir)\n    -- walk up from this file's location to find the map root's data/state.json\n    local state_path = map_dir .. \"/data/state.json\"\n    local f = io.open(state_path, \"r\")\n    if not f then return \"world\" end\n    local raw  = f:read(\"*a\")\n    f:close()\n    local obj, _, _ = json.decode(raw)\n    if not obj then return \"world\" end\n    local name_field = obj.fields and obj.fields.name\n    if not name_field then return \"world\" end\n    return name_field.value or \"world\"\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ hello\nfunction M.hello(map_dir)\n    local name = read_name(map_dir)\n    return \"Hello, \" .. tostring(name) .. \"!\"\nend\n-- }}}\n\nreturn M\n",

          "old_string":"-- Writes the result text to data/state.json in the map directory.\n-- Requires the soramech-data library on the package path.\n\nlocal data = require(\"soramech-data\")\nlocal M    = {}\n\n-- {{{ write_result\nfunction M.write_result(map_dir, text)\n    -- map_dir is injected by the driver as the first argument\n    local ok, werr = data.set(map_dir, \"state\", \"result\", text)\n    if not ok then\n        error(\"write_result: \" .. tostring(werr))\n    end\nend\n-- }}}",
          "new_string":"-- Writes the result text to data/state.json in the map directory.\n-- Uses dkjson directly (soramech-data is implemented in issue 109).\n\nlocal json = require(\"dkjson\")\nlocal M    = {}\n\n-- {{{ write_result\nfunction M.write_result(text)\n    -- SORAMECH_MAP_DIR is injected by the lua driver shim\n    local map_dir = SORAMECH_MAP_DIR or \".\"\n    local path = map_dir .. \"/data/state.json\"\n\n    local f_read = io.open(path, \"r\")\n    if not f_read then error(\"write_result: cannot open \" .. path) end\n    local raw = f_read:read(\"*a\")\n    f_read:close()\n\n    local obj, _, jerr = json.decode(raw)\n    if not obj then error(\"write_result: JSON error in state.json: \" .. tostring(jerr)) end\n\n    obj.fields.result.value = text\n\n    local tmp_path = path .. \".tmp\"\n    local f_write = io.open(tmp_path, \"w\")\n    if not f_write then error(\"write_result: cannot write \" .. tmp_path) end\n    f_write:write(json.encode(obj, { indent = true }))\n    f_write:close()\n    os.rename(tmp_path, path)\nend\n-- }}}",

    "content":"-- Minimal HTTP server for the SoraMech web editor.\n-- Handles file CRUD for map directories. Validates writes against the\n-- schema before touching disk. Closes after each response (HTTP/1.0 style).\n-- Started with: luajit soramech-server.lua <maps-root> [port]\n\nlocal DIR = \"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech\"\n\npackage.path  = DIR .. \"/libs/?.lua;\"\n             .. DIR .. \"/libs/luasocket/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;\"\n             .. DIR .. \"/src/?.lua;\"\n             .. package.path\npackage.cpath = DIR .. \"/libs/luasocket/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;\"\n             .. package.cpath\n\nlocal socket = require(\"socket\")\nlocal json   = require(\"dkjson\")\nlocal schema = require(\"001-schema\")\n\nlocal M = {}\n\n-- {{{ read_file\nlocal function read_file(path)\n    local f, err = io.open(path, \"r\")\n    if not f then return nil, err end\n    local data = f:read(\"*a\")\n    f:close()\n    return data\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ write_file_atomic\nlocal function write_file_atomic(path, data)\n    local tmp = path .. \".tmp\"\n    local f, err = io.open(tmp, \"w\")\n    if not f then return false, err end\n    f:write(data)\n    f:close()\n    local ok, rerr = os.rename(tmp, path)\n    if not ok then return false, rerr end\n    return true\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ parse_json_file\nlocal function parse_json_file(path)\n    local raw, err = read_file(path)\n    if not raw then return nil, err end\n    local obj, _, jerr = json.decode(raw)\n    if not obj then return nil, \"JSON error: \" .. tostring(jerr) end\n    return obj\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ list_dir_json\nlocal function list_dir_json(dir)\n    local handle = io.popen(\"ls \" .. dir .. \"/*.json 2>/dev/null\")\n    if not handle then return {} end\n    local listing = handle:read(\"*a\")\n    handle:close()\n    local files = {}\n    for path in listing:gmatch(\"[^\\n]+\") do\n        files[#files + 1] = path\n    end\n    return files\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ list_subdirs\nlocal function list_subdirs(dir)\n    local handle = io.popen(\"ls -d \" .. dir .. \"/*/ 2>/dev/null\")\n    if not handle then return {} end\n    local listing = handle:read(\"*a\")\n    handle:close()\n    local names = {}\n    for path in listing:gmatch(\"[^\\n]+\") do\n        local name = path:match(\"/([^/]+)/$\")\n        if name then names[#names + 1] = name end\n    end\n    return names\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ safe_path\n-- Returns the resolved path if it is within root, nil otherwise.\n-- Prevents path traversal outside the maps root.\nlocal function safe_path(root, ...)\n    local parts = { root }\n    for _, p in ipairs({...}) do\n        -- reject any component containing \"..\"\n        if tostring(p):find(\"%.%.\", 1, true) then return nil end\n        parts[#parts + 1] = p\n    end\n    return table.concat(parts, \"/\")\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ find_references\n-- Scan all box files in a map for any connection referencing the given box id.\nlocal function find_references(map_dir, box_id)\n    local refs = {}\n    local files = list_dir_json(map_dir .. \"/boxes\")\n    for _, path in ipairs(files) do\n        local box, _ = parse_json_file(path)\n        if box and box.id ~= box_id then\n            for _, c in ipairs(box.connections or {}) do\n                if c.to_box == box_id or c.from_box == box_id then\n                    refs[#refs + 1] = box.id\n                    break\n                end\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    return refs\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ respond\nlocal function respond(client, status, body, content_type)\n    content_type = content_type or \"application/json\"\n    local response = table.concat({\n        \"HTTP/1.0 \" .. status,\n        \"Content-Type: \" .. content_type,\n        \"Content-Length: \" .. #body,\n        \"Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *\",\n        \"Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS\",\n        \"Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type\",\n        \"Connection: close\",\n        \"\",\n        body,\n    }, \"\\r\\n\")\n    client:send(response)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ json_ok\nlocal function json_ok(client, data)\n    respond(client, \"200 OK\", json.encode(data))\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ json_err\nlocal function json_err(client, status, msg)\n    respond(client, status, json.encode({ error = msg }))\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ parse_request\nlocal function parse_request(client)\n    local line, err = client:receive(\"*l\")\n    if not line then return nil, err end\n\n    local method, path, _ = line:match(\"^(%u+) ([^ ]+) HTTP\")\n    if not method then return nil, \"bad request line: \" .. line end\n\n    -- read headers\n    local headers = {}\n    local content_length = 0\n    while true do\n        local hline = client:receive(\"*l\")\n        if not hline or hline == \"\" then break end\n        local k, v = hline:match(\"^([^:]+):%s*(.+)\")\n        if k then\n            headers[k:lower()] = v\n            if k:lower() == \"content-length\" then\n                content_length = tonumber(v) or 0\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    -- read body if present\n    local body = \"\"\n    if content_length > 0 then\n        body = client:receive(content_length) or \"\"\n    end\n\n    -- split path into segments\n    local parts = {}\n    for seg in path:gmatch(\"[^/]+\") do parts[#parts + 1] = seg end\n\n    return { method = method, path = path, parts = parts, body = body }\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_options\nlocal function handle_options(client)\n    respond(client, \"200 OK\", \"\", \"text/plain\")\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- ============================================================\n-- Route handlers\n-- ============================================================\n\n-- {{{ handle_list_maps\nlocal function handle_list_maps(client, req, maps_root)\n    local names = list_subdirs(maps_root)\n    json_ok(client, names)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_list_boxes\nlocal function handle_list_boxes(client, req, maps_root)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local boxes_dir = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"boxes\")\n    if not boxes_dir then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local files = list_dir_json(boxes_dir)\n    local ids = {}\n    for _, f in ipairs(files) do\n        local id = f:match(\"/([^/]+)%.json$\")\n        if id then ids[#ids + 1] = id end\n    end\n    json_ok(client, ids)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_get_box\nlocal function handle_get_box(client, req, maps_root)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local box_id   = req.parts[4]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"boxes\", box_id .. \".json\")\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local raw, err = read_file(path)\n    if not raw then return json_err(client, \"404 Not Found\", \"box not found: \" .. tostring(err)) end\n    respond(client, \"200 OK\", raw)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_put_box\nlocal function handle_put_box(client, req, maps_root)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local box_id   = req.parts[4]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"boxes\", box_id .. \".json\")\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local box, _, jerr = json.decode(req.body)\n    if not box then\n        return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid JSON: \" .. tostring(jerr))\n    end\n\n    local errs = schema.validate_box(box)\n    if #errs > 0 then\n        return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"schema error: \" .. table.concat(errs, \"; \"))\n    end\n\n    local ok, werr = write_file_atomic(path, req.body)\n    if not ok then return json_err(client, \"500 Internal Server Error\", tostring(werr)) end\n    json_ok(client, { ok = true })\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_delete_box\nlocal function handle_delete_box(client, req, maps_root)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local box_id   = req.parts[4]\n    local map_dir  = safe_path(maps_root, map_name)\n    local path     = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"boxes\", box_id .. \".json\")\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    -- check for references in other boxes before deleting\n    local refs = find_references(map_dir, box_id)\n    if #refs > 0 then\n        return json_err(client, \"409 Conflict\",\n            \"box '\" .. box_id .. \"' is referenced by: \" .. table.concat(refs, \", \"))\n    end\n\n    local ok = os.remove(path)\n    if not ok then  local map_name  = req.parts[2]\n    local file_name = req.parts[4]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"data\", file_name .. \".json\")\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local raw, err = read_file(path)\n    if not raw then return json_err(client, \"404 Not Found\", tostring(err)) end\n    respond(client, \"200 OK\", raw)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_put_data\nlocal function handle_put_data(client, req, maps_root)\n    local map_name  = req.parts[2]\n    local file_name = req.parts[4]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"data\", file_name .. \".json\")\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    -- validate it's at least valid JSON\n    local _, _, jerr = json.decode(req.body)\n    if jerr then\n        return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid JSON: \" .. tostring(jerr))\n    end\n\n    local ok, werr = write_file_atomic(path, req.body)\n    if not ok then return json_err(client, \"500 Internal Server Error\", tostring(werr)) end\n    json_ok(client, { ok = true })\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_get_simple\n-- Handles GET for single-file resources: drivers.json, meta.json\nlocal function handle_get_simple(client, req, maps_root, filename)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, filename)\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local raw, err = read_file(path)\n    if not raw then return json_err(client, \"404 Not Found\", tostring(err)) end\n    respond(client, \"200 OK\", raw)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_put_simple\nlocal function handle_put_simple(client, req, maps_root, filename, validator)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, filename)\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local obj, _, jerr = json.decode(req.body)\n    if not obj then\n        return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid JSON: \" .. tostring(jerr))\n    end\n\n    if validator then\n        local errs = validator(obj)\n        if #errs > 0 then\n            return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", table.concat(errs, \"; \"))\n        end\n    end\n\n    local ok, werr = write_file_atomic(path, req.body)\n    if not ok then return json_err(client, \"500 Internal Server Error\", tostring(werr)) end\n    json_ok(client, { ok = true })\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ dispatch\nlocal function dispatch(client, req, maps_root)\n    local m = req.method\n    local p = req.parts\n\n    -- OPTIONS preflight\n    if m == \"OPTIONS\" then return handle_options(client) end\n\n    -- GET /maps\n    if m == \"GET\" and #p == 1 and p[1] == \"maps\" then\n        return handle_list_maps(client, req, maps_root)\n    end\n\n    -- GET /maps/<name>/boxes\n    if m == \"GET\" and #p == 3 and p[1] == \"maps\" and p[3] == \"boxes\" then\n        return handle_list_boxes(client, req, maps_root)\n    end\n\n    -- GET/PUT/DELETE /maps/<name>/boxes/<id>\n    if #p == 4 and p[1] == \"maps\" and p[3] == \"boxes\" then\n        if m == \"GET\"    then return handle_get_box(client, req, maps_root) end\n        if m == \"PUT\"    then return handle_put_box(client, req, maps_root) end\n        if m == \"DELETE\" then return handle_delete_box(client, req, maps_root) end\n    end\n\n    -- GET/PUT /maps/<name>/data/<filename>\n    if #p == 4 and p[1] == \"maps\" and p[3] == \"data\" then\n        if m == \"GET\" then return handle_get_data(client, req, maps_root) end\n        if m == \"PUT\" then return handle_put_data(client, req, maps_root) end\n    end\n\n    -- GET/PUT /maps/<name>/drivers\n    if #p == 3 and p[1] == \"maps\" and p[3] == \"drivers\" then\n        if m == \"GET\" then return handle_get_simple(client, req, maps_root, \"drivers.json\") end\n        if m == \"PUT\" then return handle_put_simple(client, req, maps_root, \"drivers.json\", schema.validate_drivers) end\n    end\n\n    -- GET/PUT /maps/<name>/meta\n    if #p == 3 and p[1] == \"maps\" and p[3] == \"meta\" then\n        if m == \"GET\" then return handle_get_simple(client, req, maps_root, \"meta.json\") end\n        if m == \"PUT\" then return handle_put_simple(client, req, maps_root, \"meta.json\", schema.validate_meta) end\n    end\n\n    json_err(client, \"404 Not Found\", \"no route for \" .. m .. \" \" .. req.path)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ serve\nfunction M.serve(maps_root, port)\n    local server, err = socket.bind(\"*\", port)\n    if not server then\n        io.stderr:write(\"server: cannot bind to port \" .. port .. \": \" .. tostring(err) .. \"\\n\")\n        os.exit(1)\n    end\n    server:settimeout(1)  -- 1s accept timeout so we can handle signals cleanly\n\n    print(\"soramech-server listening on :\" .. port .. \" (maps: \" .. maps_root .. \")\")\n\n    while true do\n        local client, cerr = server:accept()\n        if client then\n            client:settimeout(5)\n            local t_start = socket.gettime()\n\n            local req, rerr = parse_request(client)\n            if req then\n                local ok_disp, derr = pcall(dispatch, client, req, maps_root)\n                if not ok_disp then\n                    pcall(json_err, client, \"500 Internal Server Error\", tostring(derr))\n                end\n                local elapsed = math.floor((socket.gettime() - t_start) * 1000)\n                print(string.format(\"[%.0f] %s %s (%dms)\",\n                    os.time(), req.method, req.path, elapsed))\n            else\n                pcall(json_err, client, \"400 Bad Request\", tostring(rerr))\n            end\n\n            client:close()\n        end\n        -- cerr is \"timeout\" on accept timeout — that's normal, keep looping\n    end\nend\n-- }}}\n\nreturn M\n",

          "content":"# 005-http-server.lua — Public API\n\nMinimal HTTP/1.0 server for the SoraMech web editor.\n\n## M.serve(maps_root: string, port: number)\n\nBinds to the given port and serves map file CRUD indefinitely.\nOne connection per request; CORS headers on every response.\nLogs each request to stdout as: [timestamp] METHOD /path (Nms)\n\nRoutes:\n  GET  /maps                    -> string[]  (map names)\n  GET  /maps/<n>/boxes          -> string[]  (box ids)\n  GET  /maps/<n>/boxes/<id>     -> box JSON\n  PUT  /maps/<n>/boxes/<id>     <- box JSON  (validates schema)\n  DEL  /maps/<n>/boxes/<id>     -> {ok}      (409 if referenced)\n  GET  /maps/<n>/data/<f>       -> data JSON\n  PUT  /maps/<n>/data/<f>       <- data JSON\n  GET  /maps/<n>/drivers        -> drivers JSON\n  PUT  /maps/<n>/drivers        <- drivers JSON\n  GET  /maps/<n>/meta           -> meta JSON\n  PUT  /maps/<n>/meta           <- meta JSON (validates schema)\n",

  "toolUseResult":{
    "content":"# 005-http-server.lua — Public API\n\nMinimal HTTP/1.0 server for the SoraMech web editor.\n\n## M.serve(maps_root: string, port: number)\n\nBinds to the given port and serves map file CRUD indefinitely.\nOne connection per request; CORS headers on every response.\nLogs each request to stdout as: [timestamp] METHOD /path (Nms)\n\nRoutes:\n  GET  /maps                    -> string[]  (map names)\n  GET  /maps/<n>/boxes          -> string[]  (box ids)\n  GET  /maps/<n>/boxes/<id>     -> box JSON\n  PUT  /maps/<n>/boxes/<id>     <- box JSON  (validates schema)\n  DEL  /maps/<n>/boxes/<id>     -> {ok}      (409 if referenced)\n  GET  /maps/<n>/data/<f>       -> data JSON\n  PUT  /maps/<n>/data/<f>       <- data JSON\n  GET  /maps/<n>/drivers        -> drivers JSON\n  PUT  /maps/<n>/drivers        <- drivers JSON\n  GET  /maps/<n>/meta           -> meta JSON\n  PUT  /maps/<n>/meta           <- meta JSON (validates schema)\n",

assert_contains\nassert_contains() {\n    local label=\"${1}\"\n    local expected=\"${2}\"\n    local actual=\"${3}\"\n    if echo \"${actual}\" | grep -qF \"${expected}\"; then\n        echo \"  PASS: ${label}\"\n        PASS=$((PASS + 1))\n    else\n        echo \"  FAIL: ${label}\"\n        echo \"        expected to contain: ${expected}\"\n        echo \"        got: ${actual}\"\n        FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))\n    fi\n}\n# }}}\n\n# {{{ start_server\nluajit \"${DIR}/soramech-server.lua\" \"${MAPS_ROOT}\" \"${PORT}\" > /tmp/soramech-test-server.log 2>&1 &\nSERVER_PID=$!\nsleep 0.5\nif ! kill -0 \"${SERVER_PID}\" 2>/dev/null; then\n    echo \"FAIL: server did not start (check /tmp/soramech-test-server.log)\"\n    exit 1\nfi\necho \"server started (pid ${SERVER_PID})\"\n# }}}\n\ncleanup() {\n    kill \"${SERVER_PID}\" 2>/dev/null\n}\ntrap cleanup EXIT\n\n# Test 1: list maps\nRESULT=$(curl -s \"${BASE}/maps\")\nassert_contains \"GET /maps returns hello\" \"hello\" \"${RESULT}\"\n\n# Test 2: list boxes in hello map\nRESULT=$(curl -s \"${BASE}/maps/hello/boxes\")\nassert_contains \"GET /maps/hello/boxes returns greet\" \"greet\" \"${RESULT}\"\n\n# Test 3: read a box\nRESULT=$(curl -s \"${BASE}/maps/hello/boxes/greet\")\nassert_contains \"GET /maps/hello/boxes/greet has id field\" '\"id\"' \"${RESULT}\"\nassert_contains \"GET /maps/hello/boxes/greet has greet id\" '\"greet\"' \"${RESULT}\"\n\n# Test 4: create a new box -s -X PUT -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n    -d \"${NEW_BOX}\" \"${BASE}/maps/hello/boxes/test-box\")\nassert_contains \"PUT new box returns ok\" '\"ok\"' \"${RESULT}\"\n\n# Test 5: read it assert_contains\nassert_contains() {\n    local label=\"${1}\"\n    local expected=\"${2}\"\n    local actual=\"${3}\"\n    if echo \"${actual}\" | grep -qF \"${expected}\"; then\n        echo \"  PASS: ${label}\"\n        PASS=$((PASS + 1))\n    else\n        echo \"  FAIL: ${label}\"\n        echo \"        expected to contain: ${expected}\"\n        echo \"        got: ${actual}\"\n        FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))\n    fi\n}\n# }}}\n\n# {{{ start_server\nluajit \"${DIR}/soramech-server.lua\" \"${MAPS_ROOT}\" \"${PORT}\" > /tmp/soramech-test-server.log 2>&1 &\nSERVER_PID=$!\nsleep 0.5\nif ! kill -0 \"${SERVER_PID}\" 2>/dev/null; then\n    echo \"FAIL: server did not start (check /tmp/soramech-test-server.log)\"\n    exit 1\nfi\necho \"server started (pid ${SERVER_PID})\"\n# }}}\n\ncleanup() {\n    kill \"${SERVER_PID}\" 2>/dev/null\n}\ntrap cleanup EXIT\n\n# Test 1: list maps\nRESULT=$(curl -s \"${BASE}/maps\")\nassert_contains \"GET /maps returns hello\" \"hello\" If a box is selected, removes the box (prompts\n   if the box has connections — lists them).\n\n## Related documents\n\n- docs/001-architecture.md — connection format (both-ends invariant)\n- issues/106 — canvas and port dot rendering\n- issues/108 — branch box port colors and predicate display on wires\n\n## Notes\n\nWire hit testing on a bezier curve is non-trivial. A practical approach:\nsample 20 evenly spaced points along the curve, find the minimum distance\nto the cursor. If under a threshold (e.g., 6px screen space), the wire\nis hit. This is fast enough for the number of wires expected.\n\nThe fetch-before-PUT pattern in step 4 is important. Without it, a\nconnection added from two different browsers simultaneously can cause one\nto overwrite the other's change. In v1, last-write-wins is acceptable\n(no locking), but fetching first reduces the window.\n",

          "content":"// Camera state and canvas management.\n// Owns pan/zoom, the render loop, and coordinate conversion.\n\nconst Canvas = (() => {\n  const el  = document.getElementById('canvas');\n  const ctx = el.getContext('2d');\n\n  const cam = { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 };\n  let dirty = true;\n  let dragging_cam = false;\n  let drag_start   = null;\n\n  // {{{ resize\n  function resize() {\n    el.width  = window.innerWidth  - (document.getElementById('sidebar').offsetWidth || 0);\n    el.height = window.innerHeight;\n    dirty = true;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ world_to_screen\n  function world_to_screen(wx, wy) {\n    return {\n      x: (wx + cam.x) * cam.zoom,\n      y: (wy + cam.y) * cam.zoom,\n    };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ screen_to_world\n  function screen_to_world(sx, sy) {\n    return {\n      x: sx / cam.zoom - cam.x,\n      y: sy / cam.zoom - cam.y,\n    };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mark_dirty\n  function mark_dirty() { dirty = true; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ start_frame\n  // Called by the render loop; returns true if a redraw is needed.\n  function start_frame() {\n    if (!dirty) return false;\n    dirty = false;\n    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, el.width, el.height);\n    ctx.save();\n    ctx.scale(cam.zoom, cam.zoom);\n    ctx.translate(cam.x, cam.y);\n    return true;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ end_frame\n  function end_frame() { ctx.restore(); }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mouse_pos\n  function mouse_pos(e) {\n    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // Panning via middle-mouse or space+drag\n  let space_down = false;\n  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') space_down = true; });\n  window.addEventListener('keyup',   e => { if (e.code === 'Space') space_down = false; });\n\n  el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {\n    if (e.button === 1 || (e.button === 0 && space_down)) {\n      dragging_cam = true;\n      drag_start   = { x: e.clientX - cam.x * cam.zoom,\n                       y: e.clientY - cam.y * cam.zoom };\n      e.preventDefault();\n    }\n  });\n\n  window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {\n    if (dragging_cam && drag_start) {\n      cam.x = (e.clientX - drag_start.x) / cam.zoom;\n      cam.y = (e.clientY - drag_start.y) / cam.zoom;\n      mark_dirty();\n    }\n  });\n\n  window.addEventListener('mouseup', e => {\n    if (e.button === 1 || e.button === 0) dragging_cam = false;\n  });\n\n  // Zoom via scroll wheel\n  el.addEventListener('wheel', e => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const m   = mouse_pos(e);\n    const wbefore = screen_to_world(m.x, m.y);\n    const factor  = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9;\n    cam.zoom = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(5, cam.zoom * factor));\n    const wafter = screen_to_world(m.x, m.y);\n    cam.x += wafter.x - wbefore.x;\n    cam.y += wafter.y - wbefore.y;\n    mark_dirty();\n  }, { passive: false });\n\n  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);\n  resize();\n\n  return { el, ctx, cam, world_to_screen, screen_to_world, mark_dirty,\n           start_frame, end_frame, mouse_pos };\n})();\n",

    "content":"// Camera state and canvas management.\n// Owns pan/zoom, the render loop, and coordinate conversion.\n\nconst Canvas = (() => {\n  const el  = document.getElementById('canvas');\n  const ctx = el.getContext('2d');\n\n  const cam = { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 };\n  let dirty = true;\n  let dragging_cam = false;\n  let drag_start   = null;\n\n  // {{{ resize\n  function resize() {\n    el.width  = window.innerWidth  - (document.getElementById('sidebar').offsetWidth || 0);\n    el.height = window.innerHeight;\n    dirty = true;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ world_to_screen\n  function world_to_screen(wx, wy) {\n    return {\n      x: (wx + cam.x) * cam.zoom,\n      y: (wy + cam.y) * cam.zoom,\n    };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ screen_to_world\n  function screen_to_world(sx, sy) {\n    return {\n      x: sx / cam.zoom - cam.x,\n      y: sy / cam.zoom - cam.y,\n    };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mark_dirty\n  function mark_dirty() { dirty = true; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ start_frame\n  // Called by the render loop; returns true if a redraw is needed.\n  function start_frame() {\n    if (!dirty) return false;\n    dirty = false;\n    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, el.width, el.height);\n    ctx.save();\n    ctx.scale(cam.zoom, cam.zoom);\n    ctx.translate(cam.x, cam.y);\n    return true;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ end_frame\n  function end_frame() { ctx.restore(); }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mouse_pos\n  function mouse_pos(e) {\n    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // Panning via middle-mouse or space+drag\n  let space_down = false;\n  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') space_down = true; });\n  window.addEventListener('keyup',   e => { if (e.code === 'Space') space_down = false; });\n\n  el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {\n    if (e.button === 1 || (e.button === 0 && space_down)) {\n      dragging_cam = true;\n      drag_start   = { x: e.clientX - cam.x * cam.zoom,\n                       y: e.clientY - cam.y * cam.zoom };\n      e.preventDefault();\n    }\n  });\n\n  window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {\n    if (dragging_cam && drag_start) {\n      cam.x = (e.clientX - drag_start.x) / cam.zoom;\n      cam.y = (e.clientY - drag_start.y) / cam.zoom;\n      mark_dirty();\n    }\n  });\n\n  window.addEventListener('mouseup', e => {\n    if (e.button === 1 || e.button === 0) dragging_cam = false;\n  });\n\n  // Zoom via scroll wheel\n  el.addEventListener('wheel', e => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const m   = mouse_pos(e);\n    const wbefore = screen_to_world(m.x, m.y);\n    const factor  = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9;\n    cam.zoom = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(5, cam.zoom * factor));\n    const wafter = screen_to_world(m.x, m.y);\n    cam.x += wafter.x - wbefore.x;\n    cam.y += wafter.y - wbefore.y;\n    mark_dirty();\n  }, { passive: false });\n\n  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);\n  resize();\n\n  return { el, ctx, cam, world_to_screen, screen_to_world, mark_dirty,\n           start_frame, end_frame, mouse_pos };\n})();\n",
    "userModified":false,
    "type":"create",
    "filePath":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/assets/js/001-canvas.js",
    "structuredPatch":[]
  }
}

          "content":"// Box rendering, layout, and hit testing.\n// Each box knows its world-space position; the camera transform is applied by the canvas.\n\nconst Boxes = (() => {\n  const BOX_W         = 180;\n  const BOX_HEADER    = 36;\n  const PORT_ROW_H    = 22;\n  const PORT_R        = 6;   // port dot radius in world units\n  const MIN_BOX_H     = 80;\n\n  const KIND_COLOR = { call: '#4a9eff', branch: '#ff8c42', data: '#4caf7d' };\n\n  // boxes: { [id]: box_data }\n  let boxes = {};\n\n  // {{{ box_height\n  function box_height(box) {\n    const n = Math.max(\n      (box.inputs || []).length,\n      (box.kind === 'branch' ? (box.ports || []).length : (box.outputs || []).length)\n    );\n    return Math.max(MIN_BOX_H, BOX_HEADER + n * PORT_ROW_H + 8);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ port_positions\n  // Returns world-space {x,y} for each port dot on a box.\n  function port_positions(box) {\n    const bx = box.ui?.x ?? 0;\n    const by = box.ui?.y ?? 0;\n    const h  = box_height(box);\n    const inputs  = box.inputs  || [];\n    const outputs = box.kind === 'branch' ? (box.ports || []) : (box.outputs || []);\n\n    const in_pts  = inputs.map((p, i) => ({\n      name: p.name, side: 'input',\n      x: bx,\n      y: by + BOX_HEADER + PORT_ROW_H * i + PORT_ROW_H / 2,\n    }));\n    const out_pts = outputs.map((p, i) => ({\n      name: p.name, side: 'output',\n      x: bx + BOX_W,\n      y: by + BOX_HEADER + PORT_ROW_H * i + PORT_ROW_H / 2,\n    }));\n    return { inputs: in_pts, outputs: out_pts };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ draw_box\n  function draw_box(ctx, box, selected) {\n    const x = box.ui?.x ?? 0;\n    const y = box.ui?.y ?? 0;\n    const w = BOX_W;\n    const h = box_height(box);\n    const kind  = box.kind || 'call';\n    const color = KIND_COLOR[kind] || '#888';\n\n    // shadow when selected\n    if (selected) {\n      ctx.shadowColor = color;\n      ctx.shadowBlur  = 12;\n    }\n\n    // body\n    ctx.fillStyle   = '#1e2130';\n    ctx.strokeStyle = selected ? color : '#3a3f55';\n    ctx.lineWidth   = selected ? 2 : 1;\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 6);\n    ctx.fill();\n    ctx.stroke();\n\n    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;\n\n    // header bar\n    ctx.fillStyle = color + '33';\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, BOX_HEADER, [6, 6, 0, 0]);\n    ctx.fill();\n\n    // label\n    ctx.fillStyle  = '#e8eaf6';\n    ctx.font       = 'bold 12px monospace';\n    ctx.textAlign  = 'left';\n    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n    ctx.fillText(box.label || box.id, x + 10, y + BOX_HEADER / 2);\n\n    // kind badge (top right)\n    ctx.fillStyle  = color;\n    ctx.font       = '9px monospace';\n    ctx.textAlign  = 'right';\n    ctx.fillText(kind.toUpperCase(), x + w - 8, y + BOX_HEADER / 2);\n\n    // port dots and labels\n    const { inputs: in_pts, outputs: out_pts } = port_positions(box);\n\n    ctx.font      = '10px monospace';\n    ctx.fillStyle = '#9ea3c0';\n\n    in_pts.forEach((p, i) => {\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, PORT_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n      ctx.fillStyle   = '#2d3250';\n      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6c72a0';\n      ctx.lineWidth   = 1.5;\n      ctx.fill();\n      ctx.stroke();\n\n      ctx.fillStyle  = '#9ea3c0';\n      ctx.textAlign  = 'left';\n      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n      ctx.fillText(p.name, p.x + PORT_R + 4, p.y);\n    });\n\n    // branch ports use palette colors\n    const port_palette = ['#ff8c42','#4a9eff','#4caf7d','#e91e63','#9c27b0','#00bcd4'];\n    out_pts.forEach((p, i) => {\n      const dot_color = (box.kind === 'branch') ? port_palette[i % port_palette.length] : color;\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, PORT_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n      ctx.fillStyle   = dot_color + '44';\n      ctx.strokeStyle = dot_color;\n      ctx.lineWidth   = 1.5;\n      ctx.fill();\n      ctx.stroke();\n\n      ctx.fillStyle  = '#9ea3c0';\n      ctx.textAlign  = 'right';\n      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n      ctx.fillText(p.name, p.x - PORT_R - 4, p.y);\n    });\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ draw_all\n  function draw_all(ctx, selected_id) {\n    for (const id in boxes) {\n      draw_box(ctx, boxes[id], id === selected_id);\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ hit_test_port\n  // Returns {box_id, port_name, side, x, y} for the port under world point (wx,wy), or null.\n  function hit_test_port(wx, wy) {\n    for (const id in boxes) {\n      const { inputs, outputs } = port_positions(boxes[id]);\n      for (const p of [...inputs, ...outputs]) {\n        const dx = wx - p.x, dy = wy - p.y;\n        if (dx*dx + dy*dy <= (PORT_R + 4) * (PORT_R + 4)) {\n          return { box_id: id, port_name: p.name, side: p.side, x: p.x, y: p.y };\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ hit_test_box\n  // Returns box id if (wx,wy) is inside a box body, or null.\n  function hit_test_box(wx, wy) {\n    for (const id in boxes) {\n      const b = boxes[id];\n      const x = b.ui?.x ?? 0, y = b.ui?.y ?? 0;\n      if (wx >= x && wx <= x + BOX_W && wy >= y && wy <= y + box_height(b)) return id;\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_port_world_pos\n  function get_port_world_pos(box_id, port_name, side) {\n    const box = boxes[box_id];\n    if (!box) return null;\n    const { inputs, outputs } = port_positions(box);\n    const list = side === 'input' ? inputs : outputs;\n    const p = list.find(p => p.name === port_name);\n    return p ? { x: p.x, y: p.y } : null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return {\n    boxes, BOX_W, BOX_HEADER, PORT_R,\n    box_height, port_positions,\n    draw_all, draw_box, hit_test_port, hit_test_box, get_port_world_pos,\n  };\n})();\n",

  "toolUseResult":{
    "content":"// Box rendering, layout, and hit testing.\n// Each box knows its world-space position; the camera transform is applied by the canvas.\n\nconst Boxes = (() => {\n  const BOX_W         = 180;\n  const BOX_HEADER    = 36;\n  const PORT_ROW_H    = 22;\n  const PORT_R        = 6;   // port dot radius in world units\n  const MIN_BOX_H     = 80;\n\n  const KIND_COLOR = { call: '#4a9eff', branch: '#ff8c42', data: '#4caf7d' };\n\n  // boxes: { [id]: box_data }\n  let boxes = {};\n\n  // {{{ box_height\n  function box_height(box) {\n    const n = Math.max(\n      (box.inputs || []).length,\n      (box.kind === 'branch' ? (box.ports || []).length : (box.outputs || []).length)\n    );\n    return Math.max(MIN_BOX_H, BOX_HEADER + n * PORT_ROW_H + 8);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ port_positions\n  // Returns world-space {x,y} for each port dot on a box.\n  function port_positions(box) {\n    const bx = box.ui?.x ?? 0;\n    const by = box.ui?.y ?? 0;\n    const h  = box_height(box);\n    const inputs  = box.inputs  || [];\n    const outputs = box.kind === 'branch' ? (box.ports || []) : (box.outputs || []);\n\n    const in_pts  = inputs.map((p, i) => ({\n      name: p.name, side: 'input',\n      x: bx,\n      y: by + BOX_HEADER + PORT_ROW_H * i + PORT_ROW_H / 2,\n    }));\n    const out_pts = outputs.map((p, i) => ({\n      name: p.name, side: 'output',\n      x: bx + BOX_W,\n      y: by + BOX_HEADER + PORT_ROW_H * i + PORT_ROW_H / 2,\n    }));\n    return { inputs: in_pts, outputs: out_pts };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ draw_box\n  function draw_box(ctx, box, selected) {\n    const x = box.ui?.x ?? 0;\n    const y = box.ui?.y ?? 0;\n    const w = BOX_W;\n    const h = box_height(box);\n    const kind  = box.kind || 'call';\n    const color = KIND_COLOR[kind] || '#888';\n\n    // shadow when selected\n    if (selected) {\n      ctx.shadowColor = color;\n      ctx.shadowBlur  = 12;\n    }\n\n    // body\n    ctx.fillStyle   = '#1e2130';\n    ctx.strokeStyle = selected ? color : '#3a3f55';\n    ctx.lineWidth   = selected ? 2 : 1;\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 6);\n    ctx.fill();\n    ctx.stroke();\n\n    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;\n\n    // header bar\n    ctx.fillStyle = color + '33';\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, BOX_HEADER, [6, 6, 0, 0]);\n    ctx.fill();\n\n    // label\n    ctx.fillStyle  = '#e8eaf6';\n    ctx.font       = 'bold 12px monospace';\n    ctx.textAlign  = 'left';\n    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n    ctx.fillText(box.label || box.id, x + 10, y + BOX_HEADER / 2);\n\n    // kind badge (top right)\n    ctx.fillStyle  = color;\n    ctx.font       = '9px monospace';\n    ctx.textAlign  = 'right';\n    ctx.fillText(kind.toUpperCase(), x + w - 8, y + BOX_HEADER / 2);\n\n    // port dots and labels\n    const { inputs: in_pts, outputs: out_pts } = port_positions(box);\n\n    ctx.font      = '10px monospace';\n    ctx.fillStyle = '#9ea3c0';\n\n    in_pts.forEach((p, i) => {\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, PORT_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n      ctx.fillStyle   = '#2d3250';\n      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6c72a0';\n      ctx.lineWidth   = 1.5;\n      ctx.fill();\n      ctx.stroke();\n\n      ctx.fillStyle  = '#9ea3c0';\n      ctx.textAlign  = 'left';\n      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n      ctx.fillText(p.name, p.x + PORT_R + 4, p.y);\n    });\n\n    // branch ports use palette colors\n    const port_palette = ['#ff8c42','#4a9eff','#4caf7d','#e91e63','#9c27b0','#00bcd4'];\n    out_pts.forEach((p, i) => {\n      const dot_color = (box.kind === 'branch') ? port_palette[i % port_palette.length] : color;\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, PORT_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n      ctx.fillStyle   = dot_color + '44';\n      ctx.strokeStyle = dot_color;\n      ctx.lineWidth   = 1.5;\n      ctx.fill();\n      ctx.stroke();\n\n      ctx.fillStyle  = '#9ea3c0';\n      ctx.textAlign  = 'right';\n      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n      ctx.fillText(p.name, p.x - PORT_R - 4, p.y);\n    });\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ draw_all\n  function draw_all(ctx, selected_id) {\n    for (const id in boxes) {\n      draw_box(ctx, boxes[id], id === selected_id);\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ hit_test_port\n  // Returns {box_id, port_name, side, x, y} for the port under world point (wx,wy), or null.\n  function hit_test_port(wx, wy) {\n    for (const id in boxes) {\n      const { inputs, outputs } = port_positions(boxes[id]);\n      for (const p of [...inputs, ...outputs]) {\n        const dx = wx - p.x, dy = wy - p.y;\n        if (dx*dx + dy*dy <= (PORT_R + 4) * (PORT_R + 4)) {\n          return { box_id: id, port_name: p.name, side: p.side, x: p.x, y: p.y };\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ hit_test_box\n  // Returns box id if (wx,wy) is inside a box body, or null.\n  function hit_test_box(wx, wy) {\n    for (const id in boxes) {\n      const b = boxes[id];\n      const x = b.ui?.x ?? 0, y = b.ui?.y ?? 0;\n      if (wx >= x && wx <= x + BOX_W && wy >= y && wy <= y + box_height(b)) return id;\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_port_world_pos\n  function get_port_world_pos(box_id, port_name, side) {\n    const box = boxes[box_id];\n    if (!box) return null;\n    const { inputs, outputs } = port_positions(box);\n    const list = side === 'input' ? inputs : outputs;\n    const p = list.find(p => p.name === port_name);\n    return p ? { x: p.x, y: p.y } : null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return {\n    boxes, BOX_W, BOX_HEADER, PORT_R,\n    box_height, port_positions,\n    draw_all, draw_box, hit_test_port, hit_test_box, get_port_world_pos,\n  };\n})();\n",
    "userModified":false,
    "type":"create",
    "filePath":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/assets/js/002-boxes.js",
    "structuredPatch":[]
  }
}

          "content":"// Thin fetch wrapper for the soramech-server REST API.\n// All functions are async and throw on non-2xx responses.\n\nconst API = (() => {\n  let base_url = '';\n  let map_name = '';\n\n  // {{{ init\n  function init(url, name) { base_url = url.replace(/\\/$/, ''); map_name = name; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ request\n  async function request(method, path, body) {\n    const opts = { method, headers: {} };\n    if (body !== undefined) {\n      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';\n      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);\n    }\n    const res = await fetch(base_url + path, opts);\n    const text = await res.text();\n    let data;\n    try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { data = { error: text }; }\n    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);\n    return data;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_maps\n  async function list_maps() { return request('GET', '/maps'); }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_boxes\n  async function list_boxes() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_box\n  async function get_box(id) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_box\n  async function put_box(id, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ delete_box\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    return request('DELETE', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_meta\n  async function get_meta() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_meta\n  async function put_meta(data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_data\n  async function get_data(filename) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_data\n  async function put_data(filename, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { init, list_maps, list_boxes, get_box, put_box, delete_box,\n           get_meta, put_meta, get_data, put_data };\n})();\n",

    "content":"// Thin fetch wrapper for the soramech-server REST API.\n// All functions are async and throw on non-2xx responses.\n\nconst API = (() => {\n  let base_url = '';\n  let map_name = '';\n\n  // {{{ init\n  function init(url, name) { base_url = url.replace(/\\/$/, ''); map_name = name; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ request\n  async function request(method, path, body) {\n    const opts = { method, headers: {} };\n    if (body !== undefined) {\n      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';\n      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);\n    }\n    const res = await fetch(base_url + path, opts);\n    const text = await res.text();\n    let data;\n    try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { data = { error: text }; }\n    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);\n    return data;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_maps\n  async function list_maps() { return request('GET', '/maps'); }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_boxes\n  async function list_boxes() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_box\n  async function get_box(id) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_box\n  async function put_box(id, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ delete_box\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    return request('DELETE', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_meta\n  async function get_meta() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_meta\n  async function put_meta(data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_data\n  async function get_data(filename) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_data\n  async function put_data(filename, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { init, list_maps, list_boxes, get_box, put_box, delete_box,\n           get_meta, put_meta, get_data, put_data };\n})();\n",

save(); });\n    return inp;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_port_list\n  function mk_port_list(ports, on_change) {\n    const wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    wrap.className = 'port-list';\n\n    const render_ports = () => {\n      wrap.innerHTML = '';\n      ports.forEach((p, i) => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className = 'port-row';\n\n        const name_inp = document.createElement('input');\n        name_inp.type  = 'text';\n        name_inp.value = p.name || '';\n        name_inp.placeholder = 'name';\n        name_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].name = name_inp.value; on_change(); save(); });\n\n        const del_btn = document.createElement('button');\n        del_btn.textContent = '×';\n        del_btn.className   = 'port-del';\n        del_btn.addEventListener('click', () => { ports.splice(i, 1); render_ports(); on_change(); save(); });\n\n        row.appendChild(name_inp);\n        row.appendChild(type_inp);\n        row.appendChild(del_btn);\n        wrap.appendChild(row);\n      });\n\n      const add_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      add_btn.textContent = '+ port';\n      add_btn.className   = 'add-port';\n      add_btn.addEventListener('click', () => {\n        ports.push({ name: '', type: 'string' });\n        render_ports();\n        on_change();\n        save();\n      });\n      wrap.appendChild(add_btn);\n    };\n\n    render_ports();\n    return wrap;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_branch_port_list\n  function mk_branch_port_list(ports, on_change) {\n    const OPS = ['eq','lt','gt','lte','gte','contains','matches'];\n    const wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    wrap.className = 'port-list';\n\n    const render_ports = () => {\n      wrap.innerHTML = '';\n      ports.forEach((p, i) => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className = 'port-row branch-port-row';\n\n        const name_inp = document.createElement('input');\n        name_inp.type  = 'text';\n        name_inp.value = p.name || '';\n        name_inp.placeholder = 'port name';\n        name_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].name = name_inp.value; opt.textContent = op;\n            if (op === p.predicate.op) opt.selected = true;\n            op_sel.appendChild(opt);\n          });\n          op_sel.addEventListener('change', () => { ports[i].predicate.op = op_sel.value; '';\n          val_inp.placeholder = 'value';\n          val_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].predicate.value = val_inp.value; save(); });\n\n          row.appendChild(op_sel);\n          row.appendChild(val_inp);\n        }\n\n        // can't delete the else port\n        if (p.name !== 'else') {\n          const del_btn = document.createElement('button');\n          del_btn.textContent = '×';\n          del_btn.className   = 'port-del';\n          del_btn.addEventListener('click', () => { ports.splice(i, 1); render_ports(); on_change(); save(); });\n          row.appendChild(del_btn);\n        }\n\n        wrap.appendChild(row);\n      });\n\n      const add_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      add_btn.textContent = '+ port';\n      add_btn.className   = 'add-port';\n      add_btn.addEventListener('click', () => {\n        // insert before else\n        const else_i = ports.findIndex(p => p.name === 'else');\n        const new_port = { name: '', predicate: { op: 'eq', value: '' } };\n        if (else_i >= 0) ports.splice(else_i, 0, new_port);\n        else ports.push(new_port);\n        render_ports(); on_change(); save();\n      });\n      wrap.appendChild(add_btn);\n    };\n\n    render_ports();\n    return wrap;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ show\n  function show(box, on_changed) {\n    current_box  = box;\n    on_change_cb = on_changed;\n    panel.classList.remove('hidden');\n    title.textContent = box.id;\n    fields.innerHTML  = '';\n\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('label',\n      mk_text_input(box.label, v => { current_box.label = v; })));\n\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('kind', (() => {\n      const sel = document.createElement('select');\n      ['call','branch','data'].forEach(k => {\n        const opt = document.createElement('option');\n        opt.value = k; opt.textContent = k;\n        if (k === box.kind) opt.selected = true;\n        sel.appendChild(opt);\n      });\n      sel.addEventListener('change', () => { current_box.kind = sel.value; show(current_box, on_change_cb);         "name":"Write",

          "type":"direct"
        },
        "input":{
          "content":"// Top-level app: connects everything, loads the map, drives the render loop.\n\nconst App = (() => {\n  let selected_id   = null;\n  let drag_box_id   = null;\n  let drag_offset   = { x: 0, y: 0 };\n  let drawing_wire  = null;  // { from_box, from_port, from_side, cur_x, cur_y }\n  let hover_port    = null;\n  let status_el     = document.getElementById('status');\n\n  // {{{ status_msg\n  window.status_msg = function(msg, level = 'info') {\n    status_el.textContent = msg;\n    status_el.className   = 'status ' + level;\n  };\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ load_map\n  async function load_map() {\n    status_msg('loading…');\n    try {\n      const ids = await API.list_boxes();\n      const fetches = ids.map(id => API.get_box(id));\n      const all = await Promise.all(fetches);\n      Boxes.boxes = {};\n      all.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('loaded ' + ids.length + ' boxes');\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('load error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ new_box_at\n  async function new_box_at(wx, wy) {\n    const id = 'box-' + Date.now().toString(36);\n    const box = {\n      id, label: 'New Box', kind: 'call',\n      ref: '', fn: '', inputs: [], outputs: [], connections: [],\n      ui: { x: Math.round(wx), y: Math.round(wy) },\n    };\n    try {\n      await API.put_box(id, box);\n      Boxes.boxes[id] = box;\n      selected_id = id;\n      Inspector.show(box, () => Canvas.mark_dirty());\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n    } catch(e) {\n           "content":"// Wire rendering, hit testing, and connection management.\n// Wires are derived from box connection data — no separate wire store.\n\nconst Wires = (() => {\n  const BEZIER_CTRL_OFFSET = 80;\n  const HIT_SAMPLES        = 20;\n  const HIT_THRESHOLD_PX   = 8;\n  const PORT_PALETTE = ['#ff8c42','#4a9eff','#4caf7d','#e91e63','#9c27b0','#00bcd4'];\n\n  let _selected_wire = null;  // { from_box, from_port, to_box, to_input }\n\n  // {{{ selected_wire\n  function selected_wire() { return _selected_wire; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ bezier_point\n  function bezier_point(t, x0, y0, cx0, cy0, cx1, cy1, x1, y1) {\n    const mt = 1 - t;\n    return {\n      x: mt*mt*mt*x0 + 3*mt*mt*t*cx0 + 3*mt*t*t*cx1 + t*t*t*x1,\n      y: mt*mt*mt*y0 + 3*mt*mt*t*cy0 + 3*mt*t*t*cy1 + t*t*t*y1,\n    };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ draw_bezier\n  function draw_bezier(ctx, x0, y0, x1, y1, color, selected) {\n    const cx0 = x0 + BEZIER_CTRL_OFFSET;\n    const cy0 = y0;\n    const cx1 = x1 - BEZIER_CTRL_OFFSET;\n    const cy1 = y1;\n\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(x0, y0);\n    ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx0, cy0, cx1, cy1, x1, y1);\n    ctx.strokeStyle = selected ? '#ffffff' : color;\n    ctx.lineWidth   = selected ? 2.5 : 1.5;\n    ctx.setLineDash(selected ? [] : []);\n    ctx.stroke();\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ hit_test_wire\n  // Returns the connection record if cursor (wx,wy) is within HIT_THRESHOLD pixels\n  // of any wire, or null. Operates in world space; threshold is adjusted for zoom.\n  function hit_test_wire(wx, wy, zoom) {\n    const threshold = HIT_THRESHOLD_PX / zoom;\n    for (const id in Boxes.boxes) {\n      const box = Boxes.boxes[id];\n      for (const c of box.connections || []) {\n        if (c.from_box !== id) continue;\n\n        const src  = Boxes.get_port_world_pos(c.from_box, c.from_output || c.from_port, 'output');\n        const dst  = Boxes.get_port_world_pos(c.to_box,   c.to_input,                   'input');\n        if (!src || !dst) continue;\n\n        const cx0 = src.x + BEZIER_CTRL_OFFSET, cy0 = src.y;\n        const cx1 = dst.x - BEZIER_CTRL_OFFSET, cy1 = dst.y;\n\n        for (let i = 0; i <= HIT_SAMPLES; i++) {\n          const t = i / HIT_SAMPLES;\n          const p = bezier_point(t, src.x, src.y, cx0, cy0, cx1, cy1, dst.x, dst.y);\n          const dx = wx - p.x, dy = wy - p.y;\n          if (dx*dx + dy*dy <= threshold*threshold) return c;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ draw_all\n  function draw_all(ctx, selected_box_id) {\n    let branch_port_index = {};\n\n    for (const id in Boxes.boxes) {\n      const box = Boxes.boxes[id];\n      for (const c of box.connections || []) {\n        if (c.from_box !== id) continue;\n\n        const src = Boxes.get_port_world_pos(c.from_box, c.from_output || c.from_port, 'output');\n        const dst = Boxes.get_port_world_pos(c.to_box,   c.to_input,                   'input');\n        if (!src || !dst) continue;\n\n        // branch boxes get per-port palette colors\n        let color = '#4a6080';\n        if (box.kind === 'branch') {\n          const port_name = c.from_port;\n          if (!branch_port_index[id]) branch_port_index[id] = {};\n          if (branch_port_index[id][port_name] === undefined) {\n            branch_port_index[id][port_name] = Object.keys(branch_port_index[id]).length;\n          }\n          color = PORT_PALETTE[branch_port_index[id][port_name] % PORT_PALETTE.length];\n        }\n\n        const is_selected = _selected_wire &&\n          _selected_wire.from_box    === c.from_box &&\n          _selected_wire.from_output === c.from_output &&\n          _selected_wire.to_box      === c.to_box &&\n          _selected_wire.to_input    === c.to_input;\n\n        draw_bezier(ctx, src.x, src.y, dst.x, dst.y, color, is_selected);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // Handle wire selection via click\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('click', e => {\n    if (e.button !== 0) return;\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    // only try wire hit if no box was hit\n    if (Boxes.hit_test_box(w.x, w.y)) { _selected_wire = null; return; }\n    if (Boxes.hit_test_port(w.x, w.y)) return;\n\n    const wire = hit_test_wire(w.x, w.y, Canvas.cam.zoom);\n    if (wire) {\n      _selected_wire = wire;\n    } else {\n      _selected_wire = null;\n    }\n    Canvas.mark_dirty();\n  });\n\n  // {{{ create_connection\n  // Fetch-before-PUT: read both boxes, add the connection record, write both.\n  async function create_connection(from_box_id, from_port, to_box_id, to_input) {\n    try {\n      const [src_box, dst_box] = await Promise.all([\n        API.get_box(from_box_id),\n        API.get_box(to_box_id),\n      ]);\n\n      const conn = {\n        from_box:    from_box_id,\n        from_output: from_port,\n        to_box:      to_box_id,\n        to_input:    to_input,\n      };\n\n      // if source is a branch box the connection uses from_port not from_output\n      const src_local = Boxes.boxes[from_box_id];\n      if (src_local && src_local.kind === 'branch') {\n        conn.from_port   = from_port;\n        delete conn.from_output;\n      }\n\n      src_box.connections = src_box.connections || [];\n      dst_box.connections = dst_box.connections || [];\n\n      // avoid duplicates\n      const dup = src_box.connections.some(c =>\n        c.from_box === conn.from_box &&\n        (c.from_output || c.from_port) === from_port &&\n        c.to_box === conn.to_box && c.to_input === conn.to_input\n      );\n      if (dup) return;\n\n      src_box.connections.push(conn);\n      dst_box.connections.push(conn);\n\n      await Promise.all([\n        API.put_box(from_box_id, src_box),\n '#ffffff' : color;\n    ctx.lineWidth   = selected ? 2.5 : 1.5;\n    ctx.setLineDash(selected ? [] : []);\n    ctx.stroke();\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ hit_test_wire\n  // Returns the connection record if cursor (wx,wy) is within HIT_THRESHOLD pixels\n  // of any wire, or null. Operates in world space; threshold is adjusted for zoom.\n  function hit_test_wire(wx, wy, zoom) {\n    const threshold = HIT_THRESHOLD_PX / zoom;\n    for (const id in Boxes.boxes) {\n      const box = Boxes.boxes[id];\n      for (const c of box.connections || []) {\n        if (c.from_box !== id) continue;\n\n        const src  = Boxes.get_port_world_pos(c.from_box, c.from_output || c.from_port, bezier_point(t, src.x, src.y, cx0, cy0, cx1, cy1, dst.x, dst.y);\n          const dx = wx - p.x, dy = wy - p.y;\n          if (dx*dx + dy*dy <= threshold*threshold) return c;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ draw_all\n  function draw_all(ctx, selected_box_id) {\n    let branch_port_index = {};\n\n    for (const id in Boxes.boxes) {\n      const box = _selected_wire.from_output === c.from_output &&\n          _selected_wire.to_box      === c.to_box &&\n          _selected_wire.to_input    === c.to_input;\n\n        draw_bezier(ctx, src.x, src.y,       "content":"-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_put_data\nlocal function handle_put_data(client, req, maps_root)\n    local map_name  = req.parts[2]\n    local file_name = req.parts[4]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"data\", file_name .. \".json\")\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    -- validate it's at least valid JSON\n    local _, _, jerr = json.decode(req.body)\n    if jerr then\n        return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid JSON: \" .. tostring(jerr))\n    end\n\n    local ok, werr = write_file_atomic(path, req.body)\n    if not ok then return json_err(client, \"500 Internal Server Error\", tostring(werr)) end\n    json_ok(client, { ok = true })\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_get_simple\n-- Handles GET for single-file resources: drivers.json, meta.json\nlocal function handle_get_simple(client, req, maps_root, filename)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, filename)\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local raw, err = read_file(path)\n    if not raw then return json_err(client, \"404 Not Found\", tostring(err)) end\n    respond(client, \"200 OK\", raw)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_put_simple\nlocal function handle_put_simple(client, req, maps_root, filename, validator)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, filename)\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local obj, _, jerr = json.decode(req.body)\n    if not obj then\n        return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid JSON: \" .. tostring(jerr))\n    end\n\n    if validator then\n        local errs = validator(obj)\n        if #errs > 0 then\n            return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", table.concat(errs, \"; \"))\n        end",

All routing is linear (one output, one wire).\n15\tThere is no mechanism to conditionally fire one box vs. another based on\n16\ta value.\n17\t\n18\t## Intended behavior\n19\t\n20\tA box with \"kind\": \"branch\" has named output ports instead of positional\n21\toutputs. Each port (except \"else\") carries a predicate. The executor\n22\tevaluates each predicate against the input value and fires the first port\n23\twhose predicate is true. Exceeded retry\n47\t      limit is a hard error, not a silent loop.\n48\t\n49\tThe \"retry_vary\" field on a box:\n50\t  \"retry_vary\": { \"temperature\": { \"min\": 0.5, \"max\": 1.2 } }\n51\t  On retry, any field listed here is replaced with a random value in range.\n52\t\n53\t## Suggested implementation steps\n54\t\n55\t1.       "content":"        if not inputs_satisfied(box, store) then\n            goto next_iter\n        end\n\n        if visited[id] and box.kind ~= \"branch\" then\n            goto next_iter\n        end\n        visited[id] = true\n\n        local inputs = collect_inputs(box, store)\n\n        -- branch box is handled specially: it doesn't invoke a driver,\n        -- it routes based on its single input value\n        local outputs, task_err\n        if box.kind == \"branch\" then\n            -- the branch input is the value wired to its single input port\n            local branch_val = inputs[(box.inputs or {})[1] and box.inputs[1].name or \"value\"]\n            outputs = { _branch_input = branch_val }\n            task_err = nil\n        else\n            outputs, task_err = run_task(box, inputs, drivers, map_dir)\n        end\n\n        run_log[id] = {\n            inputs  = inputs,\n            outputs = outputs or {},\n            status  = task_err and \"error\" or \"ok\",\n            error   = task_err,\n        }\n\n        if task_err then\n            map_ok  = false\n            map_err = task_err\n            io.stderr:write(\"executor: \" .. task_err .. \"\\n\")\n            break\n        end\n\n        -- fire connections and enqueue newly-ready boxes\n        local signal = fire_connections(box, outputs, store, queue, boxes, retry_counts)\n        if signal == \"retry\" then\n            -- unwired else: find the immediate upstream box and re-queue it\n            -- retry_vary is applied in run_task on the next invocation\n            local max_retries = box.retry_limit or 3\n            retry_counts[id] = (retry_counts[id] or 0) + 1\n            if retry_counts[id] > max_retries then\n                map_ok  = false\n                map_err = \"branch box '\" .. id .. \"' exceeded retry limit (\" ..\n                    max_retries .. \")\"\n                break\n            end\n            -- find the box that wired into this branch box and re-queue it\n            for src_id, src_box in pairs(boxes) do\n                for _, c in ipairs(src_box.connections or {}) do\n                    if c.from_box == src_id and c.to_box == id then\n                        visited[src_id] = nil\n                        queue[#queue + 1] = src_id\n                    end\n                end\n            end\n        end",

others require one\n    if port.name == nil then\n        err(errors, \"port[\" .. i .. \"] missing 'name'\")\n        return\n    end\n    if port.name == \"else\" then return end\n    if port.predicate == nil then\n        err(errors, \"port '\" .. port.name .. \"' missing predicate (only 'else' may omit it)\")\n        return\n    end\n    local p = port.predicate\n    if p.op == nil then\n        err(errors, \"port '\" .. port.name .. \"' predicate missing 'op'\")\n    elseif not valid_ops[p.op] then\n        err(errors, \"port '\" .. port.name .. \"' predicate has unknown op '\" .. p.op .. \"'\")\n    end\n    if p.value == nil then\n        err(errors, \"port '\" .. port.name .. \"' predicate missing 'value'\")\n    end\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ validate_connection\nlocal function validate_connection(c, i, errors)\n    -- all four fields must be present; both endpoint files store the same record\n    if c.from_box == nil then\n        err(errors, \"connection[\" .. i .. \"] missing 'from_box'\")\n    end\n    if c.from_output == nil then\n        err(errors, \"connection[\" .. i .. \"] missing 'from_output'\")\n    end\n    if c.to_box == nil then\n        err(errors, \"connection[\" .. i .. \"] missing 'to_box'\")\n    end\n    if c.to_input == nil then\n        err(errors, \"connection[\" .. i .. \"] missing 'to_input'\")\n    end\nend\n-- }}}\n\n--
