}\n\n.add-port {\n  background: none;\n  border: 1px dashed #3a3f55;\n  border-radius: 3px;\n  color: #6c72a0;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-family: monospace;\n  font-size: 10px;\n  padding: 3px 6px;\n  margin-top: 3px;\n}\n.add-port:hover { border-color: #4a9eff; color: #4a9eff; }\n\n.branch-port-row { flex-wrap: wrap; }\n\n/* Status bar */\n#status-bar {\n  position: absolute;\n  bottom: 8px;\n  left: 12px;\n  right: 12px;\n  pointer-events: none;\n}\n\n.status {\n  display: inline-block;\n  font-size: 10px;\n  padding: 3px 8px;\n  border-radius: 3px;\n  background: #1e2130cc;\n  color: #9ea3c0;\n}\n.status.error { color: #e91e63; }\n\n/* Toolbar */\n#toolbar {\n  position: absolute;\n  top: 8px;\n  left: 12px;\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 6px;\n}\n\n.toolbar-btn {\n  background: #181c28;\n  border: 1px solid #2a2f45;\n  border-radius: 4px;\n  color: #9ea3c0;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-family: monospace;\n  font-size: 10px;\n  padding: 4px 10px;\n}\n.toolbar-btn:hover { border-color: #4a9eff; color: #4a9eff; }\n</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n\n<div id=\"canvas-wrap\">\n  <canvas id=\"canvas\"></canvas>\n  <div id=\"toolbar\">\n    <button class=\"toolbar-btn\" onclick=\"App.load_map()\">reload</button>\n    <button class=\"toolbar-btn\" onclick=\"localStorage.clear(); location.reload()\">switch map</button>\n  </div>\n  <div id=\"status-bar\">\n    <span id=\"status\" class=\"status\">starting…</span>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<div id=\"sidebar\">\n  <div id=\"sidebar-header\">\n    <h2>SoraMech</h2>\n    <span id=\"map-label\"></span>\n  </div>\n  <div id=\"inspector\" class=\"hidden\">\n    <div id=\"inspector-title\"></div>\n    <div id=\"inspector-fields\"></div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<script src=\"js/001-canvas.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"js/002-boxes.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"js/003-api.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"js/004-inspector.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"js/006-wires.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"js/005-app.js\"></script>\n</body>\n</html>\n```\n\n## js/001-canvas.js\n\n```javascript\n// Camera state and canvas management.\n// Owns pan/zoom, the render loop, and coordinate conversion.\n\nconst Canvas = (() => {\n  const el  = document.getElementById('canvas');\n  const ctx = el.getContext('2d');\n\n  const cam = { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 };\n  let dirty = true;\n  let dragging_cam = false;\n  let drag_start   = null;\n\n  // {{{ resize\n  function resize() {\n    el.width  = window.innerWidth  - (document.getElementById('sidebar').offsetWidth || 0);\n    el.height = window.innerHeight;\n    dirty = true;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ world_to_screen\n  function world_to_screen(wx, wy) {\n    return {\n      x: (wx + cam.x) * cam.zoom,\n      y: (wy + cam.y) * cam.zoom,\n    };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ screen_to_world\n  function screen_to_world(sx, sy) {\n    return {\n      x: sx / cam.zoom - cam.x,\n      y: sy / cam.zoom - cam.y,\n    };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mark_dirty\n  function mark_dirty() { dirty = true; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ start_frame\n  // Called by the render loop; returns true if a redraw is needed.\n  function start_frame() {\n    if (!dirty) return false;\n    dirty = false;\n    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, el.width, el.height);\n    ctx.save();\n    ctx.scale(cam.zoom, cam.zoom);\n    ctx.translate(cam.x, cam.y);\n    return true;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ end_frame\n  function end_frame() { ctx.restore(); }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mouse_pos\n  function mouse_pos(e) {\n    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // Panning via middle-mouse or space+drag\n  let space_down = false;\n  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') space_down = true; });\n  window.addEventListener('keyup',   e => { if (e.code === 'Space') space_down = false; });\n\n  el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {\n    if (e.button === 1 || (e.button === 0 && space_down)) {\n      dragging_cam = true;\n      drag_start   = { x: e.clientX - cam.x * cam.zoom,\n                       y: e.clientY - cam.y * cam.zoom };\n      e.preventDefault();\n    }\n  });\n\n  window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {\n    if (dragging_cam && drag_start) {\n      cam.x = (e.clientX - drag_start.x) / cam.zoom;\n      cam.y = (e.clientY - drag_start.y) / cam.zoom;\n      mark_dirty();\n    }\n  });\n\n  window.addEventListener('mouseup', e => {\n    if (e.button === 1 || e.button === 0) dragging_cam = false;\n  });\n\n  // Zoom via scroll wheel\n  el.addEventListener('wheel', e => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const m   = mouse_pos(e);\n    const wbefore = screen_to_world(m.x, m.y);\n    const factor  = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9;\n    cam.zoom = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(5, cam.zoom * factor));\n    const wafter = screen_to_world(m.x, m.y);\n    cam.x += wafter.x - wbefore.x;\n    cam.y += wafter.y - wbefore.y;\n    mark_dirty();\n  }, { passive: false });\n\n  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);\n  resize();\n\n  return { el, ctx, cam, world_to_screen, screen_to_world, mark_dirty,\n           start_frame, end_frame, mouse_pos };\n})();\n```\n\n## js/002-boxes.js\n\n```javascript\n// Box rendering, layout, and hit testing.\n// Each box knows its world-space position; the camera transform is applied by the canvas.\n\nconst Boxes = (() => {\n  const BOX_W         = 180;\n  const BOX_HEADER    = 36;\n  const PORT_ROW_H    = 22;\n  const PORT_R        = 6;   // port dot radius in world units\n  const MIN_BOX_H     = 80;\n\n  const KIND_COLOR = { call: '#4a9eff', branch: '#ff8c42', data: '#4caf7d' };\n\n  // boxes: { [id]: box_data }\n  let boxes = {};\n\n  // {{{ box_height\n  function box_height(box) {\n    const n = Math.max(\n      (box.inputs || []).length,\n      (box.kind === 'branch' ? (box.ports || []).length : (box.outputs || []).length)\n    );\n    return Math.max(MIN_BOX_H, BOX_HEADER + n * PORT_ROW_H + 8);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ port_positions\n  // Returns world-space {x,y} for each port dot on a box.\n  function port_positions(box) {\n    const bx = box.ui?.x ?? 0;\n    const by = box.ui?.y ?? 0;\n    const h  = box_height(box);\n    const inputs  = box.inputs  || [];\n    const outputs = box.kind === 'branch' ? (box.ports || []) : (box.outputs || []);\n\n    const in_pts  = inputs.map((p, i) => ({\n      name: p.name, side: 'input',\n      x: bx,\n      y: by + BOX_HEADER + PORT_ROW_H * i + PORT_ROW_H / 2,\n    }));\n    const out_pts = outputs.map((p, i) => ({\n      name: p.name, side: 'output',\n      x: bx + BOX_W,\n      y: by + BOX_HEADER + PORT_ROW_H * i + PORT_ROW_H / 2,\n    }));\n    return { inputs: in_pts, outputs: out_pts };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ draw_box\n  function draw_box(ctx, box, selected) {\n    const x = box.ui?.x ?? 0;\n    const y = box.ui?.y ?? 0;\n    const w = BOX_W;\n    const h = box_height(box);\n    const kind  = box.kind || 'call';\n    const color = KIND_COLOR[kind] || '#888';\n\n    // shadow when selected\n    if (selected) {\n      ctx.shadowColor = color;\n      ctx.shadowBlur  = 12;\n    }\n\n    // body\n    ctx.fillStyle   = '#1e2130';\n    ctx.strokeStyle = selected ? color : '#3a3f55';\n    ctx.lineWidth   = selected ? 2 : 1;\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 6);\n    ctx.fill();\n    ctx.stroke();\n\n    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;\n\n    // header bar\n    ctx.fillStyle = color + '33';\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, BOX_HEADER, [6, 6, 0, 0]);\n    ctx.fill();\n\n    // label\n    ctx.fillStyle  = '#e8eaf6';\n    ctx.font       = 'bold 12px monospace';\n    ctx.textAlign  = 'left';\n    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n    ctx.fillText(box.label || box.id, x + 10, y + BOX_HEADER / 2);\n\n    // kind badge (top right)\n    ctx.fillStyle  = color;\n    ctx.font       = '9px monospace';\n    ctx.textAlign  = 'right';\n    ctx.fillText(kind.toUpperCase(), x + w - 8, y + BOX_HEADER / 2);\n\n    // port dots and labels\n    const { inputs: in_pts, outputs: out_pts } = port_positions(box);\n\n    ctx.font      = '10px monospace';\n    ctx.fillStyle = '#9ea3c0';\n\n    in_pts.forEach((p, i) => {\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, PORT_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n      ctx.fillStyle   = '#2d3250';\n      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6c72a0';\n      ctx.lineWidth   = 1.5;\n      ctx.fill();\n      ctx.stroke();\n\n      ctx.fillStyle  = '#9ea3c0';\n      ctx.textAlign  = 'left';\n      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n      ctx.fillText(p.name, p.x + PORT_R + 4, p.y);\n    });\n\n    // branch ports use palette colors\n    const port_palette = ['#ff8c42','#4a9eff','#4caf7d','#e91e63','#9c27b0','#00bcd4'];\n    out_pts.forEach((p, i) => {\n      const dot_color = (box.kind === 'branch') ? port_palette[i % port_palette.length] : color;\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, PORT_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n      ctx.fillStyle   = dot_color + '44';\n      ctx.strokeStyle = dot_color;\n      ctx.lineWidth   = 1.5;\n      ctx.fill();\n      ctx.stroke();\n\n      ctx.fillStyle  = '#9ea3c0';\n      ctx.textAlign  = 'right';\n      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n      ctx.fillText(p.name, p.x - PORT_R - 4, p.y);\n    });\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ draw_all\n  function draw_all(ctx, selected_id) {\n    for (const id in boxes) {\n      draw_box(ctx, boxes[id], id === selected_id);\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ hit_test_port\n  // Returns {box_id, port_name, side, x, y} for the port under world point (wx,wy), or null.\n  function hit_test_port(wx, wy) {\n    for (const id in boxes) {\n      const { inputs, outputs } = port_positions(boxes[id]);\n      for (const p of [...inputs, ...outputs]) {\n        const dx = wx - p.x, dy = wy - p.y;\n        if (dx*dx + dy*dy <= (PORT_R + 4) * (PORT_R + 4)) {\n          return { box_id: id, port_name: p.name, side: p.side, x: p.x, y: p.y };\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ hit_test_box\n  // Returns box id if (wx,wy) is inside a box body, or null.\n  function hit_test_box(wx, wy) {\n    for (const id in boxes) {\n      const b = boxes[id];\n      const x = b.ui?.x ?? 0, y = b.ui?.y ?? 0;\n      if (wx >= x && wx <= x + BOX_W && wy >= y && wy <= y + box_height(b)) return id;\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_port_world_pos\n  function get_port_world_pos(box_id, port_name, side) {\n    const box = boxes[box_id];\n    if (!box) return null;\n    const { inputs, outputs } = port_positions(box);\n    const list = side === 'input' ? inputs : outputs;\n    const p = list.find(p => p.name === port_name);\n    return p ? { x: p.x, y: p.y } : null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return {\n    boxes, BOX_W, BOX_HEADER, PORT_R,\n    box_height, port_positions,\n    draw_all, draw_box, hit_test_port, hit_test_box, get_port_world_pos,\n  };\n})();\n```\n\n## js/003-api.js\n\n```javascript\n// Thin fetch wrapper for the soramech-server REST API.\n// All functions are async and throw on non-2xx responses.\n\nconst API = (() => {\n  let base_url = '';\n  let map_name = '';\n\n  // {{{ init\n  function init(url, name) { base_url = url.replace(/\\/$/, ''); map_name = name; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ request\n  async function request(method, path, body) {\n    const opts = { method, headers: {} };\n    if (body !== undefined) {\n      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';\n      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);\n    }\n    const res = await fetch(base_url + path, opts);\n    const text = await res.text();\n    let data;\n    try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { data = { error: text }; }\n    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);\n    return data;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_maps\n  async function list_maps() { return request('GET', '/maps'); }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_boxes\n  async function list_boxes() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_box\n  async function get_box(id) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_box\n  async function put_box(id, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ delete_box\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    return request('DELETE', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_meta\n  async function get_meta() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_meta\n  async function put_meta(data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_data\n  async function get_data(filename) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_data\n  async function put_data(filename, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { init, list_maps, list_boxes, get_box, put_box, delete_box,\n           get_meta, put_meta, get_data, put_data };\n})();\n```\n\n## js/004-inspector.js\n\n```javascript\n// Inspector sidebar: shows and edits the selected box's fields.\n// Fires PUT to the server on every field change (autosave).\n\nconst Inspector = (() => {\n  const panel  = document.getElementById('inspector');\n  const title  = document.getElementById('inspector-title');\n  const fields = document.getElementById('inspector-fields');\n\n  let current_box = null;\n  let on_change_cb = null;\n\n  // {{{ hide\n  function hide() {\n    panel.classList.add('hidden');\n    current_box = null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ save\n  async function save() {\n    if (!current_box) return;\n    try {\n      await API.put_box(current_box.id, current_box);\n      if (on_change_cb) on_change_cb(current_box);\n    } catch(e) {\n      console.error('autosave failed:', e.message);\n      status_msg('save error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_row\n  function mk_row(label_text, input_el) {\n    const row = document.createElement('div');\n    row.className = 'field-row';\n    const lbl = document.createElement('label');\n    lbl.textContent = label_text;\n    row.appendChild(lbl);\n    row.appendChild(input_el);\n    return row;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_text_input\n  function mk_text_input(value, on_input) {\n    const inp = document.createElement('input');\n    inp.type  = 'text';\n    inp.value = value || '';\n    inp.addEventListener('input', () => { on_input(inp.value); save(); });\n    return inp;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_port_list\n  function mk_port_list(ports, on_change) {\n    const wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    wrap.className = 'port-list';\n\n    const render_ports = () => {\n      wrap.innerHTML = '';\n      ports.forEach((p, i) => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className = 'port-row';\n\n        const name_inp = document.createElement('input');\n        name_inp.type  = 'text';\n        name_inp.value = p.name || '';\n        name_inp.placeholder = 'name';\n        name_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].name = name_inp.value; on_change(); save(); });\n\n        const type_inp = document.createElement('input');\n        type_inp.type  = 'text';\n        type_inp.value = p.type || '';\n        type_inp.placeholder = 'type';\n        type_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].type = type_inp.value; on_change(); save(); });\n\n        const del_btn = document.createElement('button');\n        del_btn.textContent = '×';\n        del_btn.className   = 'port-del';\n        del_btn.addEventListener('click', () => { ports.splice(i, 1); render_ports(); on_change(); save(); });\n\n        row.appendChild(name_inp);\n        row.appendChild(type_inp);\n        row.appendChild(del_btn);\n        wrap.appendChild(row);\n      });\n\n      const add_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      add_btn.textContent = '+ port';\n      add_btn.className   = 'add-port';\n      add_btn.addEventListener('click', () => {\n        ports.push({ name: '', type: 'string' });\n        render_ports();\n        on_change();\n        save();\n      });\n      wrap.appendChild(add_btn);\n    };\n\n    render_ports();\n    return wrap;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_branch_port_list\n  function mk_branch_port_list(ports, on_change) {\n    const OPS = ['eq','lt','gt','lte','gte','contains','matches'];\n    const wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    wrap.className = 'port-list';\n\n    const render_ports = () => {\n      wrap.innerHTML = '';\n      ports.forEach((p, i) => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className = 'port-row branch-port-row';\n\n        const name_inp = document.createElement('input');\n        name_inp.type  = 'text';\n        name_inp.value = p.name || '';\n        name_inp.placeholder = 'port name';\n        name_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].name = name_inp.value; on_change(); save(); });\n        row.appendChild(name_inp);\n\n        if (p.name !== 'else') {\n          if (!p.predicate) p.predicate = { op: 'eq', value: '' };\n\n          const op_sel = document.createElement('select');\n          OPS.forEach(op => {\n            const opt = document.createElement('option');\n            opt.value = op; opt.textContent = op;\n            if (op === p.predicate.op) opt.selected = true;\n            op_sel.appendChild(opt);\n          });\n          op_sel.addEventListener('change', () => { ports[i].predicate.op = op_sel.value; save(); });\n\n          const val_inp = document.createElement('input');\n          val_inp.type  = 'text';\n          val_inp.value = p.predicate.value ?? '';\n          val_inp.placeholder = 'value';\n          val_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].predicate.value = val_inp.value; save(); });\n\n          row.appendChild(op_sel);\n          row.appendChild(val_inp);\n        }\n\n        // can't delete the else port\n        if (p.name !== 'else') {\n          const del_btn = document.createElement('button');\n          del_btn.textContent = '×';\n          del_btn.className   = 'port-del';\n          del_btn.addEventListener('click', () => { ports.splice(i, 1); render_ports(); on_change(); save(); });\n          row.appendChild(del_btn);\n        }\n\n        wrap.appendChild(row);\n      });\n\n      const add_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      add_btn.textContent = '+ port';\n      add_btn.className   = 'add-port';\n      add_btn.addEventListener('click', () => {\n        // insert before else\n        const else_i = ports.findIndex(p => p.name === 'else');\n        const new_port = { name: '', predicate: { op: 'eq', value: '' } };\n        if (else_i >= 0) ports.splice(else_i, 0, new_port);\n        else ports.push(new_port);\n        render_ports(); on_change(); save();\n      });\n      wrap.appendChild(add_btn);\n    };\n\n    render_ports();\n    return wrap;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ show\n  function show(box, on_changed) {\n    current_box  = box;\n    on_change_cb = on_changed;\n    panel.classList.remove('hidden');\n    title.textContent = box.id;\n    fields.innerHTML  = '';\n\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('label',\n      mk_text_input(box.label, v => { current_box.label = v; })));\n\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('kind', (() => {\n      const sel = document.createElement('select');\n      ['call','branch','data'].forEach(k => {\n        const opt = document.createElement('option');\n        opt.value = k; opt.textContent = k;\n        if (k === box.kind) opt.selected = true;\n        sel.appendChild(opt);\n      });\n      sel.addEventListener('change', () => { current_box.kind = sel.value; show(current_box, on_change_cb); save(); });\n      return sel;\n    })()));\n\n    if (box.kind === 'call' || box.kind === 'data') {\n      fields.appendChild(mk_row('ref',\n        mk_text_input(box.ref, v => { current_box.ref = v; })));\n      fields.appendChild(mk_row('fn',\n        mk_text_input(box.fn, v => { current_box.fn = v; })));\n    }\n\n    const inputs_sec = document.createElement('div');\n    inputs_sec.className = 'section-label';\n    inputs_sec.textContent = 'inputs';\n    fields.appendChild(inputs_sec);\n    if (!current_box.inputs) current_box.inputs = [];\n    fields.appendChild(mk_port_list(current_box.inputs, () => {}));\n\n    if (box.kind === };\n})();\n```\n\n---\n\n## Summary of what the editor currently does:\n\nThe SoraMech editor is a visual node/box editor with the following capabilities:\n\n**Canvas & Navigation:**\n- Pan via middle-mouse or Space+drag\n- Zoom via scroll wheel\n- Responsive canvas that resizes with window\n\n**Boxes (Nodes):**\n- Three box types: \"call\" (blue), \"branch\" (orange), \"data\" (green)\n- Each box has configurable inputs, outputs, and metadata (label, ref, fn)\n- Branch boxes have special \"ports\" instead of outputs, each with an operator (eq, lt, gt, lte, gte, contains, matches) and predicate value\n- Double-click empty canvas to create new box at that location\n- Click box to select and open inspector\n- Drag selected box to move it\n- Delete/Backspace key removes selected box (with confirmation if it has outgoing connections)\n\n**Wires (Connections):**\n- Click and drag from output port to input port to create connection\n- Wires render as bezier curves with colors:\n  - Gray for normal call/data boxes\n  - Palette-colored for branch boxes (each port gets a unique color)\n- Click on wire to select it\n- Delete/Backspace on selected wire to remove connection\n\n**Inspector Sidebar:**\n- Shows selected box's properties\n- Edit label, kind (call/branch/data), ref, fn\n- Add/remove inputs and outputs with name and type\n- Branch boxes show predicate operators and values with \"else\" port\n- All changes auto-save to server via API\n\n**API Integration:**\n- Connects to a REST backend (server URL and map name via localStorage)\n- All box and connection changes persist immediately\n- Two buttons: \"reload\" (refresh boxes from server) and \"switch map\" (clear storage and reload)"

color: #4a9eff; }\n</style>\n</head>\n<body>\n\n<div id=\"canvas-wrap\">\n  <canvas id=\"canvas\"></canvas>\n  <div id=\"toolbar\">\n    <button class=\"toolbar-btn\" onclick=\"App.load_map()\">reload</button>\n    <button class=\"toolbar-btn\" onclick=\"localStorage.clear(); location.reload()\">switch map</button>\n  </div>\n  <div id=\"status-bar\">\n    <span id=\"status\" class=\"status\">starting…</span>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<div id=\"sidebar\">\n  <div id=\"sidebar-header\">\n    <h2>SoraMech</h2>\n    <span id=\"map-label\"></span>\n  </div>\n  <div id=\"inspector\" class=\"hidden\">\n    <div id=\"inspector-title\"></div>\n    <div id=\"inspector-fields\"></div>\n  </div>\n</div>\n\n<script src=\"js/001-canvas.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"js/002-boxes.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"js/003-api.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"js/004-inspector.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"js/006-wires.js\"></script>\n<script src=\"js/005-app.js\"></script>\n</body>\n</html>\n```\n\n## js/001-canvas.js\n\n```javascript\n// Camera state and canvas management.\n// Owns pan/zoom, the render loop, and coordinate conversion.\n\nconst Canvas = (() => {\n  const el  = document.getElementById('canvas');\n  const ctx = el.getContext('2d');\n\n  const cam = { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 };\n  let dirty = true;\n  let dragging_cam = false;\n  let drag_start   = null;\n\n  // {{{ resize\n  function resize() {\n    el.width  = window.innerWidth  - (document.getElementById('sidebar').offsetWidth || 0);\n    el.height = window.innerHeight;\n    dirty = true;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ world_to_screen\n  function world_to_screen(wx, wy) {\n    return {\n      x: (wx + cam.x) * cam.zoom,\n      y: (wy + cam.y) * cam.zoom,\n    };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ screen_to_world\n  function screen_to_world(sx, sy) {\n    return {\n      x: sx / cam.zoom - cam.x,\n      y: sy / cam.zoom - cam.y,\n    };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mark_dirty\n  function mark_dirty() { dirty = true; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ start_frame\n  // Called by the render loop; returns true if a redraw is needed.\n  function start_frame() {\n    if (!dirty) return false;\n    dirty = false;\n    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, el.width, el.height);\n    ctx.save();\n    ctx.scale(cam.zoom, cam.zoom);\n    ctx.translate(cam.x, cam.y);\n    return true;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ end_frame\n  function end_frame() { ctx.restore(); }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mouse_pos\n  function mouse_pos(e) {\n    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();\n    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // Panning via middle-mouse or space+drag\n  let space_down = false;\n  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') space_down = true; });\n  window.addEventListener('keyup',   e => { if (e.code === 'Space') space_down = false; });\n\n  el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {\n    if (e.button === 1 || (e.button === 0 && space_down)) {\n      dragging_cam = true;\n      drag_start   = { x: e.clientX - cam.x * cam.zoom,\n                       y: e.clientY - cam.y * cam.zoom };\n      e.preventDefault();\n    }\n  });\n\n  window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {\n    if (dragging_cam && drag_start) {\n      cam.x = (e.clientX - drag_start.x) / cam.zoom;\n      cam.y = (e.clientY - drag_start.y) / cam.zoom;\n      mark_dirty();\n    }\n  });\n\n  window.addEventListener('mouseup', e => {\n    if (e.button === 1 || e.button === 0) dragging_cam = false;\n  });\n\n  // Zoom via scroll wheel\n  el.addEventListener('wheel', e => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const m   = mouse_pos(e);\n    const wbefore = screen_to_world(m.x, m.y);\n    const factor  = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9;\n    cam.zoom = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(5, cam.zoom * factor));\n    const wafter = screen_to_world(m.x, m.y);\n    cam.x += wafter.x - wbefore.x;\n    cam.y += wafter.y - wbefore.y;\n    mark_dirty();\n  }, { passive: false });\n\n  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);\n  resize();\n\n  return { el, ctx, cam, world_to_screen, screen_to_world, mark_dirty,\n           start_frame, end_frame, mouse_pos };\n})();\n```\n\n## js/002-boxes.js\n\n```javascript\n// Box rendering, layout, and hit testing.\n// Each box knows its world-space position; the camera transform is applied by the canvas.\n\nconst Boxes = (() => {\n  const BOX_W         = 180;\n  const BOX_HEADER    = 36;\n  const PORT_ROW_H    = 22;\n  const PORT_R        = 6;   // port dot radius in world units\n  const MIN_BOX_H     = 80;\n\n  const KIND_COLOR = { call: '#4a9eff', branch: '#ff8c42', data: '#4caf7d' };\n\n  // boxes: { [id]: box_data }\n  let boxes = {};\n\n  // {{{ box_height\n  function box_height(box) {\n    const n = Math.max(\n      (box.inputs || []).length,\n      (box.kind === 'branch' ? (box.ports || []).length : (box.outputs || []).length)\n    );\n    return Math.max(MIN_BOX_H, BOX_HEADER + n * PORT_ROW_H + 8);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ port_positions\n  // Returns world-space {x,y} for each port dot on a box.\n  function port_positions(box) {\n    const bx = box.ui?.x ?? 0;\n    const by = box.ui?.y ?? 0;\n    const h  = box_height(box);\n    const inputs  = box.inputs  || [];\n    const outputs = box.kind === 'branch' ? (box.ports || []) : (box.outputs || []);\n\n    const in_pts  = inputs.map((p, i) => ({\n      name: p.name, side: 'input',\n      x: bx,\n      y: by + BOX_HEADER + PORT_ROW_H * i + PORT_ROW_H / 2,\n    }));\n    const out_pts = outputs.map((p, i) => ({\n      name: p.name, side: 'output',\n      x: bx + BOX_W,\n      y: by + BOX_HEADER + PORT_ROW_H * i + PORT_ROW_H / 2,\n    }));\n    return { inputs: in_pts, outputs: out_pts };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ draw_box\n  function draw_box(ctx, box, selected) {\n    const x = box.ui?.x ?? 0;\n    const y = box.ui?.y ?? 0;\n    const w = BOX_W;\n    const h = box_height(box);\n    const kind  = box.kind || 'call';\n    const color = KIND_COLOR[kind] || '#888';\n\n    // shadow when selected\n    if (selected) {\n      ctx.shadowColor = color;\n      ctx.shadowBlur  = 12;\n    }\n\n    // body\n    ctx.fillStyle   = '#1e2130';\n    ctx.strokeStyle = selected ? color : '#3a3f55';\n    ctx.lineWidth   = selected ? 2 : 1;\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, h, 6);\n    ctx.fill();\n    ctx.stroke();\n\n    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;\n\n    // header bar\n    ctx.fillStyle = color + '33';\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.roundRect(x, y, w, BOX_HEADER, [6, 6, 0, 0]);\n    ctx.fill();\n\n    // label\n    ctx.fillStyle  = '#e8eaf6';\n    ctx.font       = 'bold 12px monospace';\n    ctx.textAlign  = 'left';\n    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n    ctx.fillText(box.label || box.id, x + 10, y + BOX_HEADER / 2);\n\n    // kind badge (top right)\n    ctx.fillStyle  = color;\n    ctx.font       = '9px monospace';\n    ctx.textAlign  = 'right';\n    ctx.fillText(kind.toUpperCase(), x + w - 8, y + BOX_HEADER / 2);\n\n    // port dots and labels\n    const { inputs: in_pts, outputs: out_pts } = port_positions(box);\n\n    ctx.font      = '10px monospace';\n    ctx.fillStyle = '#9ea3c0';\n\n    in_pts.forEach((p, i) => {\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, PORT_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n      ctx.fillStyle   = '#2d3250';\n      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6c72a0';\n      ctx.lineWidth   = 1.5;\n      ctx.fill();\n      ctx.stroke();\n\n      ctx.fillStyle  = '#9ea3c0';\n      ctx.textAlign  = 'left';\n      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n      ctx.fillText(p.name, p.x + PORT_R + 4, p.y);\n    });\n\n    // branch ports use palette colors\n    const port_palette = ['#ff8c42','#4a9eff','#4caf7d','#e91e63','#9c27b0','#00bcd4'];\n    out_pts.forEach((p, i) => {\n      const dot_color = (box.kind === 'branch') ? port_palette[i % port_palette.length] : color;\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, PORT_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n      ctx.fillStyle   = dot_color + '44';\n      ctx.strokeStyle = dot_color;\n      ctx.lineWidth   = 1.5;\n      ctx.fill();\n      ctx.stroke();\n\n      ctx.fillStyle  = '#9ea3c0';\n      ctx.textAlign  = 'right';\n      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';\n      ctx.fillText(p.name, p.x - PORT_R - 4, p.y);\n    });\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ draw_all\n  function draw_all(ctx, selected_id) {\n    for (const id in boxes) {\n      draw_box(ctx, boxes[id], id === selected_id);\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ hit_test_port\n  // Returns {box_id, port_name, side, x, y} for the port under world point (wx,wy), or null.\n  function hit_test_port(wx, wy) {\n    for (const id in boxes) {\n      const { inputs, outputs } = port_positions(boxes[id]);\n      for (const p of [...inputs, ...outputs]) {\n        const dx = wx - p.x, dy = wy - p.y;\n        if (dx*dx + dy*dy <= (PORT_R + 4) * (PORT_R + 4)) {\n          return { box_id: id, port_name: p.name, side: p.side, x: p.x, y: p.y };\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ hit_test_box\n  // Returns box id if (wx,wy) is inside a box body, or null.\n  function hit_test_box(wx, wy) {\n    for (const id in boxes) {\n      const b = boxes[id];\n      const x = b.ui?.x ?? 0, y = b.ui?.y ?? 0;\n      if (wx >= x && wx <= x + BOX_W && wy >= y && wy <= y + box_height(b)) return id;\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_port_world_pos\n  function get_port_world_pos(box_id, port_name, side) {\n    const box = boxes[box_id];\n    if (!box) return null;\n    const { inputs, outputs } = port_positions(box);\n    const list = side === 'input' ? inputs : outputs;\n    const p = list.find(p => p.name === port_name);\n    return p ? { x: p.x, y: p.y } : null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return {\n    boxes, BOX_W, BOX_HEADER, PORT_R,\n    box_height, port_positions,\n    draw_all, draw_box, hit_test_port, hit_test_box, get_port_world_pos,\n  };\n})();\n```\n\n## js/003-api.js\n\n```javascript\n// Thin fetch wrapper for the soramech-server REST API.\n// All functions are async and throw on non-2xx responses.\n\nconst API = (() => {\n  let base_url = '';\n  let map_name = '';\n\n  // {{{ init\n  function init(url, name) { base_url = url.replace(/\\/$/, ''); map_name = name; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ request\n  async function request(method, path, body) {\n    const opts = { method, headers: {} };\n    if (body !== undefined) {\n      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';\n      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);\n    }\n    const res = await fetch(base_url + path, opts);\n    const text = await res.text();\n    let data;\n    try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { data = { error: text }; }\n    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);\n    return data;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_maps\n  async function list_maps() { return request('GET', '/maps'); }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_boxes\n  async function list_boxes() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_box\n  async function get_box(id) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_box\n  async function put_box(id, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ delete_box\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    return request('DELETE', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_meta\n  async function get_meta() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_meta\n  async function put_meta(data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_data\n  async function get_data(filename) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_data\n  async function put_data(filename, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { init, list_maps, list_boxes, get_box, put_box, delete_box,\n           get_meta, put_meta, get_data, put_data };\n})();\n```\n\n## js/004-inspector.js\n\n```javascript\n// Inspector sidebar: shows and edits the selected box's fields.\n// Fires PUT to the server on every field change (autosave).\n\nconst Inspector = (() => {\n  const panel  = document.getElementById('inspector');\n  const title  = document.getElementById('inspector-title');\n  const fields = document.getElementById('inspector-fields');\n\n  let current_box = null;\n  let on_change_cb = null;\n\n  // {{{ hide\n  function hide() {\n    panel.classList.add('hidden');\n    current_box = null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ save\n  async function save() {\n    if (!current_box) return;\n    try {\n      await API.put_box(current_box.id, current_box);\n      if (on_change_cb) on_change_cb(current_box);\n    } catch(e) {\n      console.error('autosave failed:', e.message);\n      status_msg('save error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_row\n  function mk_row(label_text, input_el) {\n    const row = document.createElement('div');\n    row.className = 'field-row';\n    const lbl = document.createElement('label');\n    lbl.textContent = label_text;\n    row.appendChild(lbl);\n    row.appendChild(input_el);\n    return row;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_text_input\n  function mk_text_input(value, on_input) {\n    const inp = document.createElement('input');\n    inp.type  = 'text';\n    inp.value = value || '';\n    inp.addEventListener('input', () => { on_input(inp.value); save(); });\n    return inp;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_port_list\n  function mk_port_list(ports, on_change) {\n    const wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    wrap.className = 'port-list';\n\n    const render_ports = () => {\n      wrap.innerHTML = '';\n      ports.forEach((p, i) => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className = 'port-row';\n\n        const name_inp = document.createElement('input');\n        name_inp.type  = 'text';\n        name_inp.value = p.name || '';\n        name_inp.placeholder = 'name';\n        name_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].name = name_inp.value; on_change(); save(); });\n\n        const type_inp = document.createElement('input');\n        type_inp.type  = 'text';\n        type_inp.value = p.type || '';\n        type_inp.placeholder = 'type';\n        type_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].type = type_inp.value; on_change(); save(); });\n\n        const del_btn = document.createElement('button');\n        del_btn.textContent = '×';\n        del_btn.className   = 'port-del';\n        del_btn.addEventListener('click', () => { ports.splice(i, 1); render_ports(); on_change(); save(); });\n\n        row.appendChild(name_inp);\n        row.appendChild(type_inp);\n        row.appendChild(del_btn);\n        wrap.appendChild(row);\n      });\n\n      const add_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      add_btn.textContent = '+ port';\n      add_btn.className   = 'add-port';\n      add_btn.addEventListener('click', () => {\n        ports.push({ name: '', type: 'string' });\n        render_ports();\n        on_change();\n        save();\n      });\n      wrap.appendChild(add_btn);\n    };\n\n    render_ports();\n    return wrap;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_branch_port_list\n  function mk_branch_port_list(ports, on_change) {\n    const OPS = ['eq','lt','gt','lte','gte','contains','matches'];\n    const wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    wrap.className = 'port-list';\n\n    const render_ports = () => {\n      wrap.innerHTML = '';\n      ports.forEach((p, i) => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className = 'port-row branch-port-row';\n\n        const name_inp = document.createElement('input');\n        name_inp.type  = 'text';\n        name_inp.value = p.name || '';\n        name_inp.placeholder = 'port name';\n        name_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].name = name_inp.value; on_change(); save(); });\n        row.appendChild(name_inp);\n\n        if (p.name !== 'else') {\n          if (!p.predicate) p.predicate = { op: 'eq', value: '' };\n\n          const op_sel = document.createElement('select');\n          OPS.forEach(op => {\n            const opt = document.createElement('option');\n            opt.value = op; opt.textContent = op;\n            if (op === p.predicate.op) opt.selected = true;\n            op_sel.appendChild(opt);\n          });\n          op_sel.addEventListener('change', () => { ports[i].predicate.op = op_sel.value; save(); });\n\n          const val_inp = document.createElement('input');\n          val_inp.type  = 'text';\n          val_inp.value = p.predicate.value ?? '';\n          val_inp.placeholder = 'value';\n          val_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].predicate.value = val_inp.value; save(); });\n\n          row.appendChild(op_sel);\n          row.appendChild(val_inp);\n        }\n\n        // can't delete the else port\n        if (p.name !== 'else') {\n          const del_btn = document.createElement('button');\n          del_btn.textContent = '×';\n          del_btn.className   = 'port-del';\n          del_btn.addEventListener('click', () => { ports.splice(i, 1); render_ports(); on_change(); save(); });\n          row.appendChild(del_btn);\n        }\n\n        wrap.appendChild(row);\n      });\n\n      const add_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      add_btn.textContent = '+ port';\n      add_btn.className   = 'add-port';\n      add_btn.addEventListener('click', () => {\n        // insert before else\n        const else_i = ports.findIndex(p => p.name === 'else');\n        const new_port = { name: '', predicate: { op: 'eq', value: '' } };\n        if (else_i >= 0) ports.splice(else_i, 0, new_port);\n        else ports.push(new_port);\n        render_ports(); on_change(); save();\n      });\n      wrap.appendChild(add_btn);\n    };\n\n    render_ports();\n    return wrap;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ show\n  function show(box, on_changed) {\n    current_box  = box;\n    on_change_cb = on_changed;\n    panel.classList.remove('hidden');\n    title.textContent = box.id;\n    fields.innerHTML  = '';\n\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('label',\n      mk_text_input(box.label, v => { current_box.label = v; })));\n\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('kind', (() => {\n      const sel = document.createElement('select');\n      ['call','branch','data'].forEach(k => {\n        const opt = document.createElement('option');\n        opt.value = k; opt.textContent = k;\n        if (k === box.kind) opt.selected = true;\n        sel.appendChild(opt);\n      });\n      sel.addEventListener('change', () => { current_box.kind = sel.value; show(current_box, on_change_cb); save(); });\n      return sel;\n    })()));\n\n    if (box.kind === 'call' || box.kind === 'data') {\n      fields.appendChild(mk_row('ref',\n        mk_text_input(box.ref, v => { current_box.ref = v; })));\n      fields.appendChild(mk_row('fn',\n        mk_text_input(box.fn, v => { current_box.fn = v; })));\n    }\n\n    const inputs_sec = document.createElement('div');\n    inputs_sec.className = 'section-label';\n    inputs_sec.textContent = 'inputs';\n    fields.appendChild(inputs_sec);\n    if (!current_box.inputs) current_box.inputs = [];\n    fields.appendChild(mk_port_list(current_box.inputs, () => {}));\n\n    if (box.kind === 'branch') {\n      if (!current_box.ports) current_box.ports = [{ name: 'else' }];\n      fields.appendChild(mk_row('retry limit',\n        mk_text_input(String(box.retry_limit ?? 3),\n          v => { current_box.retry_limit = parseInt(v) || 3; })));\n      const ports_sec = document.createElement('div');\n      ports_sec.className = 'section-label';\n      ports_sec.textContent = 'ports (evaluated top-to-bottom)';\n      fields.appendChild(ports_sec);\n      fields.appendChild(mk_branch_port_list(current_box.ports, () => {}));\n    } else {\n      if (!current_box.outputs) current_box.outputs = [];\n      const out_sec = document.createElement('div');\n      out_sec.className = 'section-label';\n      out_sec.textContent = 'outputs';\n      fields.appendChild(out_sec);\n      fields.appendChild(mk_port_list(current_box.outputs, () => {}));\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { show, hide };\n})();\n```\n\n## js/005-app.js\n\n```javascript\n// Top-level app: connects everything, loads the map, drives the render loop.\n\nconst App = (() => {\n  let selected_id   = null;\n  let drag_box_id   = null;\n  let drag_offset   = { x: 0, y: 0 };\n  let drawing_wire  = null;  // { from_box, from_port, from_side, cur_x, cur_y }\n  let hover_port    = null;\n  let status_el     = document.getElementById('status');\n\n  // {{{ status_msg\n  window.status_msg = function(msg, level = 'info') {\n    status_el.textContent = msg;\n    status_el.className   = 'status ' + level;\n  };\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ load_map\n  async function load_map() {\n    status_msg('loading…');\n    try {\n      const ids = await API.list_boxes();\n      const fetches = ids.map(id => API.get_box(id));\n      const all = await Promise.all(fetches);\n      Boxes.boxes = {};\n      all.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('loaded ' + ids.length + ' boxes');\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('load error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ new_box_at\n  async function new_box_at(wx, wy) {\n    const id = 'box-' + Date.now().toString(36);\n    const box = {\n      id, label: 'New Box', kind: 'call',\n      ref: '', fn: '', inputs: [], outputs: [], connections: [],\n      ui: { x: Math.round(wx), y: middle-mouse or Space+drag\n- Zoom via scroll wheel\n- Responsive canvas that resizes with window\n\n**Boxes (Nodes):**\n- Three box types: \"call\" (blue), \"branch\" (orange), \"data\" (green)\n- Let me lay out what's broken and what's missing before proposing anything.\n\n**Broken today (explains why boxes don't show):**\n\n`005-app.js` does `Boxes.boxes = {}` on load — this *replaces* the module property with a new object, but `draw_all` inside the closure still reads from the *original* empty object. The boxes load from the server and go into the new object; the renderer never sees them. The fix is to mutate the existing object (clear then repopulate) instead of replacing it.\n\n**What exists but isn't obvious:**\n- Double-click empty canvas → create box\n- Drag an output port dot → draw wire → release on input port\n- Click wire → select it → Delete key removes it\n- Inspector autosaves on every keystroke\n\nThe user can't discover any of this because there are no visible boxes to interact with.\n\n---\n\n**Proposed Phase 2 — \"Editor you can actually use\"**\n\nSix issues in priority order:\n\n| ID | Title | Why |\n|----|-------|-----|\n| 201 | Fix box rendering closure bug | Boxes are loaded but invisible — nothing else works until this is fixed |\n| 202 | Fit-to-view on map load | Once boxes render, they may be off-screen at origin; fit-to-view centers them |\n| 203 | Map picker panel | Typing map names into a browser prompt is painful; replace with a list from the server |\n| 204 | Visible interaction hints | User has no way to know double-click creates boxes or how wiring works |\n| 205 | Run button + last-run status | Show the runner output in the editor so you don't need a separate terminal |\n| 206 | Entry box designation | Editor should show which box is the entry point and let you change it |\n\nI'd skip data file editing for Phase 2 — it's useful but the six above are what makes the tool feel operational vs. broken.\n\nDoes this match what you're thinking, or would you reorder / cut anything?"

## [1046]

```json
{
  "isSidechain":false,
  "timestamp":"2026-05-08T00:00:04.365Z",
  "slug":"reactive-toasting-squid",
  "gitBranch":"HEAD",
  "version":"2.1.121",
  "sessionId":"2029ad16-5678-4b15-931f-3f52d826597a",
  "message":{
    "content":[{
        "type":"text",
        "text":"**What ref and fn do:**\n\n- **ref** — the path to the source file, relative to the map root. E.g. `src/greet.lua`, `src/stamp.sh`. This tells the runner which file to pass to the language driver.\n- **fn** — the function name within that file to call. E.g. `hello`, `write_result`. The runner passes this as the second argument to the driver.\n\nTogether they fully specify one invocation: *\"run the function `hello` from `src/greet.lua` using whatever driver handles `.lua` files.\"*\n\n---\n\n**On inputs/outputs:**\n\nYou're right, and this points to a real design gap. Right now the inspector lets you type port names and types by hand — but the function already *has* a signature. The box is just a wiring point for that function. Letting the user invent port names that don't match the function is a source of errors with no feedback.\n\nThe project convention (from CLAUDE.md) already calls for a `.info.md` sidecar next to each source file listing its public functions and their inputs/outputs. `soramech-data.info.md` is an example we wrote. That file is the natural source of truth for the editor.\n\nThe revised Phase 2 plan, with 205 dropped and this folded in:\n\n| ID | Title |\n|----|-------|\n| 201 | Fix box rendering closure bug |\n| 202 | Fit-to-view on map load |\n| 203 | Map picker panel |\n| 204 | Visible interaction hints |\n| 205 | ~~Run button~~ — dropped |\n| 206 | Entry box designation |\n| 207 | Auto-derive ports from source file manifest (ref+fn → read info.md → populate ports read-only) |\n\n207 needs a server endpoint to read `src/*.info.md` files, and a convention for the info.md format that the editor can parse. ```json
{
  "isSidechain":false,
  "promptId":"24e164c0-6778-4afd-bd4a-c0357d29aba3",

  "gitBranch":"HEAD",
  "version":"2.1.121",
  "message":{
    "role":"user",
    "content":"  The project convention (from CLAUDE.md) already calls for a .info.md sidecar next\n  to each source file listing its public functions and their inputs/outputs.\n  soramech-data.info.md is an example we wrote. That file is the natural source of\n  truth for the editor.\n\n\nyes, but the user is expected to write their own src files, so there's no guarantee that an info.md file will exist.\n\n  207 needs a server endpoint to read src/*.info.md files, and a convention for the\n  info.md format that the editor can parse. How are you thinking about that? Should\n  the info.md files be the mechanism, or would you prefer something else — a doc\n  comment in the source file, a JSON sidecar, a separate schema file?\n\n\njust, look through the file for all return statements. Look at the function signature for inputs. Easy, right?\n\n  - ref — the path to the source file, relative to the map root. E.g. src/greet.lua,\n   src/stamp.sh. This tells the runner which file to pass to the language driver.\n  - fn — the function name within that file to call. E.g. hello, write_result. The\n  runner passes this as the second argument to the driver.\n\n  Together they fully specify one invocation: \"run the function hello from\n  src/greet.lua using whatever driver handles .lua files.\"\n\n\nOkay that makes more sense. Can we create a simple file browser that lets a user pick a specific file, and upon picking it can we show a list in the panel on the right of all the functions in the file, with an indented newline for each of the inputs and output values?"
  },

      "content":"-- Minimal HTTP server for the SoraMech web editor.\n-- Handles file CRUD for map directories. Validates writes against the\n-- schema before touching disk. Closes after each response (HTTP/1.0 style).\n-- Started with: luajit soramech-server.lua <maps-root> [port]\n\nlocal DIR = \"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech\"\n\npackage.path  = DIR .. \"/libs/?.lua;\"\n             .. DIR .. \"/libs/luasocket/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;\"\n             .. DIR .. \"/src/?.lua;\"\n             .. package.path\npackage.cpath = DIR .. \"/libs/luasocket/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;\"\n             .. package.cpath\n\nlocal socket = require(\"socket\")\nlocal json   = require(\"dkjson\")\nlocal schema = require(\"001-schema\")\n\nlocal M = {}\n\n-- {{{ read_file\nlocal function read_file(path)\n    local f, err = io.open(path, \"r\")\n    if not f then return nil, err end\n    local data = f:read(\"*a\")\n    f:close()\n    return data\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ write_file_atomic\nlocal function write_file_atomic(path, data)\n    local tmp = path .. \".tmp\"\n    local f, err = io.open(tmp, \"w\")\n    if not f then return false, err end\n    f:write(data)\n    f:close()\n    local ok, rerr = os.rename(tmp, path)\n    if not ok then return false, rerr end\n    return true\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ parse_json_file\nlocal function parse_json_file(path)\n    local raw, err = read_file(path)\n    if not raw then return nil, err end\n    local obj, _, jerr = json.decode(raw)\n    if not obj then return nil, \"JSON error: \" .. tostring(jerr) end\n    return obj\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ list_dir_json\nlocal function list_dir_json(dir)\n    local handle = io.popen(\"ls \" .. dir .. \"/*.json 2>/dev/null\")\n    if not handle then return {} end\n    local listing = handle:read(\"*a\")\n    handle:close()\n    local files = {}\n    for path in listing:gmatch(\"[^\\n]+\") do\n        files[#files + 1] = path\n    end\n    return files\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ list_subdirs\nlocal function list_subdirs(dir)\n    local handle = io.popen(\"ls -d \" .. dir .. \"/*/ 2>/dev/null\")\n    if not handle then return {} end\n    local listing = handle:read(\"*a\")\n    handle:close()\n    local names = {}\n    for path in listing:gmatch(\"[^\\n]+\") do\n        local name = path:match(\"/([^/]+)/$\")\n        if name then names[#names + 1] = name end\n    end\n    return names\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ safe_path\n-- Returns the resolved path if it is within root, nil otherwise.\n-- Prevents path traversal outside the maps root.\nlocal function safe_path(root, ...)\n    local parts = { root }\n    for _, p in ipairs({...}) do\n        -- reject any component containing \"..\"\n        if tostring(p):find(\"%.%.\", 1, true) then return nil end\n        parts[#parts + 1] = p\n    end\n    return table.concat(parts, \"/\")\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ find_references\n-- Scan all box files in a map for any connection referencing the given box id.\nlocal function find_references(map_dir, box_id)\n    local refs = {}\n    local files = list_dir_json(map_dir .. \"/boxes\")\n    for _, path in ipairs(files) do\n        local box, _ = parse_json_file(path)\n        if box and box.id ~= box_id then\n            for _, c in ipairs(box.connections or {}) do\n                if c.to_box == box_id or c.from_box == box_id then\n                    refs[#refs + 1] = box.id\n                    break\n                end\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    return refs\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ respond\nlocal function respond(client, status, body, content_type)\n    content_type = content_type or \"application/json\"\n    local response = table.concat({\n        \"HTTP/1.0 \" .. status,\n        \"Content-Type: \" .. content_type,\n        \"Content-Length: \" .. #body,\n        \"Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *\",\n        \"Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS\",\n        \"Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type\",\n        \"Connection: close\",\n        \"\",\n        body,\n    }, \"\\r\\n\")\n    client:send(response)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ json_ok\nlocal function json_ok(client, data)\n    respond(client, \"200 OK\", json.encode(data))\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ json_err\nlocal function json_err(client, status, msg)\n    respond(client, status, json.encode({ error = msg }))\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ parse_request\nlocal function parse_request(client)\n    local line, err = client:receive(\"*l\")\n    if not line then return nil, err end\n\n    local method, path, _ = line:match(\"^(%u+) ([^ ]+) HTTP\")\n    if not method then return nil, \"bad request line: \" .. line end\n\n    -- read headers\n    local headers = {}\n    local content_length = 0\n    while true do\n        local hline = client:receive(\"*l\")\n        if not hline or hline == \"\" then break end\n        local k, v = hline:match(\"^([^:]+):%s*(.+)\")\n        if k then\n            headers[k:lower()] = v\n            if k:lower() == \"content-length\" then\n                content_length = tonumber(v) or 0\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    -- read body if present\n    local body = \"\"\n    if content_length > 0 then\n        body = client:receive(content_length) or \"\"\n    end\n\n    -- split path into segments\n    local parts = {}\n    for seg in path:gmatch(\"[^/]+\") do parts[#parts + 1] = seg end\n\n    return { method = method, path = path, parts = parts, body = body }\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_options\nlocal function handle_options(client)\n    respond(client, \"200 OK\", \"\", \"text/plain\")\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- ============================================================\n-- Route handlers\n-- ============================================================\n\n-- {{{ handle_list_maps\nlocal function handle_list_maps(client, req, maps_root)\n    local names = list_subdirs(maps_root)\n    json_ok(client, names)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_list_boxes\nlocal function handle_list_boxes(client, req, maps_root)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local boxes_dir = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"boxes\")\n    if not boxes_dir then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local files = list_dir_json(boxes_dir)\n    local ids = {}\n    for _, f in ipairs(files) do\n        local id = f:match(\"/([^/]+)%.json$\")\n        if id then ids[#ids + 1] = id end\n    end\n    json_ok(client, ids)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_get_box\nlocal function handle_get_box(client, req, maps_root)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local box_id   = req.parts[4]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"boxes\", box_id .. \".json\")\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local raw, err = read_file(path)\n    if not raw then return json_err(client, \"404 Not Found\", \"box not found: \" .. tostring(err)) end\n    respond(client, \"200 OK\", raw)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_put_box\nlocal function handle_put_box(client, req, maps_root)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local box_id   = req.parts[4]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"boxes\", box_id .. \".json\")\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local box, _, jerr = json.decode(req.body)\n    if not box then\n        return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid JSON: \" .. tostring(jerr))\n    end\n\n    local errs = schema.validate_box(box)\n    if #errs > 0 then\n        return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"schema error: \" .. table.concat(errs, \"; \"))\n    end\n\n    local ok, werr = write_file_atomic(path, req.body)\n    if not ok then return json_err(client, \"500 Internal Server Error\", tostring(werr)) end\n    json_ok(client, { ok = true })\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_delete_box\nlocal function handle_delete_box(client, req, maps_root)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local box_id   = req.parts[4]\n    local map_dir  = safe_path(maps_root, map_name)\n    local path     = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"boxes\", box_id .. \".json\")\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    -- check for references in other boxes before deleting\n    local refs = find_references(map_dir, box_id)\n    if #refs > 0 then\n        return json_err(client, \"409 Conflict\",\n            \"box '\" .. box_id .. \"' is referenced by: \" .. table.concat(refs, \", \"))\n    end\n\n    local ok = os.remove(path)\n    if not ok then return json_err(client, \"404 Not Found\", \"box not found\") end\n    json_ok(client, { ok = true })\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_get_data\nlocal function handle_get_data(client, req, maps_root)\n    local map_name  = req.parts[2]\n    local file_name = req.parts[4]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"data\", file_name .. \".json\")\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local raw, err = read_file(path)\n    if not raw then return json_err(client, \"404 Not Found\", tostring(err)) end\n    respond(client, \"200 OK\", raw)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_put_data\nlocal function handle_put_data(client, req, maps_root)\n    local map_name  = req.parts[2]\n    local file_name = req.parts[4]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, \"data\", file_name .. \".json\")\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    -- validate it's at least valid JSON\n    local _, _, jerr = json.decode(req.body)\n    if jerr then\n        return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid JSON: \" .. tostring(jerr))\n    end\n\n    local ok, werr = write_file_atomic(path, req.body)\n    if not ok then return json_err(client, \"500 Internal Server Error\", tostring(werr)) end\n    json_ok(client, { ok = true })\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_get_simple\n-- Handles GET for single-file resources: drivers.json, meta.json\nlocal function handle_get_simple(client, req, maps_root, filename)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, filename)\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local raw, err = read_file(path)\n    if not raw then return json_err(client, \"404 Not Found\", tostring(err)) end\n    respond(client, \"200 OK\", raw)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ handle_put_simple\nlocal function handle_put_simple(client, req, maps_root, filename, validator)\n    local map_name = req.parts[2]\n    local path = safe_path(maps_root, map_name, filename)\n    if not path then return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid path\") end\n\n    local obj, _, jerr = json.decode(req.body)\n    if not obj then\n        return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", \"invalid JSON: \" .. tostring(jerr))\n    end\n\n    if validator then\n        local errs = validator(obj)\n        if #errs > 0 then\n            return json_err(client, \"400 Bad Request\", table.concat(errs, \"; \"))\n        end\n    end\n\n    local ok, werr = write_file_atomic(path, req.body)\n    if not ok then return json_err(client, \"500 Internal Server Error\", tostring(werr)) end\n    json_ok(client, { ok = true })\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ dispatch\nlocal function dispatch(client, req, maps_root)\n    local m = req.method\n    local p = req.parts\n\n    -- OPTIONS preflight\n    if m == \"OPTIONS\" then return handle_options(client) end\n\n    -- GET /maps\n    if m == \"GET\" and #p == 1 and p[1] == \"maps\" then\n        return handle_list_maps(client, req, maps_root)\n    end\n\n    -- GET /maps/<name>/boxes\n    if m == \"GET\" and #p == 3 and p[1] == \"maps\" and p[3] == \"boxes\" then\n        return handle_list_boxes(client, req, maps_root)\n    end\n\n    -- GET/PUT/DELETE /maps/<name>/boxes/<id>\n    if #p == 4 and p[1] == \"maps\" and p[3] == \"boxes\" then\n        if m == \"GET\"    then return handle_get_box(client, req, maps_root) end\n        if m == \"PUT\"    then return handle_put_box(client, req, maps_root) end\n        if m == \"DELETE\" then return handle_delete_box(client, req, maps_root) end\n    end\n\n    -- GET/PUT /maps/<name>/data/<filename>\n    if #p == 4 and p[1] == \"maps\" and p[3] == \"data\" then\n        if m == \"GET\" then return handle_get_data(client, req, maps_root) end\n        if m == \"PUT\" then return handle_put_data(client, req, maps_root) end\n    end\n\n    -- GET/PUT /maps/<name>/drivers\n    if #p == 3 and p[1] == \"maps\" and p[3] == \"drivers\" then\n        if m == \"GET\" then return handle_get_simple(client, req, maps_root, \"drivers.json\") end\n        if m == \"PUT\" then return handle_put_simple(client, req, maps_root, \"drivers.json\", schema.validate_drivers) end\n    end\n\n    -- GET/PUT /maps/<name>/meta\n    if #p == 3 and p[1] == \"maps\" and p[3] == \"meta\" then\n        if m == \"GET\" then return handle_get_simple(client, req, maps_root, \"meta.json\") end\n        if m == \"PUT\" then return handle_put_simple(client, req, maps_root, \"meta.json\", schema.validate_meta) end\n    end\n\n    -- GET / and GET /js/* and GET /*.html — serve static assets\n    if m == \"GET\" then\n        local rel = req.path == \"/\" and \"/index.html\" or req.path\n        -- only allow paths that don't escape the assets directory\n        if not rel:find(\"%.%.\", 1, true) then\n            local asset_path = DIR .. \"/assets\" .. rel\n            local raw, _ = read_file(asset_path)\n            if raw then\n                local ext = rel:match(\"%.([^./]+)$\") or \"\"\n                local mime = ({\n                    html = \"text/html\",\n                    js   = \"application/javascript\",\n                    css  = \"text/css\",\n                })[ext] or \"text/plain\"\n                respond(client, \"200 OK\", raw, mime)\n                return\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    json_err(client, \"404 Not Found\", \"no route for \" .. m .. \" \" .. req.path)\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ serve\nfunction M.serve(maps_root, port)\n    local server, err = socket.bind(\"*\", port)\n    if not server then\n        io.stderr:write(\"server: cannot bind to port \" .. port .. \": \" .. tostring(err) .. \"\\n\")\n        os.exit(1)\n    end\n    server:settimeout(1)  -- 1s accept timeout so we can handle signals cleanly\n\n    print(\"soramech-server listening on :\" .. port .. \" (maps: \" .. maps_root .. \")\")\n\n    while true do\n        local client, cerr = server:accept()\n        if client then\n            client:settimeout(5)\n            local t_start = socket.gettime()\n\n            local req, rerr = parse_request(client)\n            if req then\n                local ok_disp, derr = pcall(dispatch, client, req, maps_root)\n                if not ok_disp then\n                    pcall(json_err, client, \"500 Internal Server Error\", tostring(derr))\n                end\n                local elapsed = math.floor((socket.gettime() - t_start) * 1000)\n                print(string.format(\"[%.0f] %s %s (%dms)\",\n                    os.time(), req.method, req.path, elapsed))\n            else\n                pcall(json_err, client, \"400 Bad Request\", tostring(rerr))\n            end\n\n            client:close()\n        end\n        -- cerr is \"timeout\" on accept timeout — that's normal, keep looping\n    end\nend\n-- }}}\n\nreturn M\n",

        "input":{
          "content":"# 201 — Fix box rendering closure bug\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Current behavior\n\nBoxes load from the server (\"loaded N boxes\" appears in the status bar) but\nnothing is drawn on the canvas. The inspector and all interaction also fail\nsilently.\n\n## Root cause\n\n`005-app.js` `load_map()` does:\n```javascript\nBoxes.boxes = {};\nall.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n```\n\n`Boxes.boxes` is the exported reference to the closure-private `boxes`\nvariable inside `002-boxes.js`. Assigning `Boxes.boxes = {}` replaces the\nproperty on the module object with a new object, but `draw_all`, `hit_test_box`,\nand all other functions inside the closure still read from the original `boxes`\nvariable. The original object stays empty forever.\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nBoxes render as soon as `load_map()` completes.\n\n## Suggested fix\n\nMutate the existing object instead of replacing it:\n```javascript\n// clear\nObject.keys(Boxes.boxes).forEach(k => delete Boxes.boxes[k]);\n// repopulate\nall.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n```\n\n## Related documents\n\n- assets/js/002-boxes.js — closure owner\n- assets/js/005-app.js — load_map, new_box_at (same pattern)\n",
          "file_path":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/issues/201-fix-box-rendering-closure-bug.md"
        }
      }],

The inspector and all interaction also fail\nsilently.\n\n## Root cause\n\n`005-app.js` `load_map()` does:\n```javascript\nBoxes.boxes = {};\nall.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n```\n\n`Boxes.boxes` is the exported reference to the closure-private `boxes`\nvariable inside `002-boxes.js`. Assigning `Boxes.boxes = {}` replaces the\nproperty on the module object with a new object, but `draw_all`, `hit_test_box`,\nand all other functions inside the closure still read from the original `boxes`\nvariable. The original object stays empty forever.\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nBoxes render as soon as `load_map()` completes.\n\n## Suggested fix\n\nMutate the existing object instead of replacing it:\n```javascript\n// clear\nObject.keys(Boxes.boxes).forEach(k => delete Boxes.boxes[k]);\n// repopulate\nall.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n```\n\n## Related documents\n\n- assets/js/002-boxes.js — closure owner\n- assets/js/005-app.js — load_map, new_box_at (same pattern)\n",
    "userModified":false,
    "type":"create",
    "filePath":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/issues/201-fix-box-rendering-closure-bug.md",
    "structuredPatch":[]
  }
}

          "content":"# 207 — Source file browser and port auto-population\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Blockers\n\n- 201 (boxes must render for this to be testable)\n\n## Current behavior\n\nThe inspector shows editable text inputs for ref, fn, inputs, and outputs.\nUsers must type port names by hand with no relationship to the actual function\nbeing called. Mismatches between the box config and the function signature\ncause silent runtime failures.\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nFor call boxes:\n- \"ref\" field shows current value plus a Browse button\n- Clicking Browse replaces the inspector panel with a file list from the\n  map's src/ directory\n- Selecting a file shows all public functions parsed from that file, each\n  with its inputs (from the function signature) and outputs (from return\n  statements), displayed as read-only text\n- Clicking a function sets ref and fn on the box, derives inputs and outputs\n  from the parsed signature, saves the box, and returns to the normal\n  inspector view\n- Inputs and outputs in the inspector are read-only — not editable fields\n\nFor branch boxes: no file browser; ports remain manually configured.\n\n## Suggested implementation steps\n\n1. Server: add GET /maps/:name/src (list files in src/) and\n   GET /maps/:name/src/:file (return file content as text/plain)\n2. API: add list_src_files() and get_src_file(filename)\n3. New file 007-filebrowser.js: parse_functions(content, filename),\n   render(container, on_select) that shows file list → function list\n4. Inspector: replace ref text input with display + Browse button;\n   remove editable inputs/outputs; show derived ports as read-only list\n5. When function selected: set box.ref, box.fn, box.inputs, box.outputs\n   (with type: \"any\" for all), autosave\n\n## Parser conventions\n\nLua (.lua): match `function M.name(args)` for inputs; scan function body\nfor `return` statements and use variable names as output names. If the\nreturn expression is not a bare identifier, name it \"result\".\n\nBash (.sh): match `name() {`; scan body for `local var=\"${N}\"` to name\npositional inputs; output is always one value named \"output\".\n\nOther extensions: show file in list but display \"no parser\" when selected.\n\n## Related documents\n\n- docs/001-architecture.md — box file format (ref, fn, inputs, outputs)\n- assets/js/004-inspector.js — inspector to modify\n- src/005-http-server.lua — server to extend\n",

    "content":"# 207 — Source file browser and port auto-population\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Blockers\n\n- 201 (boxes must render for this to be testable)\n\n## Current behavior\n\nThe inspector shows editable text inputs for ref, fn, inputs, and outputs.\nUsers must type port names by hand with no relationship to the actual function\nbeing called. Mismatches between the box config and the function signature\ncause silent runtime failures.\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nFor call boxes:\n- \"ref\" field shows current value plus a Browse button\n- Clicking Browse replaces the inspector panel with a file list from the\n  map's src/ directory\n- Selecting a file shows all public functions parsed from that file, each\n  with its inputs (from the function signature) and outputs (from return\n  statements), displayed as read-only text\n- Clicking a function sets ref and fn on the box, derives inputs and outputs\n  from the parsed signature, saves the box, and returns to the normal\n  inspector view\n- Inputs and outputs in the inspector are read-only — not editable fields\n\nFor branch boxes: no file browser; ports remain manually configured.\n\n## Suggested implementation steps\n\n1. Server: add GET /maps/:name/src (list files in src/) and\n   GET /maps/:name/src/:file (return file content as text/plain)\n2. API: add list_src_files() and get_src_file(filename)\n3. New file 007-filebrowser.js: parse_functions(content, filename),\n   render(container, on_select) that shows file list → function list\n4. Inspector: replace ref text input with display + Browse button;\n   remove editable inputs/outputs; show derived ports as read-only list\n5. When function selected: set box.ref, box.fn, box.inputs, box.outputs\n   (with type: \"any\" for all), autosave\n\n## Parser conventions\n\nLua (.lua): match `function M.name(args)` for inputs; scan function body\nfor `return` statements and use variable names as output names. If the\nreturn expression is not a bare identifier, name it \"result\".\n\nBash (.sh): match `name() {`; scan body for `local var=\"${N}\"` to name\npositional inputs; output is always one value named \"output\".\n\nOther extensions: show file in list but display \"no parser\" when selected.\n\n## Related documents\n\n- docs/001-architecture.md — box file format (ref, fn, inputs, outputs)\n- assets/js/004-inspector.js — inspector to modify\n- src/005-http-server.lua — server to extend\n",
    "userModified":false,
    "type":"create",
    "filePath":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/issues/207-source-file-browser-and-port-auto-population.md",
    "structuredPatch":[]
  }
}

map_name = name; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ request\n  async function request(method, path, body) {\n    const opts = { method, headers: {} };\n    if (body !== undefined) {\n      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';\n      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);\n    }\n    const res = await fetch(base_url + path, opts);\n    const text = await res.text();\n    let data;\n    try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { data = { error: text }; }\n    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);\n    return data;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_maps\n  async function list_maps() { return request('GET', '/maps'); }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_boxes\n  async function list_boxes() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_box\n  async function get_box(id) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_box\n  async function put_box(id, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ delete_box\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    return request('DELETE', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_meta\n  async function get_meta() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_meta\n  async function put_meta(data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_data\n  async function get_data(filename) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_data\n  async function put_data(filename, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { init, list_maps, list_boxes, get_box, put_box, delete_box,\n           get_meta, put_meta, get_data, put_data };\n})();\n",

    "newString":"  return { init, list_maps, list_boxes, get_box, put_box, delete_box,\n           get_meta, put_meta, get_data, put_data,\n           list_src_files, get_src_file };",
    "originalFile":"// Thin fetch wrapper for the soramech-server REST API.\n// All functions are async and throw on non-2xx responses.\n\nconst API = (() => {\n  let base_url = '';\n  let map_name = '';\n\n  // {{{ init\n  function init(url, name) { base_url = url.replace(/\\/$/, ''); map_name = name; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ request\n  async function request(method, path, body) {\n    const opts = { method, headers: {} };\n    if (body !== undefined) {\n      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';\n      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);\n    }\n    const res = await fetch(base_url + path, opts);\n    const text = await res.text();\n    let data;\n    try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { data = { error: text }; }\n    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);\n    return data;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_maps\n  async function list_maps() { return request('GET', '/maps'); }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_boxes\n  async function list_boxes() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_box\n  async function get_box(id) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_box\n  async function put_box(id, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ delete_box\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    return request('DELETE', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_meta\n  async function get_meta() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_meta\n  async function put_meta(data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_src_files\n  async function list_src_files() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/src`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_src_file\n  async function get_src_file(filename) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/src/${encodeURIComponent(filename)}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_data\n  async function get_data(filename) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_data\n  async function put_data(filename, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { init, list_maps, list_boxes, get_box, put_box, delete_box,\n           get_meta, put_meta, get_data, put_data };\n})();\n",
