{{{ parse_lua_returns\n  // Scans a function body for return statements; returns an array of output names.\n  function parse_lua_returns(body) {\n    const re    = /\\breturn\\b\\s*([^\\n]+)/g;\n    const names = new Set();\n    let m;\n    while ((m = re.exec(body)) !== null) {\n      const expr = m[1].replace(/--.*$/, '').trim();\n      if (!expr) continue;\n      expr.split(',').forEach((part, i) => {\n        part = part.trim();\n        // bare identifier → use as port name\n        if (/^[a-zA-Z_]\\w*$/.test(part) &&\n            !['nil','true','false','not','and','or','end'].includes(part)) {\n          names.add(part);\n        } else if (expr.split(',').length === 1 && part) {\n          // single complex expression → call it \"result\"\n          names.add('result');\n        }\n        // multi-value complex expression: skip unnamed parts\n      });\n    }\n    return [...names];\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ parse_lua\n  function parse_lua(content) {\n    const fns    = [];\n    const fn_re  = /^function\\s+M\\.(\\w+)\\s*\\(([^)]*)\\)/mg;\n    const starts = [];\n    let m;\n    while ((m = fn_re.exec(content)) !== null) {\n      starts.push({ name: m[1], args: m[2], body_start: m.index + m[0].length });\n    }\n    starts.forEach((fn, i) => {\n      const body_end = i + 1 < starts.length ? starts[i + 1].body_start : content.length;\n      const body     = content.slice(fn.body_start, body_end);\n      const inputs   = fn.args.trim()\n        ? fn.args.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)\n        : [];\n      const outputs  = parse_lua_returns(body);\n      fns.push({ name: fn.name, inputs, outputs });\n    });\n    return fns;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ parse_bash_inputs\n  function parse_bash_inputs(body) {\n    const params = {};\n    // local var=\"${N}\" or local var=\"$N\"\n    const local_re = /local\\s+(\\w+)\\s*=\\s*[\"']?\\$\\{?(\\d+)\\}?[\"']?/g;\n    let m;\n    while ((m = local_re.exec(body)) !== null) {\n      params[parseInt(m[2])] = m[1];\n    }\n    if (Object.keys(params).length > 0) {\n      const max = Math.max(...Object.keys(params).map(Number));\n      return Array.from({ length: max }, (_, i) => params[i + 1] || `arg${i + 1}`);\n    }\n    // fall back: scan for raw $N references\n    const seen = new Set();\n    const pos_re = /\\$\\{?(\\d+)\\}?/g;\n    while ((m = pos_re.exec(body)) !== null) {\n      const n = parseInt(m[1]);\n      if (n > 0) seen.add(n);\n    }\n    if (seen.size > 0) {\n      const max = Math.max(...seen);\n      return Array.from({ length: max }, (_, i) => `arg${i + 1}`);\n    }\n    return [];\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ parse_bash\n  function parse_bash(content) {\n    const fns   = [];\n    const re    = /^(\\w+)\\s*\\(\\s*\\)\\s*\\{/mg;\n    const skip  = new Set(['if','while','for','case','do','done','fi','then','else']);\n    let m;\n    while ((m = re.exec(content)) !== null) {\n      const name = m[1];\n      if (skip.has(name)) continue;\n      const body_start = m.index + m[0].length;\n      const close      = content.indexOf('\\n}', body_start);\n      const body       = content.slice(body_start, close > -1 ? close : body_start + 800);\n      const inputs     = parse_bash_inputs(body);\n      fns.push({ name, inputs, outputs: ['output'] });\n    }\n    return fns;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ parse_functions\n  // Returns [{name, inputs:[string], outputs:[string]}] for a given file.\n  function parse_functions(content, filename) {\n    const ext = filename.split('.').pop();\n    if (ext === 'lua') return parse_lua(content);\n    if (ext === 'sh')  return parse_bash(content);\n    return null;  // null = no parser for this extension\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ render_fn_list\n  // Shows parsed functions for one file; calls on_select(filename, fn) on click.\n  function render_fn_list(container, filename, fns, on_select, on_back) {\n    container.innerHTML = '';\n\n    const back_btn = document.createElement('button');\n    back_btn.className   = 'fb-back';\n    back_btn.textContent = '← ' + filename;\n    back_btn.onclick     = on_back;\n    container.appendChild(back_btn);\n\n    if (fns === null) {\n      const note = document.createElement('div');\n      note.className   = 'fb-note';\n      note.textContent = 'no parser for .' + filename.split('.').pop() + ' files';\n      container.appendChild(note);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (fns.length === 0) {\n      const note = document.createElement('div');\n      note.className   = 'fb-note';\n      note.textContent = 'no public functions found (expected: function M.name(...))';\n      container.appendChild(note);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    fns.forEach(fn => {\n      const row = document.createElement('div');\n      row.className = 'fb-fn-row';\n\n      const name_el = document.createElement('div');\n      name_el.className   = 'fb-fn-name';\n      name_el.textContent = fn.name + '(' + fn.inputs.join(', ') + ')';\n      row.appendChild(name_el);\n\n      const in_el = document.createElement('div');\n      in_el.className   = 'fb-fn-ports';\n      in_el.textContent = 'in:  ' + (fn.inputs.length ? fn.inputs.join(', ') : '(none)');\n      row.appendChild(in_el);\n\n      const out_el = document.createElement('div');\n      out_el.className   = 'fb-fn-ports';\n      out_el.textContent = 'out: ' + (fn.outputs.length ? fn.outputs.join(', ') : '(none)');\n      row.appendChild(out_el);\n\n      row.onclick = () => on_select(filename, fn);\n      container.appendChild(row);\n    });\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ render\n  // Renders the full file browser into container.\n  // on_select(filename, fn_obj) called when the user picks a function.\n  async function render(container, on_select) {\n    container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note\">loading src/…</div>';\n\n    let files;\n    try {\n      files = await API.list_src_files();\n    } catch (e) {\n      container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note error\">could not list src/: ' + e.message + '</div>';\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (!files || files.length === 0) {\n      container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note\">src/ is empty — add source files to the map</div>';\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // show file list\n    const show_file_list = () => {\n      container.innerHTML = '';\n      const hdr = document.createElement('div');\n      hdr.className   = 'fb-header';\n      hdr.textContent = 'src/';\n      container.appendChild(hdr);\n\n      files.forEach(filename => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className   = 'fb-file-row';\n        row.textContent = filename;\n        row.onclick     = async () => {\n          row.textContent = filename + ' …';\n          let content;\n          try {\n            content = await API.get_src_file(filename);\n          } catch (e) {\n            container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note error\">could not read ' + filename + ': ' + e.message + '</div>';\n            show_file_list();\n            return;\n          }\n          const fns = parse_functions(content, filename);\n          render_fn_list(container, filename, fns,\n            (f, fn) => on_select(f, fn),\n            show_file_list\n          );\n        };\n        container.appendChild(row);\n      });\n    };\n\n    show_file_list();\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { parse_functions, render };\n})();\n",

    "originalFile":"// Top-level app: connects everything, loads the map, drives the render loop.\n\nconst App = (() => {\n  let selected_id   = null;\n  let drag_box_id   = null;\n  let drag_offset   = { x: 0, y: 0 };\n  let drawing_wire  = null;  // { from_box, from_port, from_side, cur_x, cur_y }\n  let hover_port    = null;\n  let status_el     = document.getElementById('status');\n\n  // {{{ status_msg\n  window.status_msg = function(msg, level = 'info') {\n    status_el.textContent = msg;\n    status_el.className   = 'status ' + level;\n  };\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ load_map\n  async function load_map() {\n    status_msg('loading…');\n    try {\n      const ids = await API.list_boxes();\n      const fetches = ids.map(id => API.get_box(id));\n      const all = await Promise.all(fetches);\n      Boxes.boxes = {};\n      all.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('loaded ' + ids.length + ' boxes');\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('load error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ new_box_at\n  async function new_box_at(wx, wy) {\n    const id = 'box-' + Date.now().toString(36);\n    const box = {\n      id, label: 'New Box', kind: 'call',\n      ref: '', fn: '', inputs: [], outputs: [], connections: [],\n      ui: { x: Math.round(wx), y: Math.round(wy) },\n    };\n    try {\n      await API.put_box(id, box);\n      Boxes.boxes[id] = box;\n      selected_id = id;\n      Inspector.show(box, () => Canvas.mark_dirty());\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('create error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ render\n  function render() {\n    if (Canvas.start_frame()) {\n      const ctx = Canvas.ctx;\n      Wires.draw_all(ctx, selected_id);\n      Boxes.draw_all(ctx, selected_id);\n\n      // draw in-progress wire\n      if (drawing_wire) {\n        const src = Boxes.get_port_world_pos(drawing_wire.from_box, drawing_wire.from_port, 'output');\n        if (src) {\n          Wires.draw_bezier(ctx, src.x, src.y, drawing_wire.cur_x, drawing_wire.cur_y,\n            '#6c72a0', false);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    requestAnimationFrame(render);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // Mouse interaction\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {\n    if (e.button !== 0) return;\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    // port hit?\n    const port = Boxes.hit_test_port(w.x, w.y);\n    if (port && port.side === 'output') {\n      drawing_wire = { from_box: port.box_id, from_port: port.port_name,\n                       cur_x: w.x, cur_y: w.y };\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // box hit?\n    const box_id = Boxes.hit_test_box(w.x, w.y);\n    if (box_id) {\n      selected_id = box_id;\n      drag_box_id = box_id;\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[box_id];\n      drag_offset = { x: w.x - (b.ui?.x ?? 0), y: w.y - (b.ui?.y ?? 0) };\n      Inspector.show(b, () => Canvas.mark_dirty());\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // click on empty space: deselect\n    selected_id = null;\n    Inspector.hide();\n    Canvas.mark_dirty();\n  });\n\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    if (drawing_wire) {\n      drawing_wire.cur_x = w.x;\n      drawing_wire.cur_y = w.y;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (drag_box_id) {\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[drag_box_id];\n      if (b) {\n        b.ui = b.ui || {};\n        b.ui.x = Math.round(w.x - drag_offset.x);\n        b.ui.y = Math.round(w.y - drag_offset.y);\n        Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mouseup', async e => {\n    if (e.button !== 0) return;\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    if (drawing_wire) {\n      const target_port = Boxes.hit_test_port(w.x, w.y);\n      if (target_port && target_port.side === 'input' &&\n          target_port.box_id !== drawing_wire.from_box) {\n        await Wires.create_connection(\n          drawing_wire.from_box, drawing_wire.from_port,\n          target_port.box_id, target_port.port_name\n        );\n      }\n      drawing_wire = null;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (drag_box_id) {\n      // persist position on mouseup\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[drag_box_id];\n      if (b) {\n        try { await API.put_box(b.id, b); }\n        catch(e) { status_msg('save position failed: ' + e.message, 'error'); }\n      }\n      drag_box_id = null;\n    }\n  });\n\n  // Double-click to create box\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('dblclick', async e => {\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n    if (!Boxes.hit_test_box(w.x, w.y)) {\n      await new_box_at(w.x, w.y);\n    }\n  });\n\n  // Delete key: remove selected box or wire\n  window.addEventListener('keydown', async e => {\n    if (e.code !== 'Delete' && e.code !== 'Backspace') return;\n    if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT') return;\n\n    const sel_wire = Wires.selected_wire();\n    if (sel_wire) {\n      await Wires.delete_connection(sel_wire);\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (selected_id) {\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[selected_id];\n      const conns = (b && b.connections || []).filter(c => c.from_box === selected_id);\n      if (conns.length > 0) {\n        const refs = conns.map(c => c.to_box).join(', ');\n        if (!confirm(`Box \"${selected_id}\" has connections to: ${refs}.\\nDelete anyway?`)) return;\n      }\n      try {\n        await API.delete_box(selected_id);\n        delete Boxes.boxes[selected_id];\n        Inspector.hide();\n        selected_id = null;\n        Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      } catch(e) {\n        status_msg('delete error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  // {{{ init\n  async function init() {\n    let server_url = localStorage.getItem('soramech_server') || '';\n    let map_name   = localStorage.getItem('soramech_map')    || '';\n\n    if (!server_url || !map_name) {\n      server_url =     "originalFile":"# 201 — Fix box rendering closure bug\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Current behavior\n\nBoxes load from the server (\"loaded N boxes\" appears in the status bar) but\nnothing is drawn on the canvas. The inspector and all interaction also fail\nsilently.\n\n## Root cause\n\n`005-app.js` `load_map()` does:\n```javascript\nBoxes.boxes = {};\nall.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n```\n\n`Boxes.boxes` is the exported reference to the closure-private `boxes`\nvariable inside `002-boxes.js`. Assigning `Boxes.boxes = {}` replaces the\nproperty on the module object with a new object, but `draw_all`, `hit_test_box`,\nand all other functions inside the closure still read from the original `boxes`\nvariable. The original object stays empty forever.\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nBoxes render as soon as `load_map()` completes.\n\n## Suggested fix\n\nMutate the existing object instead of replacing it:\n```javascript\n// clear\nObject.keys(Boxes.boxes).forEach(k => delete Boxes.boxes[k]);\n// repopulate\nall.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n```\n\n## Related documents\n\n- assets/js/002-boxes.js — closure owner\n- assets/js/005-app.js — load_map, new_box_at (same pattern)\n",
    "filePath":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/issues/201-fix-box-rendering-closure-bug.md",

On function\nclick, ref/fn/inputs/outputs are set on the box and saved. Inputs and outputs\nare shown as read-only port-display lists, not editable fields. Branch box\ninputs remain manually editable (no source function to parse).",
    "originalFile":"# 207 — Source file browser and port auto-population\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Blockers\n\n- 201 (boxes must render for this to be testable)\n\n## Current behavior\n\nThe inspector shows editable text inputs for ref, fn, inputs, and outputs.\nUsers must type port names by hand with no relationship to the actual function\nbeing called. Mismatches between the box config and the function signature\ncause silent runtime failures.\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nFor call boxes:\n- \"ref\" field shows current value plus a Browse button\n- Clicking Browse replaces the inspector panel with a file list from the\n  map's src/ directory\n- Selecting a file shows all public functions parsed from that file, each\n  with its inputs (from the function signature) and outputs (from return\n  statements), displayed as read-only text\n- Clicking a function sets ref and fn on the box, derives inputs and outputs\n  from the parsed signature, saves the box, and returns to the normal\n  inspector view\n- Inputs and outputs in the inspector are read-only — not editable fields\n\nFor branch boxes: no file browser; ports remain manually configured.\n\n## Suggested implementation steps\n\n1. Server: add GET /maps/:name/src (list files in src/) and\n   GET /maps/:name/src/:file (return file content as text/plain)\n2. API: add list_src_files() and get_src_file(filename)\n3. New file 007-filebrowser.js: parse_functions(content, filename),\n   render(container, on_select) that shows file list → function list\n4. Inspector: replace ref text input with display + Browse button;\n   remove editable inputs/outputs; show derived ports as read-only list\n5. When function selected: set box.ref, box.fn, box.inputs, box.outputs\n   (with type: \"any\" for all), autosave\n\n## Parser conventions\n\nLua (.lua): match `function M.name(args)` for inputs; scan function body\nfor `return` statements and use variable names as output names. If the\nreturn expression is not a bare identifier, name it \"result\".\n\nBash (.sh): match `name() {`; scan body for `local var=\"${N}\"` to name\npositional inputs; output is always one value named \"output\".\n\nOther extensions: show file in list but display \"no parser\" when selected.\n\n## Related documents\n\n- docs/001-architecture.md — box file format (ref, fn, inputs, outputs)\n- assets/js/004-inspector.js — inspector to modify\n- src/005-http-server.lua — server to extend\n",

          "content":"# 202 — Fit-to-view on map load\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Blockers\n\n- 201 (boxes must render before fit-to-view can be tested)\n\n## Current behavior\n\nWhen a map loads, the camera stays at its default position (origin, zoom 1).\nIf boxes were placed at coordinates far from (0,0), they are off-screen and\nthe user has no way to know where to look.\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nAfter `load_map()` completes, the camera is moved and zoomed so that all\nloaded boxes are visible with a small margin. If the map is empty, the camera\nresets to the origin.\n\n## Suggested implementation steps\n\n1. In `005-app.js`, after populating `Boxes.boxes`, compute the bounding box\n   of all box positions (using `box.ui.x`, `box.ui.y`, and `Boxes.box_height`).\n2. Compute the center of the bounding box and set `cam.x` / `cam.y` to center\n   it in the canvas.\n3. Compute zoom so the bounding box fits within the canvas with ~60px margin\n   on each side. Clamp zoom to [0.25, 1.5].\n4. Call `Canvas.mark_dirty()`.\n5. Expose a `fit_to_view()` function from App and wire it to a toolbar button\n   so the user can re-center at any time.\n\n## Related documents\n\n- assets/js/001-canvas.js — cam, mark_dirty\n- assets/js/002-boxes.js — box_height, BOX_W\n- assets/js/005-app.js — load_map\n",
          "file_path":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/issues/202-fit-to-view-on-map-load.md"
        }
      }],

  "toolUseResult":{
    "content":"# 202 — Fit-to-view on map load\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Blockers\n\n- 201 (boxes must render before fit-to-view can be tested)\n\n## Current behavior\n\nWhen a map loads, the camera stays at its default position (origin, zoom 1).\nIf boxes were placed at coordinates far from (0,0), they are off-screen and\nthe user has no way to know where to look.\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nAfter `load_map()` completes, the camera is moved and zoomed so that all\nloaded boxes are visible with a small margin. If the map is empty, the camera\nresets to the origin.\n\n## Suggested implementation steps\n\n1. In `005-app.js`, after populating `Boxes.boxes`, compute the bounding box\n   of all box positions (using `box.ui.x`, `box.ui.y`, and `Boxes.box_height`).\n2. Compute the center of the bounding box and set `cam.x` / `cam.y` to center\n   it in the canvas.\n3. Compute zoom so the bounding box fits within the canvas with ~60px margin\n   on each side. Clamp zoom to [0.25, 1.5].\n4. Call `Canvas.mark_dirty()`.\n5. Expose a `fit_to_view()` function from App and wire it to a toolbar button\n   so the user can re-center at any time.\n\n## Related documents\n\n- assets/js/001-canvas.js — cam, mark_dirty\n- assets/js/002-boxes.js — box_height, BOX_W\n- assets/js/005-app.js — load_map\n",
    "userModified":false,
    "type":"create",
    "filePath":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/issues/202-fit-to-view-on-map-load.md",
    "structuredPatch":[]
  }
}

          "content":"# 203 — Map picker panel\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Current behavior\n\nOn first load, the editor shows a browser `prompt()` asking for a server URL\nand map name. These are stored in localStorage. The only way to switch maps\nis to click \"switch map\", which clears localStorage and reloads — prompting\nagain with bare text inputs.\n\nThis is friction every time you want to work on a different map.\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nOn load, if no server URL or map name is stored, show a proper panel (not a\nbrowser prompt) with:\n- A text input for the server URL (default: http://localhost:7700)\n- A list of available maps fetched from GET /maps on the server\n- Clicking a map name connects to it and loads the editor\n\nThe \"switch map\" button opens this panel again without clearing all of\nlocalStorage (so the server URL is remembered).\n\nThe panel should be rendered in the sidebar, replacing the inspector content\nwhile open. Once a map is selected, the normal editor state resumes.\n\n## Suggested implementation steps\n\n1. On `DOMContentLoaded`, if `soramech_map` is not in localStorage, show the\n   picker panel instead of loading immediately.\n2. The picker panel: server URL text input + \"connect\" button. On connect,\n   call `API.list_maps()` and render a clickable list of map names.\n3. On map name click: store URL + name in localStorage, call `API.init()`,\n   close the picker, call `load_map()`.\n4. \"switch map\" button opens the picker panel without wiping the server URL.\n5. If the server is unreachable, show an error in the panel with a retry\n   option.\n\n## Related documents\n\n- assets/js/003-api.js — list_maps()\n- assets/js/005-app.js — init(), load_map()\n- assets/index.html — sidebar and inspector panel\n",

        "name":"Write",
        "id":"toolu_01XCNtZTwPjWvTnpzWoMKeKE",
        "type":"tool_use",
        "caller":{
          "type":"direct"
        },
        "input":{
          "content":"# 204 — Visible interaction hints\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Current behavior\n\nThe editor has no visible instructions. A new user sees a blank canvas with\ntwo toolbar buttons (\"reload\", \"switch map\") and no indication of what to do.\nAll interactions are undiscoverable:\n- Double-click to create a box\n- Drag an output port to draw a wire\n- Click a wire then Delete to remove it\n- Space+drag or middle-mouse to pan\n- Scroll to zoom\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nThe canvas shows a short hint overlay when the map is empty or when nothing\nis selected. The hint disappears once the user has at least one box on the\ncanvas. It should not reappear after that.\n\nSuggested hint text (monospace, centered, dim):\n```\ndouble-click  create box\ndrag port →   draw wire\nspace+drag    pan\nscroll        zoom\n```\n\nAdditionally, the status bar at the bottom-left should reflect the current\ninteraction state:\n- Idle with boxes: \"N boxes loaded  —  double-click to create\"\n- Wire drawing in progress: \"drawing wire — release on an input port\"\n- Box selected: \"selected: <box-id>\"\n- Wire selected: \"wire selected — Delete to remove\"\n\n## Suggested implementation steps\n\n1. In the render loop (`005-app.js`), if `Boxes.boxes` is empty, draw the\n   hint text centered on the canvas using the canvas 2D context (not a DOM\n   overlay, so it transforms with the camera only for pan/zoom-invariant\n   display use `ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0)` before drawing).\n2. Update `status_msg` calls in mouse handlers to reflect interaction state.\n3. No persistent storage needed — the hint is purely runtime state based on\n   whether the boxes object is empty.\n\n## Related documents\n\n- assets/js/005-app.js — render loop, mouse handlers, status_msg\n- assets/js/001-canvas.js — start_frame / end_frame (canvas transform)\n",
          "file_path":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/issues/204-visible-interaction-hints.md"
        }

    "content":"# 204 — Visible interaction hints\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Current behavior\n\nThe editor has no visible instructions. A new user sees a blank canvas with\ntwo toolbar buttons (\"reload\", \"switch map\") and no indication of what to do.\nAll interactions are undiscoverable:\n- Double-click to create a box\n- Drag an output port to draw a wire\n- Click a wire then Delete to remove it\n- Space+drag or middle-mouse to pan\n- Scroll to zoom\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nThe canvas shows a short hint overlay when the map is empty or when nothing\nis selected. The hint disappears once the user has at least one box on the\ncanvas. It should not reappear after that.\n\nSuggested hint text (monospace, centered, dim):\n```\ndouble-click  create box\ndrag port →   draw wire\nspace+drag    pan\nscroll        zoom\n```\n\nAdditionally, the status bar at the bottom-left should reflect the current\ninteraction state:\n- Idle with boxes: \"N boxes loaded  —  double-click to create\"\n- Wire drawing in progress: \"drawing wire — release on an input port\"\n- Box selected: \"selected: <box-id>\"\n- Wire selected: \"wire selected — Delete to remove\"\n\n## Suggested implementation steps\n\n1. In the render loop (`005-app.js`), if `Boxes.boxes` is empty, draw the\n   hint text centered on the canvas using the canvas 2D context (not a DOM\n   overlay, so it transforms with the camera only for pan/zoom-invariant\n   display use `ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0)` before drawing).\n2. Update `status_msg` calls in mouse handlers to reflect interaction state.\n3. No persistent storage needed — the hint is purely runtime state based on\n   whether the boxes object is empty.\n\n## Related documents\n\n- assets/js/005-app.js — render loop, mouse handlers, status_msg\n- assets/js/001-canvas.js — start_frame / end_frame (canvas transform)\n",
    "userModified":false,

}

          "content":"# 206 — Entry box designation\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Current behavior\n\nThe entry box is set in `meta.json` (`entry_box_id` field), but the editor\nhas no way to show which box is the entry point or to change it. The user\nmust edit meta.json directly (via the server API or a text editor) to set or\nchange the entry box.\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nThe entry box is visually distinct on the canvas — a small marker or badge\n(e.g. a filled triangle or \"▶\" label) drawn in the top-left corner of the\nbox header.\n\nAny box can be designated as the entry box from the inspector. When a box is\nselected, a \"set as entry\" button appears at the top of the inspector panel.\nClicking it updates `meta.json` via PUT /maps/:name/meta and redraws the\ncanvas.\n\nOnly one box can be the entry at a time. Changing the entry box immediately\nupdates the visual marker on the canvas.\n\n## Suggested implementation steps\n\n1. In `005-app.js` `load_map()`, also fetch `meta.json` and store\n   `App.meta` (or a module-level variable) with the current entry_box_id.\n2. In `002-boxes.js` `draw_box()`, if `box.id === entry_box_id`, draw a\n   small \"▶\" badge in the header area (e.g., left of the label, in the\n   accent color for the box kind).\n3. In `004-inspector.js` `show()`, add a \"set as entry\" button at the top\n   of the inspector. On click: update the local entry_box_id, call\n   `API.put_meta({...meta, entry_box_id: box.id})`, mark canvas dirty.\n4. Pass `entry_box_id` into `draw_all` so the renderer knows which box to\n   mark.\n\n## Related documents\n\n- assets/js/002-boxes.js — draw_box\n- assets/js/004-inspector.js — show\n- assets/js/005-app.js — load_map, meta storage\n- assets/js/003-api.js — get_meta, put_meta\n- docs/001-architecture.md — meta.json format\n",

  "toolUseResult":{
    "content":"# 206 — Entry box designation\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Current behavior\n\nThe entry box is set in `meta.json` (`entry_box_id` field), but the editor\nhas no way to show which box is the entry point or to change it. The user\nmust edit meta.json directly (via the server API or a text editor) to set or\nchange the entry box.\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nThe entry box is visually distinct on the canvas — a small marker or badge\n(e.g. a filled triangle or \"▶\" label) drawn in the top-left corner of the\nbox header.\n\nAny box can be designated as the entry box from the inspector. When a box is\nselected, a \"set as entry\" button appears at the top of the inspector panel.\nClicking it updates `meta.json` via PUT /maps/:name/meta and redraws the\ncanvas.\n\nOnly one box can be the entry at a time. Changing the entry box immediately\nupdates the visual marker on the canvas.\n\n## Suggested implementation steps\n\n1. In `005-app.js` `load_map()`, also fetch `meta.json` and store\n   `App.meta` (or a module-level variable) with the current entry_box_id.\n2. In `002-boxes.js` `draw_box()`, if `box.id === entry_box_id`, draw a\n   small \"▶\" badge in the header area (e.g., left of the label, in the\n   accent color for the box kind).\n3. In `004-inspector.js` `show()`, add a \"set as entry\" button at the top\n   of the inspector. On click: update the local entry_box_id, call\n   `API.put_meta({...meta, entry_box_id: box.id})`, mark canvas dirty.\n4. Pass `entry_box_id` into `draw_all` so the renderer knows which box to\n   mark.\n\n## Related documents\n\n- assets/js/002-boxes.js — draw_box\n- assets/js/004-inspector.js — show\n- assets/js/005-app.js — load_map, meta storage\n- assets/js/003-api.js — get_meta, put_meta\n- docs/001-architecture.md — meta.json format\n",
    "userModified":false,
    "type":"create",
    "filePath":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/issues/206-entry-box-designation.md",
    "structuredPatch":[]
  }
}

    "originalFile":"// Top-level app: connects everything, loads the map, drives the render loop.\n\nconst App = (() => {\n  let selected_id   = null;\n  let drag_box_id   = null;\n  let drag_offset   = { x: 0, y: 0 };\n  let drawing_wire  = null;  // { from_box, from_port, from_side, cur_x, cur_y }\n  let hover_port    = null;\n  let status_el     = document.getElementById('status');\n\n  // {{{ status_msg\n  window.status_msg = function(msg, level = 'info') {\n    status_el.textContent = msg;\n    status_el.className   = 'status ' + level;\n  };\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ load_map\n  async function load_map() {\n    status_msg('loading…');\n    try {\n      const ids = await API.list_boxes();\n      const fetches = ids.map(id => API.get_box(id));\n      const all = await Promise.all(fetches);\n      // mutate the existing object so the draw_all closure sees the new boxes\n      Object.keys(Boxes.boxes).forEach(k => delete Boxes.boxes[k]);\n      all.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('loaded ' + ids.length + ' boxes');\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('load error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ new_box_at\n  async function new_box_at(wx, wy) {\n    const id = 'box-' + Date.now().toString(36);\n    const box = {\n      id, label: 'New Box', kind: 'call',\n      ref: '', fn: '', inputs: [], outputs: [], connections: [],\n      ui: { x: Math.round(wx), y: Math.round(wy) },\n    };\n    try {\n      await API.put_box(id, box);\n      Boxes.boxes[id] = box;\n      selected_id = id;\n      Inspector.show(box, () => Canvas.mark_dirty());\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('create error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ render\n  function render() {\n    if (Canvas.start_frame()) {\n      const ctx = Canvas.ctx;\n      Wires.draw_all(ctx, selected_id);\n      Boxes.draw_all(ctx, selected_id);\n\n      // draw in-progress wire\n      if (drawing_wire) {\n        const src = Boxes.get_port_world_pos(drawing_wire.from_box, drawing_wire.from_port, 'output');\n        if (src) {\n          Wires.draw_bezier(ctx, src.x, src.y, drawing_wire.cur_x, drawing_wire.cur_y,\n            '#6c72a0', false);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    requestAnimationFrame(render);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // Mouse interaction\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {\n    if (e.button !== 0) return;\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    // port hit?\n    const port = Boxes.hit_test_port(w.x, w.y);\n    if (port && port.side === 'output') {\n      drawing_wire = { from_box: port.box_id, from_port: port.port_name,\n                       cur_x: w.x, cur_y: w.y };\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // box hit?\n    const box_id = Boxes.hit_test_box(w.x, w.y);\n    if (box_id) {\n      selected_id = box_id;\n      drag_box_id = box_id;\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[box_id];\n      drag_offset = { x: w.x - (b.ui?.x ?? 0), y: w.y - (b.ui?.y ?? 0) };\n      Inspector.show(b, () => Canvas.mark_dirty());\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // click on empty space: deselect\n    selected_id = null;\n    Inspector.hide();\n    Canvas.mark_dirty();\n  });\n\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    if (drawing_wire) {\n      drawing_wire.cur_x = w.x;\n      drawing_wire.cur_y = w.y;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (drag_box_id) {\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[drag_box_id];\n      if (b) {\n        b.ui = b.ui || {};\n        b.ui.x = Math.round(w.x - drag_offset.x);\n        b.ui.y = Math.round(w.y - drag_offset.y);\n        Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mouseup', async e => {\n    if (e.button !== 0) return;\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    if (drawing_wire) {\n      const target_port = Boxes.hit_test_port(w.x, w.y);\n      if (target_port && target_port.side === 'input' &&\n          target_port.box_id !== drawing_wire.from_box) {\n        await Wires.create_connection(\n          drawing_wire.from_box, drawing_wire.from_port,\n          target_port.box_id, target_port.port_name\n        );\n      }\n      drawing_wire = null;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (drag_box_id) {\n      // persist position on mouseup\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[drag_box_id];\n      if (b) {\n        try { await API.put_box(b.id, b); }\n        catch(e) { status_msg('save position failed: ' + e.message, 'error'); }\n      }\n      drag_box_id = null;\n    }\n  });\n\n  // Double-click to create box\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('dblclick', async e => {\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n    if (!Boxes.hit_test_box(w.x, w.y)) {\n      await new_box_at(w.x, w.y);\n    }\n  });\n\n  // {{{ delete_box\n  // Shared deletion logic used by both the Delete key and the inspector button.\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    const b = Boxes.boxes[id];\n    if (!b) return;\n    const conns = (b.connections || []).filter(c => c.from_box === id);\n    if (conns.length > 0) {\n      const refs = conns.map(c => c.to_box).join(', ');\n      if (!confirm(`Box \"${id}\" has connections to: ${refs}.\\nDelete anyway?`)) return;\n    }\n    try {\n      await API.delete_box(id);\n      delete Boxes.boxes[id];\n      Inspector.hide();\n      selected_id = null;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('deleted ' + id);\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('delete error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // expose so Inspector can call it\n  window.App_delete_box = delete_box;\n\n  // Delete key: remove selected box or wire\n  window.addEventListener('keydown', async e => {\n    if (e.code !== 'Delete' && e.code !== 'Backspace') return;\n    if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT') return;\n\n    const sel_wire = Wires.selected_wire();\n    if (sel_wire) {\n      await Wires.delete_connection(sel_wire);\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (selected_id) await delete_box(selected_id);\n  });\n\n  // {{{ init\n  async function init() {\n    let server_url = localStorage.getItem('soramech_server') || '';\n    let map_name   = document.getElementById('map-label').textContent = map_name;\n    API.init(server_url, map_name);\n    await load_map();\n    requestAnimationFrame(render);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n status_msg\n  window.status_msg = function(msg, level = 'info') {\n    status_el.textContent = msg;\n    status_el.className   = 'status ' + level;\n  };\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ load_map\n  async function load_map() {\n    status_msg('loading…');\n    try {\n      const ids = await API.list_boxes();\n      const fetches = ids.map(id => API.get_box(id));\n      const all = await Promise.all(fetches);\n      // mutate the existing object so the draw_all closure sees the new boxes\n      Object.keys(Boxes.boxes).forEach(k => delete Boxes.boxes[k]);\n      all.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('loaded ' + ids.length + ' boxes');\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('load error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ new_box_at\n  async function new_box_at(wx, wy) {\n    const id = 'box-' + Date.now().toString(36);\n    const box = {\n      id, label: 'New Box', kind: 'call',\n      ref: '', fn: '', inputs: [], outputs: [], connections: [],\n      ui: { x: Math.round(wx), y: Math.round(wy) },\n    };\n    try {\n      await API.put_box(id, box);\n      Boxes.boxes[id] = box;\n      selected_id = id;\n      Inspector.show(box, () => Canvas.mark_dirty(), () => delete_box(id));\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('create error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ render\n  function render() {\n    if (Canvas.start_frame()) {\n      const ctx = Canvas.ctx;\n      Wires.draw_all(ctx, selected_id);\n      Boxes.draw_all(ctx, selected_id);\n\n      // draw in-progress wire\n      if (drawing_wire) {\n        const src = Boxes.get_port_world_pos(drawing_wire.from_box, drawing_wire.from_port, 'output');\n        if (src) {\n          Wires.draw_bezier(ctx, src.x, src.y, drawing_wire.cur_x, drawing_wire.cur_y,\n            '#6c72a0', false);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    requestAnimationFrame(render);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // Mouse interaction\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {\n    if (e.button !== 0) return;\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    // port hit?\n    const port = Boxes.hit_test_port(w.x, w.y);\n    if (port && port.side === 'output') {\n      drawing_wire = { from_box: port.box_id, from_port: port.port_name,\n                       cur_x: w.x, cur_y: w.y };\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // box hit?\n    const box_id = Boxes.hit_test_box(w.x, w.y);\n    if (box_id) {\n      selected_id = box_id;\n      drag_box_id = box_id;\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[box_id];\n      drag_offset = { x: w.x - (b.ui?.x ?? 0), y: w.y - (b.ui?.y ?? 0) };\n      Inspector.show(b, () => Canvas.mark_dirty());\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // click on empty space: deselect\n    selected_id = null;\n    Inspector.hide();\n    Canvas.mark_dirty();\n  });\n\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    if (drawing_wire) {\n      drawing_wire.cur_x = w.x;\n      drawing_wire.cur_y = w.y;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (drag_box_id) {\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[drag_box_id];\n      if (b) {\n        b.ui = b.ui || {};\n        b.ui.x = Math.round(w.x - drag_offset.x);\n        b.ui.y = Math.round(w.y - drag_offset.y);\n        Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mouseup', async e => {\n    if (e.button !== 0) return;\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    if (drawing_wire) {\n      const target_port = Boxes.hit_test_port(w.x, w.y);\n      if (target_port && target_port.side === 'input' &&\n          target_port.box_id !== drawing_wire.from_box) {\n        await Wires.create_connection(\n          drawing_wire.from_box, drawing_wire.from_port,\n          target_port.box_id, target_port.port_name\n        );\n      }\n      drawing_wire = null;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (drag_box_id) {\n      // persist position on mouseup\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[drag_box_id];\n      if (b) {\n        try { await API.put_box(b.id, b); }\n        catch(e) { status_msg('save position failed: ' + e.message, 'error'); }\n      }\n      drag_box_id = null;\n    }\n  });\n\n  // Double-click to create box\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('dblclick', async e => {\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n    if (!Boxes.hit_test_box(w.x, w.y)) {\n      await new_box_at(w.x, w.y);\n    }\n  });\n\n  // {{{ delete_box\n  // Shared deletion logic used by both the Delete key and the inspector button.\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    const b = Boxes.boxes[id];\n    if (!b) return;\n    const conns = (b.connections || []).filter(c => c.from_box === id);\n    if (conns.length > 0) {\n      const refs = conns.map(c => c.to_box).join(', ');\n      if (!confirm(`Box \"${id}\" has connections to: ${refs}.\\nDelete anyway?`)) return;\n    }\n    try {\n      await API.delete_box(id);\n      delete Boxes.boxes[id];\n      Inspector.hide();\n      selected_id = null;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('deleted ' + id);\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('delete error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // expose so Inspector can call it\n  window.App_delete_box = delete_box;\n\n  // Delete key: remove selected box or wire\n  window.addEventListener('keydown', async e => {\n    if (e.code !== 'Delete' && e.code !== 'Backspace') return;\n    if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT') return;\n\n    const sel_wire = Wires.selected_wire();\n    if (sel_wire) {\n      await Wires.delete_connection(sel_wire);\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (selected_id) await delete_box(selected_id);\n  });\n\n  // {{{ init\n  async function init() {\n    let server_url = localStorage.getItem('soramech_server') || '';\n    let map_name   = localStorage.getItem('soramech_map')    || '';\n\n    if (!server_url || !map_name) {\n      server_url = prompt('Server URL:', 'http://localhost:7700') || 'http://localhost:7700';\n      map_name   = document.getElementById('map-label').textContent = map_name;\n    API.init(server_url, map_name);\n    await load_map();\n    requestAnimationFrame(render);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);\n  return { load_map };\n})();\n",

        "content":"// Inspector sidebar: shows and edits the selected box's fields.\n// Fires PUT to the server on every field change (autosave).\n// For call boxes, ref/fn are set via the file browser; ports are read-only and derived.\n\nconst Inspector = (() => {\n  const panel  = document.getElementById('inspector');\n  const title  = document.getElementById('inspector-title');\n  const fields = document.getElementById('inspector-fields');\n\n  let current_box  = null;\n  let on_change_cb = null;\n  let on_delete_cb = null;\n\n  // {{{ hide\n  function hide() {\n    panel.classList.add('hidden');\n    current_box  = null;\n    on_delete_cb = null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ save\n  async function save() {\n    if (!current_box) return;\n    try {\n      await API.put_box(current_box.id, current_box);\n      if (on_change_cb) on_change_cb(current_box);\n    } catch(e) {\n      console.error('autosave failed:', e.message);\n      status_msg('save error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_row\n  function mk_row(label_text, input_el) {\n    const row = document.createElement('div');\n    row.className = 'field-row';\n    const lbl = document.createElement('label');\n    lbl.textContent = label_text;\n    row.appendChild(lbl);\n    row.appendChild(input_el);\n    return row;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_text_input\n  function mk_text_input(value, on_input) {\n    const inp = document.createElement('input');\n    inp.type  = 'text';\n    inp.value = value || '';\n    inp.addEventListener('input', () => { on_input(inp.value); save(); });\n    return inp;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_readonly\n  function mk_readonly(value) {\n    const el = document.createElement('div');\n    el.className   = 'field-readonly';\n    el.textContent = value || '—';\n    return el;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_port_display\n  // Read-only list of derived port names.\n  function mk_port_display(ports) {\n    const wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    wrap.className = 'port-display';\n    if (!ports || ports.length === 0) {\n      const empty = document.createElement('span');\n      empty.className   = 'port-display-empty';\n      empty.textContent = '(none)';\n      wrap.appendChild(empty);\n    } else {\n      ports.forEach(p => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className   = 'port-display-row';\n        row.textContent = p.name + (p.type && p.type !== 'any' ? '  :' + p.type : '');\n        wrap.appendChild(row);\n      });\n    }\n    return wrap;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_branch_port_list\n  const OPS = ['eq','lt','gt','lte','gte','contains','matches'];\n  function mk_branch_port_list(ports, on_change) {\n    const wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    wrap.className = 'port-list';\n\n    const render_ports = () => {\n      wrap.innerHTML = '';\n      ports.forEach((p, i) => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className = 'port-row branch-port-row';\n\n        const name_inp = document.createElement('input');\n        name_inp.type  = 'text';\n        name_inp.value = p.name || '';\n        name_inp.placeholder = 'port name';\n        name_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].name = name_inp.value; on_change(); save(); });\n        row.appendChild(name_inp);\n\n        if (p.name !== 'else') {\n          if (!p.predicate) p.predicate = { op: 'eq', value: '' };\n\n          const op_sel = document.createElement('select');\n          OPS.forEach(op => {\n            const opt = document.createElement('option');\n            opt.value = op; opt.textContent = op;\n            if (op === p.predicate.op) opt.selected = true;\n            op_sel.appendChild(opt);\n          });\n          op_sel.addEventListener('change', () => { ports[i].predicate.op = op_sel.value; save(); });\n\n          const val_inp = document.createElement('input');\n          val_inp.type  = 'text';\n          val_inp.value = p.predicate.value ?? '';\n          val_inp.placeholder = 'value';\n          val_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { ports[i].predicate.value = val_inp.value; save(); });\n\n          row.appendChild(op_sel);\n          row.appendChild(val_inp);\n        }\n\n        if (p.name !== 'else') {\n          const del_btn = document.createElement('button');\n          del_btn.textContent = '×';\n          del_btn.className   = 'port-del';\n          del_btn.addEventListener('click', () => { ports.splice(i, 1); render_ports(); on_change(); save(); });\n          row.appendChild(del_btn);\n        }\n\n        wrap.appendChild(row);\n      });\n\n      const add_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      add_btn.textContent = '+ port';\n      add_btn.className   = 'add-port';\n      add_btn.addEventListener('click', () => {\n        const else_i = ports.findIndex(p => p.name === 'else');\n        const new_port = { name: '', predicate: { op: 'eq', value: '' } };\n        if (else_i >= 0) ports.splice(else_i, 0, new_port);\n        else ports.push(new_port);\n        render_ports(); on_change(); save();\n      });\n      wrap.appendChild(add_btn);\n    };\n\n    render_ports();\n    return wrap;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ open_browser\n  // Replaces inspector content with the file browser.\n  // On function select: populates ref/fn/inputs/outputs and returns to normal view.\n  function open_browser() {\n    title.textContent = 'browse src/';\n    fields.innerHTML  = '';\n    FileBrowser.render(fields, (filename, fn) => {\n      current_box.ref     = filename;\n      current_box.fn      = fn.name;\n      current_box.inputs  = fn.inputs.map(n  => ({ name: n, type: 'any' }));\n      current_box.outputs = fn.outputs.map(n => ({ name: n, type: 'any' }));\n      save().then(() => show(current_box, on_change_cb));\n    });\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ show\n  function show(box, on_changed, on_delete) {\n    current_box  = box;\n    on_change_cb = on_changed;\n    on_delete_cb = on_delete || null;\n    panel.classList.remove('hidden');\n    title.textContent = box.id;\n    fields.innerHTML  = '';\n\n    // delete button — always visible at the top of the inspector\n    if (on_delete_cb) {\n      const del_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      del_btn.textContent = 'delete box';\n      del_btn.className   = 'delete-box-btn';\n      del_btn.onclick     = () => on_delete_cb();\n      fields.appendChild(del_btn);\n    }\n\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('label',\n      mk_text_input(box.label, v => { current_box.label = v; })));\n\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('kind', (() => {\n      const sel = document.createElement('select');\n      ['call','branch','data'].forEach(k => {\n        const opt = document.createElement('option');\n        opt.value = k; opt.textContent = k;\n        if (k === box.kind) opt.selected = true;\n        sel.appendChild(opt);\n      });\n      sel.addEventListener('change', () => {\n        current_box.kind = sel.value;\n        show(current_box, on_change_cb);\n        save();\n      });\n      return sel;\n    })()));\n\n    if (box.kind === 'call' || box.kind === 'data') {\n      // ref: read-only display + browse button\n      const ref_wrap = document.createElement('div');\n      ref_wrap.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;';\n      const ref_disp = document.createElement('div');\n      ref_disp.className   = 'field-readonly';\n      ref_disp.style.flex  = '1';\n      ref_disp.style.minWidth = '0';\n      ref_disp.style.overflow = 'hidden';\n      ref_disp.style.textOverflow = 'ellipsis';\n      ref_disp.style.whiteSpace   = 'nowrap';\n      ref_disp.textContent = box.ref || '—';\n      const browse_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      browse_btn.className   = 'toolbar-btn';\n      browse_btn.textContent = 'browse';\n      browse_btn.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';\n      browse_btn.onclick = open_browser;\n      ref_wrap.appendChild(ref_disp);\n      ref_wrap.appendChild(browse_btn);\n      fields.appendChild(mk_row('ref', ref_wrap));\n\n      fields.appendChild(mk_row('fn', mk_readonly(box.fn)));\n\n      const in_sec = document.createElement('div');\n      in_sec.className   = 'section-label';\n      in_sec.textContent = 'inputs';\n      fields.appendChild(in_sec);\n      fields.appendChild(mk_port_display(box.inputs));\n\n      const out_sec = document.createElement('div');\n      out_sec.className   = 'section-label';\n      out_sec.textContent = 'outputs';\n      fields.appendChild(out_sec);\n      fields.appendChild(mk_port_display(box.outputs));\n    }\n\n    if (box.kind === 'branch') {\n      if (!current_box.ports) current_box.ports = [{ name: 'else' }];\n      fields.appendChild(mk_row('retry limit',\n        mk_text_input(String(box.retry_limit ?? 3),\n          v => { current_box.retry_limit = parseInt(v) || 3; })));\n\n      // branch inputs are manually configured (no source file to parse)\n      const in_sec = document.createElement('div');\n      in_sec.className   = 'section-label';\n      in_sec.textContent = 'inputs';\n      fields.appendChild(in_sec);\n      if (!current_box.inputs) current_box.inputs = [];\n      const in_list = document.createElement('div');\n      in_list.className = 'port-list';\n      (current_box.inputs || []).forEach((p, i) => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className = 'port-row';\n        const ni = document.createElement('input');\n        ni.type = 'text'; ni.value = p.name || ''; ni.placeholder = 'name';\n        ni.addEventListener('input', () => { current_box.inputs[i].name = ni.value; save(); });\n        const ti = document.createElement('input');\n        ti.type = 'text'; ti.value = p.type || ''; ti.placeholder = 'type';\n        ti.addEventListener('input', () => { current_box.inputs[i].type = ti.value; save(); });\n        const del = document.createElement('button');\n        del.textContent = '×'; del.className = 'port-del';\n        del.addEventListener('click', () => {\n          current_box.inputs.splice(i, 1);\n          show(current_box, on_change_cb);\n          save();\n        });\n        row.appendChild(ni); row.appendChild(ti); row.appendChild(del);\n        in_list.appendChild(row);\n      });\n      const add_in = document.createElement('button');\n      add_in.textContent = '+ input'; add_in.className = 'add-port';\n      add_in.addEventListener('click', () => {\n        current_box.inputs.push({ name: '', type: 'any' });\n        show(current_box, on_change_cb);\n        save();\n      });\n      in_list.appendChild(add_in);\n      fields.appendChild(in_list);\n\n      const ports_sec = document.createElement('div');\n      ports_sec.className   = 'section-label';\n      ports_sec.textContent = 'ports (evaluated top-to-bottom)';\n      fields.appendChild(ports_sec);\n      fields.appendChild(mk_branch_port_list(current_box.ports, () => {}));\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { show, hide };\n})();\n",

        "content":"// Top-level app: connects everything, loads the map, drives the render loop.\n\nconst App = (() => {\n  let selected_id   = null;\n  let drag_box_id   = null;\n  let drag_offset   = { x: 0, y: 0 };\n  let drawing_wire  = null;  // { from_box, from_port, from_side, cur_x, cur_y }\n  let hover_port    = null;\n  let status_el     = document.getElementById('status');\n\n  // {{{ status_msg\n  window.status_msg = function(msg, level = 'info') {\n    status_el.textContent = msg;\n    status_el.className   = 'status ' + level;\n  };\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ load_map\n  async function load_map() {\n    status_msg('loading…');\n    try {\n      const ids = await API.list_boxes();\n      const fetches = ids.map(id => API.get_box(id));\n      const all = await Promise.all(fetches);\n      // mutate the existing object so the draw_all closure sees the new boxes\n      Object.keys(Boxes.boxes).forEach(k => delete Boxes.boxes[k]);\n      all.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('loaded ' + ids.length + ' boxes');\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('load error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ new_box_at\n  async function new_box_at(wx, wy) {\n    const id = 'box-' + Date.now().toString(36);\n    const box = {\n      id, label: 'New Box', kind: 'call',\n      ref: '', fn: '', inputs: [], outputs: [], connections: [],\n      ui: { x: Math.round(wx), y: Math.round(wy) },\n    };\n    try {\n      await API.put_box(id, box);\n      Boxes.boxes[id] = box;\n      selected_id = id;\n      Inspector.show(box, () => Canvas.mark_dirty(), () => delete_box(id));\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('create error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ render\n  function render() {\n    if (Canvas.start_frame()) {\n      const ctx = Canvas.ctx;\n      Wires.draw_all(ctx, selected_id);\n      Boxes.draw_all(ctx, selected_id);\n\n      // draw in-progress wire\n      if (drawing_wire) {\n        const src = Boxes.get_port_world_pos(drawing_wire.from_box, drawing_wire.from_port, 'output');\n        if (src) {\n          Wires.draw_bezier(ctx, src.x, src.y, drawing_wire.cur_x, drawing_wire.cur_y,\n            '#6c72a0', false);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    requestAnimationFrame(render);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // Mouse interaction\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {\n    if (e.button !== 0) return;\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    // port hit?\n    const port = Boxes.hit_test_port(w.x, w.y);\n    if (port && port.side === 'output') {\n      drawing_wire = { from_box: port.box_id, from_port: port.port_name,\n                       cur_x: w.x, cur_y: w.y };\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // box hit?\n    const box_id = Boxes.hit_test_box(w.x, w.y);\n    if (box_id) {\n      selected_id = box_id;\n      drag_box_id = box_id;\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[box_id];\n      drag_offset = { x: w.x - (b.ui?.x ?? 0), y: w.y - (b.ui?.y ?? 0) };\n      Inspector.show(b, () => Canvas.mark_dirty(), () => delete_box(box_id));\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // click on empty space: deselect\n    selected_id = null;\n    Inspector.hide();\n    Canvas.mark_dirty();\n  });\n\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    if (drawing_wire) {\n      drawing_wire.cur_x = w.x;\n      drawing_wire.cur_y = w.y;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (drag_box_id) {\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[drag_box_id];\n      if (b) {\n        b.ui = b.ui || {};\n        b.ui.x = Math.round(w.x - drag_offset.x);\n        b.ui.y = Math.round(w.y - drag_offset.y);\n        Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mouseup', async e => {\n    if (e.button !== 0) return;\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    if (drawing_wire) {\n      const target_port = Boxes.hit_test_port(w.x, w.y);\n      if (target_port && target_port.side === 'input' &&\n          target_port.box_id !== drawing_wire.from_box) {\n        await Wires.create_connection(\n          drawing_wire.from_box, drawing_wire.from_port,\n          target_port.box_id, target_port.port_name\n        );\n      }\n      drawing_wire = null;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (drag_box_id) {\n      // persist position on mouseup\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[drag_box_id];\n      if (b) {\n        try { await API.put_box(b.id, b); }\n        catch(e) { status_msg('save position failed: ' + e.message, 'error'); }\n      }\n      drag_box_id = null;\n    }\n  });\n\n  // Double-click to create box\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('dblclick', async e => {\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n    if (!Boxes.hit_test_box(w.x, w.y)) {\n      await new_box_at(w.x, w.y);\n    }\n  });\n\n  // {{{ delete_box\n  // Shared deletion logic used by both the Delete key and the inspector button.\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    const b = Boxes.boxes[id];\n    if (!b) return;\n    const conns = (b.connections || []).filter(c => c.from_box === id);\n    if (conns.length > 0) {\n      const refs = conns.map(c => c.to_box).join(', ');\n      if (!confirm(`Box \"${id}\" has connections to: ${refs}.\\nDelete anyway?`)) return;\n    }\n    try {\n      await API.delete_box(id);\n      delete Boxes.boxes[id];\n      Inspector.hide();\n      selected_id = null;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('deleted ' + id);\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('delete error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // expose so Inspector can call it\n  window.App_delete_box = delete_box;\n\n  // Delete key: remove selected box or wire\n  window.addEventListener('keydown', async e => {\n    if (e.code !== 'Delete' && e.code !== 'Backspace') return;\n    if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT') return;\n\n    const sel_wire = Wires.selected_wire();\n    if (sel_wire) {\n      await Wires.delete_connection(sel_wire);\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (selected_id) await delete_box(selected_id);\n  });\n\n  // {{{ init\n  async function init() {\n    let server_url = localStorage.getItem('soramech_server') || '';\n    let map_name   = localStorage.getItem('soramech_map')    || '';\n\n    if (!server_url || !map_name) {\n      server_url = prompt('Server URL:', 'http://localhost:7700') || 'http://localhost:7700';\n      map_name   = prompt('Map name:',   'hello')                || 'hello';\n      localStorage.setItem('soramech_server', server_url);\n      localStorage.setItem('soramech_map',    map_name);\n    }\n\n    document.getElementById('map-label').textContent = map_name;\n    API.init(server_url, map_name);\n    await load_map();\n    requestAnimationFrame(render);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);\n  return { load_map };\n})();\n",

        "content":"# Phase 2 Progress\n\nGoal: an editor you can actually use to build maps.\n\n## Issues\n\n| ID  | Title                                          | Status   |\n|-----|------------------------------------------------|----------|\n| 201 | fix box rendering closure bug                  | complete |\n| 202 | fit-to-view on map load                        | open     |\n| 203 | map picker panel                               | open     |\n| 204 | visible interaction hints                      | open     |\n| 206 | entry box designation                          | open     |\n| 207 | source file browser and port auto-population   | complete |\n\n## Phase goal checklist\n\n- [x] Boxes render on map load\n- [x] Clicking a box opens the inspector\n- [x] Ref/fn set by browsing src/ files; ports auto-derived\n- [ ] Map loads centered on screen (fit-to-view)\n- [ ] Map can be switched from a list, not a text prompt\n- [ ] Empty canvas shows interaction hints\n- [ ] Entry box is visually marked and settable from the editor\n",

        "content":"# 206 — Entry box designation\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Current behavior\n\nThe entry box is set in `meta.json` (`entry_box_id` field), but the editor\nhas no way to show which box is the entry point or to change it. The user\nmust edit meta.json directly (via the server API or a text editor) to set or\nchange the entry box.\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nThe entry box is visually distinct on the canvas — a small marker or badge\n(e.g. a filled triangle or \"▶\" label) drawn in the top-left corner of the\nbox header.\n\nAny box can be designated as the entry box from the inspector. When a box is\nselected, a \"set as entry\" button appears at the top of the inspector panel.\nClicking it updates `meta.json` via PUT /maps/:name/meta and redraws the\ncanvas.\n\nOnly one box can be the entry at a time. Changing the entry box immediately\nupdates the visual marker on the canvas.\n\n## Suggested implementation steps\n\n1. In `005-app.js` `load_map()`, also fetch `meta.json` and store\n   `App.meta` (or a module-level variable) with the current entry_box_id.\n2. In `002-boxes.js` `draw_box()`, if `box.id === entry_box_id`, draw a\n   small \"▶\" badge in the header area (e.g., left of the label, in the\n   accent color for the box kind).\n3. In `004-inspector.js` `show()`, add a \"set as entry\" button at the top\n   of the inspector. On click: update the local entry_box_id, call\n   `API.put_meta({...meta, entry_box_id: box.id})`, mark canvas dirty.\n4.       "file":{
        "content":"# 204 — Visible interaction hints\n\n## Status\n\nopen\n\n## Current behavior\n\nThe editor has no visible instructions. A new user sees a blank canvas with\ntwo toolbar buttons (\"reload\", \"switch map\") and no indication of what to do.\nAll interactions are undiscoverable:\n- Double-click to create a box\n- Drag an output port to draw a wire\n- Click a wire then Delete to remove it\n- Space+drag or middle-mouse to pan\n- Scroll to zoom\n\n## Intended behavior\n\nThe canvas shows a short hint overlay when the map is empty or when nothing\nis selected. The hint disappears once the user has at least one box on the\ncanvas. It should not reappear after that.\n\nSuggested hint text (monospace, centered, dim):\n```\ndouble-click  create box\ndrag port →   draw wire\nspace+drag    pan\nscroll        zoom\n```\n\nAdditionally, the status bar at the bottom-left should reflect the current\ninteraction state:\n- Idle with boxes: \"N boxes loaded  —  double-click to create\"\n- Wire drawing in progress: \"drawing wire — release on an input port\"\n- Box selected: \"selected: <box-id>\"\n- Wire selected: \"wire selected — Delete to remove\"\n\n## Suggested implementation steps\n\n1. In the render loop (`005-app.js`), if `Boxes.boxes` is empty, draw the\n   hint text centered on the canvas using the canvas 2D context (not a DOM\n   overlay, so it transforms with the camera only for pan/zoom-invariant\n   display use `ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0)` before drawing).\n2. Update `status_msg` calls in mouse handlers to reflect interaction state.\n3. No persistent storage needed — the hint is purely runtime state based on\n   whether the boxes object is empty.\n\n## Related documents\n\n- assets/js/005-app.js — render loop, mouse handlers, status_msg\n- assets/js/001-canvas.js — start_frame / end_frame (canvas transform)\n",
        "startLine":1,
        "totalLines":53,

render_fn_list(container, filename, fns, on_select, on_back) {\n    container.innerHTML = '';\n\n    const back_btn = document.createElement('button');\n    back_btn.className   = 'fb-back';\n    back_btn.textContent = '← ' + filename;\n    back_btn.onclick     = on_back;\n    container.appendChild(back_btn);\n\n    if (fns === null) {\n      const note = document.createElement('div');\n      note.className   = 'fb-note';\n      note.textContent = 'no parser for .' + filename.split('.').pop() + ' files';\n      container.appendChild(note);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (fns.length === 0) {\n      const note = document.createElement('div');\n      note.className   = 'fb-note';\n      note.textContent = 'no public functions found (expected: function M.name(...))';\n      container.appendChild(note);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    fns.forEach(fn => {\n      const row = document.createElement('div');\n      row.className = 'fb-fn-row';\n\n      const name_el = document.createElement('div');\n      name_el.className   = 'fb-fn-name';\n      name_el.textContent = fn.name + '(' + fn.inputs.join(', ') + ')';\n      row.appendChild(name_el);\n\n      const in_el = document.createElement('div');\n      in_el.className   = 'fb-fn-ports';\n      in_el.textContent = 'in:  ' + (fn.inputs.length ? fn.inputs.join(', ') : '(none)');\n      row.appendChild(in_el);\n\n      const out_el = document.createElement('div');\n      out_el.className   = 'fb-fn-ports';\n      out_el.textContent = 'out: ' + (fn.outputs.length ? fn.outputs.join(', ') : '(none)');\n      row.appendChild(out_el);\n\n      row.onclick = () => on_select(filename, fn);\n      container.appendChild(row);\n    });\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ render\n  // Renders the full file browser into container.\n  // on_select(filename, fn_obj) called when the user picks a function.\n  async function render(container, on_select) {\n    container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note\">loading src/…</div>';\n\n    let files;\n    try {\n      files = await API.list_src_files();\n    } catch (e) {\n      container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note error\">could not list src/: ' + e.message + '</div>';\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (!files || files.length === 0) {\n      container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note\">src/ is empty — add source files to the map</div>';\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // show file list\n    const show_file_list = () => {\n      container.innerHTML = '';\n      const hdr = document.createElement('div');\n      hdr.className   = 'fb-header';\n      hdr.textContent = 'src/';\n      container.appendChild(hdr);\n\n      files.forEach(filename => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className   = 'fb-file-row';\n        row.textContent = filename;\n        row.onclick     = async () => {\n          row.textContent = filename + ' …';\n          let content;\n          try {\n            content = await API.get_src_file(filename);\n          } catch (e) {\n            container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note error\">could not read ' + filename + ': ' + e.message + '</div>';\n            show_file_list();\n            return;\n          }\n          const fns = parse_functions(content, filename);\n          render_fn_list(container, filename, fns,\n            (f, fn) => on_select(f, fn),\n            show_file_list\n          );\n        };\n        container.appendChild(row);\n      });\n    };\n\n    show_file_list();\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { parse_functions, render };\n})();\n",

    "originalFile":"// Thin fetch wrapper for the soramech-server REST API.\n// All functions are async and throw on non-2xx responses.\n\nconst API = (() => {\n  let base_url = '';\n  let map_name = '';\n\n  // {{{ init\n  function init(url, name) { base_url = url.replace(/\\/$/, ''); map_name = name; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ request\n  async function request(method, path, body) {\n    const opts = { method, headers: {} };\n    if (body !== undefined) {\n      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';\n      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);\n    }\n    const res = await fetch(base_url + path, opts);\n    const text = await res.text();\n    let data;\n    try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { data = { error: text }; }\n    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);\n    return data;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_maps\n  async function list_maps() { return request('GET', '/maps'); }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_boxes\n  async function list_boxes() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_box\n  async function get_box(id) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_box\n  async function put_box(id, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ delete_box\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    return request('DELETE', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_meta\n  async function get_meta() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_meta\n  async function put_meta(data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_src_files\n  async function list_src_files() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/src`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_src_file\n  async function get_src_file(filename) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/src/${encodeURIComponent(filename)}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_data\n  async function get_data(filename) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_data\n  async function put_data(filename, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { init, list_maps, list_boxes, get_box, put_box, delete_box,\n           get_meta, put_meta, get_data, put_data,\n           list_src_files, get_src_file };\n})();\n",

    "content":"alright now for both of the two example files it just says \"M\" as the output. What does that mean? Also, when we hook up a wire, it should display both the datatype (if known, lua doesn't always keep track of that sort of thing) and the variable name. We should be able to rename the variables as well - in the right-side panel where it says \"inputs\" and \"outputs\" we should be able to rename both of them.\n\nalso, can we make a section for values that can be modified on a per-box basis? stuff that doesn't need to be passed in, but can still be tweaked on the box. I'm thinking this should be just, variables that are defined at the top of the function, but I'm not sure how to implement that with user-defined functions. The user should be able to take a library they downloaded off the internet and drop it in the src/ directory and we should be able to fully utilize it, so if we enforce a certain norm (like, you must define variables at the top) then it'll break most of the libraries we download. What do you think we should do for that?"
  },

        "content":"-- Hello function for the hello example map.\n-- Reads the name from data/state.json and returns a greeting string.\n-- No inputs: name comes from the map's data file at runtime.\n\nlocal json = require(\"dkjson\")\nlocal M    = {}\n\n-- {{{ read_name\nlocal function read_name(map_dir)\n    -- walk up from this file's location to find the map root's data/state.json\n    local state_path = map_dir .. \"/data/state.json\"\n    local f = io.open(state_path, \"r\")\n    if not f then return \"world\" end\n    local raw  = f:read(\"*a\")\n    f:close()\n    local obj, _, _ = json.decode(raw)\n    if not obj then return \"world\" end\n    local name_field = obj.fields and obj.fields.name\n    if not name_field then return \"world\" end\n    return name_field.value or \"world\"\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ hello\nfunction M.hello()\n    -- SORAMECH_MAP_DIR is injected by the lua driver shim at invocation time\n    local name = read_name(SORAMECH_MAP_DIR or \".\")\n    return \"Hello, \" .. tostring(name) .. \"!\"\nend\n-- }}}\n\nreturn M",

    "stdout":"-- Hello function for the hello example map.\n-- Reads the name from data/state.json and returns a greeting string.\n-- No inputs: name comes from the map's data file at runtime.\n\nlocal json = require(\"dkjson\")\nlocal M    = {}\n\n-- {{{ read_name\nlocal function read_name(map_dir)\n    -- walk up from this file's location to find the map root's data/state.json\n    local state_path = map_dir .. \"/data/state.json\"\n    local f = io.open(state_path, \"r\")\n    if not f then return \"world\" end\n    local raw  = f:read(\"*a\")\n    f:close()\n    local obj, _, _ = json.decode(raw)\n    if not obj then return \"world\" end\n    local name_field = obj.fields and obj.fields.name\n    if not name_field then return \"world\" end\n    return name_field.value or \"world\"\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ hello\nfunction M.hello()\n    -- SORAMECH_MAP_DIR is injected by the lua driver shim at invocation time\n    local name = read_name(SORAMECH_MAP_DIR or \".\")\n    return \"Hello, \" .. tostring(name) .. \"!\"\nend\n-- }}}\n\nreturn M"

        "text":"Good. No server restart needed — reload the page.\n\n---\n\n**On per-box values:** you're right that parsing variable definitions from arbitrary downloaded libraries is a non-starter. Two approaches worth considering:\n\n**Option A — Manual \"config\" table on the box.** Add a `box.config` field (key-value pairs, editable in the inspector). At runtime the runner injects them as a Lua global table before calling the function, or passes them as an extra argument. Works with any library, zero source parsing needed. The user decides which knobs exist.\n\n**Option B — Use the existing data/ system.** Each box can already read from `data/*.json` files at runtime via `SORAMECH_MAP_DIR`. The inspector could just show a \"linked data file\" picker. Less editor overhead, already implemented.\n\nMy recommendation is **Option A** — a lightweight `box.config` section in the inspector (a simple add/remove key-value list, same pattern as the branch ports UI). It's self-contained per box, visible at a glance, and doesn't require the user to know the data/ directory layout. The runner side just needs one extra injected global before the function call.\n\nWant me to sketch the runner injection side so you can decide if the contract makes sense before building the UI?"

{
  "isSidechain":false,
  "timestamp":"2026-05-08T00:58:07.870Z",
  "slug":"reactive-toasting-squid",
  "gitBranch":"HEAD",
  "version":"2.1.121",
  "sessionId":"2029ad16-5678-4b15-931f-3f52d826597a",
  "message":{
    "content":[{
        "type":"text",
        "text":"Good call — narrowing scope to your actual use case is the right move.\n\nHere's the convention I'd propose for Lua:\n\n```lua\nfunction M.classify(text)\n  local values = {\n    keyword        = \"SoraMech\",\n    case_sensitive = false,\n    max_retries    = 3,\n  }\n  -- rest of function uses values.keyword, etc.\n  return result\nend\n```\n\nThe parser already scans the function body — it just needs to also look for `local values = {` and extract the key/default-value pairs. The inspector shows them as editable fields. The box stores overrides in `box.values`. At runtime, the Lua driver sets a `SORAMECH_VALUES` global with the box's overrides before calling the function, and you write:\n\n```lua\nlocal values = SORAMECH_VALUES or {\n  keyword = \"SoraMech\",\n  ...\n}\n```\n\nOr we add a one-liner helper to `libs/soramech-data.lua` so you don't write that every time:\n\n```lua\nlocal values = sora.values({ keyword = \"SoraMech\", ... })\n-- (merges SORAMECH_VALUES overrides on top of your defaults)\n```\n\nFor **C** it's harder since it's compiled. The natural approach there is: the C function reads a config file from `SORAMECH_MAP_DIR/tmp/<box_id>_values.json` that the runner writes before invoking it. Slightly more boilerplate, but the pattern is the same.\n\nMy honest take: this is a solid convention. It's readable, self-documenting, and the defaults live right next to the code that uses them. The one thing to decide before building it is the variable name — `values` vs `config` vs `params`. I'd lean toward `config` since `values` is a common local variable name that might collide accidentally.\n\nShould I start with the parser side (extract `local config = {` blocks in the file browser) or the runner injection side first?"
      }],
