inputs are read-only, derived from parsing.\n\nconst Inspector = (() => {\n  const panel  = document.getElementById('inspector');\n  const title  = document.getElementById('inspector-title');\n  const fields = document.getElementById('inspector-fields');\n\n  let current_box  = null;\n  let on_change_cb = null;\n  let on_delete_cb = null;\n\n  // {{{ hide\n  function hide() {\n    panel.classList.add('hidden');\n    current_box  = null;\n    on_delete_cb = null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ save\n  async function save() {\n    if (!current_box) return;\n    try {\n      await API.put_box(current_box.id, current_box);\n      if (on_change_cb) on_change_cb(current_box);\n    } catch(e) {\n      console.error('autosave failed:', e.message);\n      status_msg('save error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_row\n  function mk_row(label_text, input_el) {\n    const row = document.createElement('div');\n    row.className = 'field-row';\n    const lbl = document.createElement('label');\n    lbl.textContent = label_text;\n    row.appendChild(lbl);\n    row.appendChild(input_el);\n    return row;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_text_input\n  function mk_text_input(value, on_input) {\n    const inp = document.createElement('input');\n    inp.type  = 'text';\n    inp.value = value || '';\n    inp.addEventListener('input', () => { on_input(inp.value); save(); });\n    return inp;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_readonly\n  function mk_readonly(value) {\n    const el = document.createElement('div');\n    el.className   = 'field-readonly';\n    el.textContent = value || '—';\n    return el;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_port_display\n  // Renders input ports as read-only name labels with an optional literal value field.\n  // Names are derived from source parsing and are not editable here.\n  function mk_port_display(ports) {\n    const wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    wrap.className = 'port-display';\n    if (!ports || ports.length === 0) {\n      const empty = document.createElement('span');\n      empty.className   = 'port-display-empty';\n      empty.textContent = '(none)';\n      wrap.appendChild(empty);\n    } else {\n      ports.forEach((p, i) => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className = 'port-display-row';\n\n        // name is read-only — derived from function signature via file browser\n        const name_el = document.createElement('span');\n        name_el.className   = 'port-name-inp';\n        name_el.textContent = p.name || '';\n        name_el.style.color = '#9ea3c0';\n        row.appendChild(name_el);\n\n        if (p.type && p.type !== 'any') {\n          const type_el = document.createElement('span');\n          type_el.className   = 'port-type';\n          type_el.textContent = ':' + p.type;\n          row.appendChild(type_el);\n        }\n\n        // literal value input — empty means \"no literal\" (wire will supply the value)\n        const val_inp = document.createElement('input');\n        val_inp.type        = 'text';\n        val_inp.value       = p.value !== undefined ? String(p.value) : '';\n        val_inp.placeholder = 'value…';\n        val_inp.className   = 'port-val-inp';\n        val_inp.addEventListener('input', () => {\n          ports[i].value = val_inp.value === '' ? undefined : val_inp.value;\n          save();\n        });\n        row.appendChild(val_inp);\n\n        wrap.appendChild(row);\n      });\n    }\n    return wrap;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ open_browser\n  // Replaces inspector content with the file browser.\n  // On function select: sets ref/fn/inputs from parsed signature (no outputs — single wire).\n  function open_browser() {\n    title.textContent = 'browse src/';\n    fields.innerHTML  = '';\n    FileBrowser.render(fields, (filename, fn) => {\n      current_box.ref    = filename;\n      current_box.fn     = fn.name;\n      current_box.inputs = fn.inputs.map(n => ({ name: n, type: 'any' }));\n      // outputs are not set — all boxes have exactly one output wire\n      save().then(() => show(current_box, on_change_cb, on_delete_cb));\n    });\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ show_content\n  // Renders arbitrary content into the inspector panel without a box context.\n  // Used by the map panel.classList.remove('hidden');\n    title.innerHTML   = '';\n    title.textContent = title_text;\n    fields.innerHTML  = '';\n    render_fn(fields);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ show\n  function = { x: 0, y: 0 };\n  let drawing_wire  = null;  // { from_box, from_port, cur_x, cur_y }\n  let hover_port    = null;\n  let status_el     = document.getElementById('status');\n\n  // tool_mode: }}}\n\n  // {{{ load_map\n  async function load_map() {\n    status_msg('loading…');\n    try {\n      const ids = await API.list_boxes();\n      const fetches = ids.map(id => API.get_box(id));\n      const all = await Promise.all(fetches);\n      // mutate the existing object so the draw_all closure sees the new boxes\n      Object.keys(Boxes.boxes).forEach(k => delete Boxes.boxes[k]);\n      all.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('loaded ' + ids.length + ' boxes');\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('load error: ' + e.message, Boxes.draw_all(ctx, selected_id);\n\n      // draw in-progress wire\n      if (drawing_wire) {\n        const src = Boxes.get_port_world_pos(drawing_wire.from_box, drawing_wire.from_port, 'output');\n requestAnimationFrame(render);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // Mouse interaction\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {\n    if (e.button !== 0) return;\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    if (tool_mode === 'add-box') {\n      new_box_at(w.x, w.y);\n      set_tool_mode('select');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (tool_mode ===  const box_id = Boxes.hit_test_box(w.x, w.y);\n    if (box_id) {\n      selected_id = box_id;\n      drag_box_id = box_id;\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[box_id];\n      drag_offset = { x: w.x - Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (drag_box_id) {\n      // persist position on mouseup\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[drag_box_id];\n      if (b) {\n        try { await No confirmation — deletion is always immediate.\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    const b = Boxes.boxes[id];\n    if (!b) return;\n    try {\n      // remove all connection records that reference this box from every other box\n      const other_ids = Object.keys(Boxes.boxes).filter(bid => bid !== id);\n      await Promise.all(other_ids.map(async bid => {\n        const box = await       if (box.connections.length !== before) {\n          await API.put_box(bid, box);\n          Boxes.boxes[bid] = box;\n        }\n      }));\n      await API.delete_box(id);\n      delete Boxes.boxes[id];\n      Inspector.hide();\n      selected_id = null;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('deleted ' + id);\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('delete error: ' + e.message, if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT') return;\n\n    const sel_wire = Wires.selected_wire();\n    if (sel_wire) {\n      await Wires.delete_connection(sel_wire);\n         "content":"-- Ollama API client — shared library and ready-to-use box source.\n-- require(\"ollama\") from any Lua function, or copy to a map's src/ directory\n-- to use it directly as a call box via the file browser.\n-- Uses curl; no extra Lua packages needed beyond dkjson.\n\nlocal json = require(\"dkjson\")\nlocal M    = {}\n\nlocal DEFAULT_HOST  = \"http://localhost:11434\"\nlocal DEFAULT_MODEL = \"llama3.2\"\n\n-- {{{ shell_quote\nlocal function shell_quote(s)\n    return \"'\" .. tostring(s):gsub(\"'\", \"'\\\\''\") .. \"'\"\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ curl_post\nlocal function curl_post(url, payload)\n    local cmd = \"curl -s --max-time 120 -X POST \" .. shell_quote(url) ..\n                \" -H \" .. shell_quote(\"Content-Type: application/json\") ..\n                \" -d \" .. shell_quote(payload)\n    local ph  = io.popen(cmd)\n    local out = ph:read(\"*a\")\n    ph:close()\n    return out\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ M.query\n-- Plain text generation. model and host are optional; nil or empty uses defaults.\nfunction M.query(prompt, model, host)\n    model = (model ~= nil and model ~= \"\") and model or DEFAULT_MODEL\n    host  = (host  ~= nil and host  ~= \"\") and host  or DEFAULT_HOST\n    local out  = curl_post(host .. \"/api/generate\", json.encode({\n        model  = model,\n        prompt = tostring(prompt),\n        stream = false,\n    }))\n    local resp, _, err = json.decode(out)\n    if not resp then\n        io.stderr:write(\"ollama.query: bad response: \" .. tostring(err) .. \"\\n\")\n        return nil\n    end\n    if resp.error then\n        io.stderr:write(\"ollama.query: \" .. tostring(resp.error) .. \"\\n\")\n        return nil\n    end\n    return resp.response\nend\n-- }}}\n\n-- {{{ M.chat\n-- Chat-style query. system prompt is optional; nil or empty omits it.\n-- model and host default when nil or empty.\nfunction M.chat(prompt, system, model, host)\n    model = (model ~= nil and model ~= \"\") and model or DEFAULT_MODEL\n    host  = (host  ~= nil and host  ~= \"\") and host  or DEFAULT_HOST\n    local messages = {}\n    if system ~= nil and system ~= \"\" then\n        messages[#messages + 1] = { role = \"system\", content = tostring(system) }\n    end\n    messages[#messages + 1] = { role = \"user\", content = tostring(prompt) }\n    local out  = curl_post(host .. \"/api/chat\", json.encode({\n        model    = model,\n        messages = messages,\n        stream   = false,\n    }))\n    local resp, _, err = json.decode(out)\n    if not resp then\n        io.stderr:write(\"ollama.chat: bad response: \" .. tostring(err) .. \"\\n\")\n        return nil\n    end\n    if resp.error then\n        io.stderr:write(\"ollama.chat: \" .. tostring(resp.error) .. \"\\n\")\n        return nil\n    end\n    return resp.message and resp.message.content or nil\nend\n-- }}}\n\nreturn M",

        "content":"// Inspector sidebar: shows and edits the selected box's fields.\n// Fires PUT to the server on every field change (autosave).\n// For call boxes, ref/fn are set via the file browser; inputs are read-only, derived from parsing.\n\nconst Inspector = (() => {\n  const panel  = document.getElementById('inspector');\n  const title  = document.getElementById('inspector-title');\n  const fields = document.getElementById('inspector-fields');\n\n  let current_box  = null;\n  let on_change_cb = null;\n  let on_delete_cb = null;\n\n  // {{{ hide\n  function hide() {\n    panel.classList.add('hidden');\n    current_box  = null;\n    on_delete_cb = null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ save\n  async function save() {\n    if (!current_box) return;\n    try {\n      await API.put_box(current_box.id, current_box);\n      if (on_change_cb) on_change_cb(current_box);\n    } catch(e) {\n      console.error('autosave failed:', e.message);\n      status_msg('save error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_row\n  function mk_row(label_text, input_el) {\n    const row = document.createElement('div');\n    row.className = 'field-row';\n    const lbl = document.createElement('label');\n    lbl.textContent = label_text;\n    row.appendChild(lbl);\n    row.appendChild(input_el);\n    return row;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_text_input\n  function mk_text_input(value, on_input) {\n    const inp = document.createElement('input');\n    inp.type  = 'text';\n    inp.value = value || '';\n    inp.addEventListener('input', () => { on_input(inp.value); save(); });\n    return inp;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_readonly\n  function mk_readonly(value) {\n    const el = document.createElement('div');\n    el.className   = 'field-readonly';\n    el.textContent = value || '—';\n    return el;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_port_display\n  // Renders input ports as read-only name labels with an optional literal value field.\n  // Names are derived from source parsing and are not editable here.\n  function mk_port_display(ports) {\n    const wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    wrap.className = 'port-display';\n    if (!ports || ports.length === 0) {\n      const empty = document.createElement('span');\n      empty.className   = 'port-display-empty';\n      empty.textContent = '(none)';\n      wrap.appendChild(empty);\n    } else {\n      ports.forEach((p, i) => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className = 'port-display-row';\n\n        // name is read-only — derived from function signature via file browser\n        const name_el = document.createElement('span');\n        name_el.className   = 'port-name-inp';\n        name_el.textContent = p.name || '';\n        name_el.style.color = '#9ea3c0';\n        row.appendChild(name_el);\n\n        if (p.type && p.type !== 'any') {\n          const type_el = document.createElement('span');\n          type_el.className   = 'port-type';\n          type_el.textContent = ':' + p.type;\n          row.appendChild(type_el);\n        }\n\n        // literal value input — empty means \"no literal\" (wire will supply the value)\n        const val_inp = document.createElement('input');\n        val_inp.type        = 'text';\n        val_inp.value       = p.value !== undefined ? String(p.value) : '';\n        val_inp.placeholder = 'value…';\n        val_inp.className   = 'port-val-inp';\n        val_inp.addEventListener('input', () => {\n          ports[i].value = val_inp.value === '' ? undefined : val_inp.value;\n          save();\n        });\n        row.appendChild(val_inp);\n\n        wrap.appendChild(row);\n      });\n    }\n    return wrap;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ open_browser\n  // Replaces inspector content with the file browser.\n  // On function select: sets ref/fn/inputs from parsed signature (no outputs — single wire).\n  function open_browser() {\n    title.textContent = 'browse src/';\n    fields.innerHTML  = '';\n    FileBrowser.render(fields, (filename, fn) => {\n      current_box.ref    = filename;\n      current_box.fn     = fn.name;\n      current_box.inputs = fn.inputs.map(n => ({ name: n, type: 'any' }));\n      // outputs are not set — all boxes have exactly one output wire\n      save().then(() => show(current_box, on_change_cb, on_delete_cb));\n    });\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ show_content\n  // Renders arbitrary content into the inspector panel without a box context.\n  // Used by the map picker and any other non-box inspector views.\n  function show_content(title_text, render_fn) {\n    current_box  = null;\n    on_change_cb = null;\n    on_delete_cb = null;\n    panel.classList.remove('hidden');\n    title.innerHTML   = '';\n    title.textContent = title_text;\n    fields.innerHTML  = '';\n    render_fn(fields);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ show\n  function show(box, on_changed, on_delete) {\n    current_box  = box;\n    on_change_cb = on_changed;\n    on_delete_cb = on_delete || null;\n    panel.classList.remove('hidden');\n\n    // title: editable label input + read-only id subtitle\n    title.innerHTML = '';\n    const lbl_inp = document.createElement('input');\n    lbl_inp.type      = 'text';\n    lbl_inp.value     = box.label || '';\n    lbl_inp.className = 'inspector-title-inp';\n    lbl_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { current_box.label = lbl_inp.value; save(); });\n    title.appendChild(lbl_inp);\n    const id_sub = document.createElement('div');\n    id_sub.className   = 'inspector-id-sub';\n    id_sub.textContent = box.id;\n    title.appendChild(id_sub);\n\n    fields.innerHTML = '';\n\n    // delete button — always visible at the top of the inspector\n    if (on_delete_cb) {\n      const del_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      del_btn.textContent = 'delete box';\n      del_btn.className   = 'delete-box-btn';\n      del_btn.onclick     = () => on_delete_cb();\n      fields.appendChild(del_btn);\n    }\n\n    // label is now the editable title — no separate field needed\n\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('kind', (() => {\n      const sel = document.createElement('select');\n      ['call', 'data'].forEach(k => {\n        const opt = document.createElement('option');\n        opt.value = k; opt.textContent = k;\n        if (k === box.kind) opt.selected = true;\n        sel.appendChild(opt);\n      });\n      sel.addEventListener('change', () => {\n        current_box.kind = sel.value;\n        show(current_box, on_change_cb, on_delete_cb);\n        save();\n      });\n      return sel;\n    })()));\n\n    // ref: editable text input + browse button to populate via file browser\n    const ref_wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    ref_wrap.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;';\n    const ref_inp = document.createElement('input');\n    ref_inp.type  = 'text';\n    ref_inp.value = box.ref || '';\n    ref_inp.style.flex = '1';\n    ref_inp.style.minWidth = '0';\n    ref_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { current_box.ref = ref_inp.value; save(); });\n    const browse_btn = document.createElement('button');\n    browse_btn.className   = 'toolbar-btn';\n    browse_btn.textContent = 'browse';\n    browse_btn.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';\n    browse_btn.onclick = open_browser;\n    ref_wrap.appendChild(ref_inp);\n    ref_wrap.appendChild(browse_btn);\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('ref', ref_wrap));\n\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('fn', mk_readonly(box.fn)));\n\n    // inputs: read-only names from parsing, editable literal values\n    const in_sec = document.createElement('div');\n    in_sec.className   = 'section-label';\n    in_sec.textContent = 'inputs';\n    fields.appendChild(in_sec);\n    fields.appendChild(mk_port_display(box.inputs));\n\n    // output: single wire; optional comparator splits into lt/eq/gt\n    const out_sec = document.createElement('div');\n    out_sec.className   = 'section-label';\n    out_sec.textContent = 'output';\n    fields.appendChild(out_sec);\n\n    const cmp_row = document.createElement('div');\n    cmp_row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;';\n\n    const has_cmp = box.comparand !== undefined && box.comparand !== '';\n    const cmp_btn = document.createElement('button');\n    cmp_btn.className   = 'toolbar-btn';\n    cmp_btn.textContent = has_cmp ? 'comparing ×' : 'compare';\n    cmp_btn.onclick = () => {\n      if (current_box.comparand !== undefined && current_box.comparand !== '') {\n        delete current_box.comparand;\n      } else {\n        current_box.comparand = '0';\n      }\n      save().then(() => show(current_box, on_change_cb, on_delete_cb));\n    };\n    cmp_row.appendChild(cmp_btn);\n\n    if (has_cmp) {\n      const cmp_inp = document.createElement('input');\n      cmp_inp.type        = 'text';\n      cmp_inp.value       = box.comparand || '';\n      cmp_inp.placeholder = 'number';\n      cmp_inp.style.cssText = 'flex:1;background:#0f1117;border:1px solid #2a2f45;' +\n        'border-radius:3px;color:#e8eaf6;font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;padding:4px 6px;';\n      cmp_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { current_box.comparand = cmp_inp.value; save(); });\n      cmp_row.appendChild(cmp_inp);\n    }\n\n    fields.appendChild(cmp_row);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { show, hide, show_content };\n})();\n",

        "content":"// Source file browser and function signature parser.\n// Renders into the inspector panel: file list → function list → auto-populate box ports.\n\nconst FileBrowser = (() => {\n\n  // {{{ lua_fn_end\n  // Returns the index of the closing 'end'/'until' that matches the function body\n  // starting at body_start. Tracks nesting depth by counting block openers and closers.\n  // Does not attempt to skip string literals — good enough for well-formatted source.\n  function lua_fn_end(content, body_start) {\n    const tok = /\\b(function|if|while|for|repeat|do|end|until)\\b/g;\n    tok.lastIndex = body_start;\n    let depth = 1;\n    let m;\n    while ((m = tok.exec(content)) !== null) {\n      const kw = m[1];\n      if (kw === 'end' || kw === 'until') {\n        depth--;\n        if (depth === 0) return m.index;\n      } else {\n        depth++;\n      }\n    }\n    return content.length;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ parse_lua_returns\n  // Scans a function body for return statements; returns an array of output names.\n  function parse_lua_returns(body) {\n    const re    = /\\breturn\\b\\s*([^\\n]+)/g;\n    const names = new Set();\n    let m;\n    while ((m = re.exec(body)) !== null) {\n      const expr = m[1].replace(/--.*$/, '').trim();\n      if (!expr) continue;\n      // string literals or concat operator mean the whole expression is complex\n      if (/[\"']|\\.\\./.test(expr)) { names.add('result'); continue; }\n      const parts = expr.split(',');\n      parts.forEach(part => {\n        part = part.trim();\n        // bare identifier → use as port name\n        if (/^[a-zA-Z_]\\w*$/.test(part) &&\n            !['nil','true','false','not','and','or','end'].includes(part)) {\n          names.add(part);\n        } else if (parts.length === 1 && part) {\n          // single complex expression → call it \"result\"\n          names.add('result');\n        }\n        // multi-value complex expression with no bare names: skip\n      });\n    }\n    return [...names];\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ parse_lua\n  function parse_lua(content) {\n    const fns    = [];\n    const fn_re  = /^function\\s+M\\.(\\w+)\\s*\\(([^)]*)\\)/mg;\n    let m;\n    while ((m = fn_re.exec(content)) !== null) {\n      const body_start = m.index + m[0].length;\n      const body_end   = lua_fn_end(content, body_start);\n      const body       = content.slice(body_start, body_end);\n      const inputs     = m[2].trim()\n        ? m[2].split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)\n        : [];\n      const outputs    = parse_lua_returns(body);\n      fns.push({ name: m[1], inputs, outputs });\n    }\n    return fns;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ parse_bash_inputs\n  function parse_bash_inputs(body) {\n    const params = {};\n    // local var=\"${N}\" or local var=\"$N\"\n    const local_re = /local\\s+(\\w+)\\s*=\\s*[\"']?\\$\\{?(\\d+)\\}?[\"']?/g;\n    let m;\n    while ((m = local_re.exec(body)) !== null) {\n      params[parseInt(m[2])] = m[1];\n    }\n    if (Object.keys(params).length > 0) {\n      const max = Math.max(...Object.keys(params).map(Number));\n      return Array.from({ length: max }, (_, i) => params[i + 1] || `arg${i + 1}`);\n    }\n    // fall back: scan for raw $N references\n    const seen = new Set();\n    const pos_re = /\\$\\{?(\\d+)\\}?/g;\n    while ((m = pos_re.exec(body)) !== null) {\n      const n = parseInt(m[1]);\n      if (n > 0) seen.add(n);\n    }\n    if (seen.size > 0) {\n      const max = Math.max(...seen);\n      return Array.from({ length: max }, (_, i) => `arg${i + 1}`);\n    }\n    return [];\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ parse_bash\n  function parse_bash(content) {\n    const fns   = [];\n    const re    = /^(\\w+)\\s*\\(\\s*\\)\\s*\\{/mg;\n    const skip  = new Set(['if','while','for','case','do','done','fi','then','else']);\n    let m;\n    while ((m = re.exec(content)) !== null) {\n      const name = m[1];\n      if (skip.has(name)) continue;\n      const body_start = m.index + m[0].length;\n      const close      = content.indexOf('\\n}', body_start);\n      const body       = content.slice(body_start, close > -1 ? close : body_start + 800);\n      const inputs     = parse_bash_inputs(body);\n      fns.push({ name, inputs, outputs: ['output'] });\n    }\n    return fns;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ parse_functions\n  // Returns [{name, inputs:[string], outputs:[string]}] for a given file.\n  function parse_functions(content, filename) {\n    const ext = filename.split('.').pop();\n    if (ext === 'lua') return parse_lua(content);\n    if (ext === 'sh')  return parse_bash(content);\n    return null;  // null = no parser for this extension\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ render_fn_list\n  // Shows parsed functions for one file; calls on_select(filename, fn) on click.\n  function render_fn_list(container, filename, fns, on_select, on_back) {\n    container.innerHTML = '';\n\n    const back_btn = document.createElement('button');\n    back_btn.className   = 'fb-back';\n    back_btn.textContent = '← ' + filename;\n    back_btn.onclick     = on_back;\n    container.appendChild(back_btn);\n\n    if (fns === null) {\n      const note = document.createElement('div');\n      note.className   = 'fb-note';\n      note.textContent = 'no parser for .' + filename.split('.').pop() + ' files';\n      container.appendChild(note);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (fns.length === 0) {\n      const note = document.createElement('div');\n      note.className   = 'fb-note';\n      note.textContent = 'no public functions found (expected: function M.name(...))';\n      container.appendChild(note);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    fns.forEach(fn => {\n      const row = document.createElement('div');\n      row.className = 'fb-fn-row';\n\n      const name_el = document.createElement('div');\n      name_el.className   = 'fb-fn-name';\n      name_el.textContent = fn.name + '(' + fn.inputs.join(', ') + ')';\n      row.appendChild(name_el);\n\n      const in_el = document.createElement('div');\n      in_el.className   = 'fb-fn-ports';\n      in_el.textContent = 'in:  ' + (fn.inputs.length ? fn.inputs.join(', ') : '(none)');\n      row.appendChild(in_el);\n\n      const out_el = document.createElement('div');\n      out_el.className   = 'fb-fn-ports';\n      out_el.textContent = 'out: ' + (fn.outputs.length ? fn.outputs.join(', ') : '(none)');\n      row.appendChild(out_el);\n\n      row.onclick = () => on_select(filename, fn);\n      container.appendChild(row);\n    });\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ show_dir_picker\n  // Renders a directory browser into container, navigating the server filesystem.\n  // on_select(abs_path) called when the user confirms a directory.\n  // on_cancel() called when the user clicks back.\n  async function show_dir_picker(container, on_select, on_cancel) {\n    let current_path = '/home';\n\n    const render_picker = async () => {\n      container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note\">loading…</div>';\n      let result;\n      try {\n        result = await API.list_dirs(current_path);\n      } catch(e) {\n        container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note error\">error: ' + e.message + '</div>';\n        return;\n      }\n\n      container.innerHTML = '';\n\n      // back button returns to file list without selecting\n      const cancel_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      cancel_btn.className   = 'fb-back';\n      cancel_btn.textContent = '← cancel';\n      cancel_btn.onclick     = on_cancel;\n      container.appendChild(cancel_btn);\n\n      // current path breadcrumb\n      const path_el = document.createElement('div');\n      path_el.style.cssText = 'font-size:10px;color:#4a9eff;word-break:break-all;' +\n        'margin-bottom:6px;font-family:monospace;';\n      path_el.textContent = result.path;\n      container.appendChild(path_el);\n\n      // \"use this directory\" confirmation button\n      const sel_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      sel_btn.className   = 'add-port';\n      sel_btn.textContent = '✓ use this directory';\n      sel_btn.style.cssText = 'display:block;width:100%;margin-bottom:8px;' +\n        'color:#4caf7d;border-color:#4caf7d;';\n      sel_btn.onclick = () => on_select(result.path);\n      container.appendChild(sel_btn);\n\n      // parent directory row (except at filesystem root)\n      if (result.path !== '/') {\n        const up_row = document.createElement('div');\n        up_row.className   = 'fb-file-row';\n        up_row.textContent = '..';\n        up_row.onclick = () => {\n          // strip last path component\n          const parent = result.path.replace(/\\/[^/]+$/, '') || '/';\n          current_path = parent;\n          render_picker();\n        };\n        container.appendChild(up_row);\n      }\n\n      if (result.dirs.length === 0) {\n        const note = document.createElement('div');\n        note.className   = 'fb-note';\n        note.textContent = '(no subdirectories)';\n        container.appendChild(note);\n      }\n\n      result.dirs.forEach(name => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className   = 'fb-file-row';\n        row.textContent = name + '/';\n        row.onclick = () => {\n          current_path = result.path === '/' ? '/' + name : result.path + '/' + name;\n          render_picker();\n        };\n        container.appendChild(row);\n      });\n    };\n\n    render_picker();\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ render\n  // Renders the full file browser into container.\n  // on_select(filename, fn_obj) called when the user picks a function.\n  // Groups: [{label, files:[string], fetch_file: async fn(filename)->text}]\n  async function render(container, on_select) {\n    container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note\">loading…</div>';\n\n    // collapsed state: set of group labels\n    const collapsed = new Set();\n\n    // load src/ and extra dirs in parallel\n    let src_files = [], extra_dirs = [];\n    try {\n      [src_files, extra_dirs] = await Promise.all([\n        API.list_src_files().catch(() => []),\n        API.list_extra_src().catch(() => []),\n      ]);\n    } catch (e) {\n      container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note error\">load error: ' + e.message + '</div>';\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // build unified group list\n    const groups = [];\n    if (src_files.length > 0) {\n      groups.push({\n        label: 'src/',\n        files: src_files,\n        fetch_file: f => API.get_src_file(f),\n      });\n    }\n    (extra_dirs || []).forEach(d => {\n      if (d.files && d.files.length > 0) {\n        groups.push({\n          label: d.label + '/',\n          files: d.files,\n          fetch_file: f => API.get_extra_src_file(d.index, f),\n        });\n      }\n    });\n\n    const show_file_list = () => {\n      container.innerHTML = '';\n\n      // add-library-dir button\n      const add_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      add_btn.textContent = '+ library dir';\n      add_btn.className   = 'fb-add-dir-btn';\n      add_btn.onclick = () => {\n        show_dir_picker(container,\n          async (path) => {\n            try {\n              const meta = await API.get_meta();\n              const dirs = meta.extra_src_dirs || [];\n              if (!dirs.includes(path)) {\n                dirs.push(path);\n                await API.put_meta({ ...meta, extra_src_dirs: dirs });\n              }\n              render(container, on_select);\n            } catch(e) {\n              show_file_list();\n              const note = document.createElement('div');\n              note.className   = 'fb-note error';\n              note.textContent = 'could not save dir: ' + e.message;\n              container.insertBefore(note, container.firstChild);\n            }\n          },\n          () => show_file_list()\n        );\n      };\n      container.appendChild(add_btn);\n\n      if (groups.length === 0) {\n        const note = document.createElement('div');\n        note.className   = 'fb-note';\n        note.textContent = 'src/ is empty — add source files or a library dir';\n        container.appendChild(note);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      groups.forEach(group => {\n        const is_collapsed = collapsed.has(group.label);\n\n        // group header row with toggle\n        const hdr = document.createElement('div');\n        hdr.className = 'fb-group-hdr';\n\n        const toggle = document.createElement('span');\n        toggle.className   = 'fb-group-toggle';\n        toggle.textContent = is_collapsed ? '▶' : '▼';\n        hdr.appendChild(toggle);\n\n        const lbl = document.createElement('span');\n        lbl.className   = 'fb-header';\n        lbl.textContent = group.label;\n        hdr.appendChild(lbl);\n\n        hdr.onclick = () => {\n          if (collapsed.has(group.label)) collapsed.delete(group.label);\n          else collapsed.add(group.label);\n          show_file_list();\n        };\n        container.appendChild(hdr);\n\n        if (is_collapsed) return;\n\n        group.files.forEach(filename => {\n          const row = document.createElement('div');\n          row.className   = 'fb-file-row';\n          row.textContent = filename;\n          row.onclick     = async () => {\n            row.textContent = filename + ' …';\n            let content;\n            try {\n              content = await group.fetch_file(filename);\n            } catch (e) {\n              container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note error\">could not read ' + filename + ': ' + e.message + '</div>';\n              show_file_list();\n              return;\n            }\n            const fns = parse_functions(content, filename);\n            render_fn_list(container, group.label + filename, fns,\n              (f, fn) => on_select(f, fn),\n              show_file_list\n            );\n          };\n          container.appendChild(row);\n        });\n      });\n    };\n\n    show_file_list();\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { parse_functions, render };\n})();\n",

        "content":"// Thin fetch wrapper for the soramech-server REST API.\n// All functions are async and throw on non-2xx responses.\n\nconst API = (() => {\n  let base_url = '';\n  let map_name = '';\n\n  // {{{ init\n  function init(url, name) { base_url = url.replace(/\\/$/, ''); map_name = name; }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ request\n  async function request(method, path, body) {\n    const opts = { method, headers: {} };\n    if (body !== undefined) {\n      opts.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';\n      opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);\n    }\n    const res = await fetch(base_url + path, opts);\n    const text = await res.text();\n    let data;\n    try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { data = { error: text }; }\n    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);\n    return data;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_maps\n  async function list_maps() { return request('GET', '/maps'); }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_boxes\n  async function list_boxes() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_box\n  async function get_box(id) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_box\n  async function put_box(id, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ delete_box\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    return request('DELETE', `/maps/${map_name}/boxes/${id}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_meta\n  async function get_meta() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_meta\n  async function put_meta(data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/meta`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_src_files\n  async function list_src_files() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/src`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_src_file\n  // Returns raw text, not JSON — the request() helper would mis-parse source code.\n  async function get_src_file(filename) {\n    const res = await fetch(base_url + `/maps/${map_name}/src/${encodeURIComponent(filename)}`);\n    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);\n    return res.text();\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_extra_src\n  async function list_extra_src() {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/extrasrc`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_extra_src_file\n  async function get_extra_src_file(dir_index, filename) {\n    const res = await fetch(base_url + `/maps/${map_name}/extrasrc/${dir_index}/${encodeURIComponent(filename)}`);\n    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);\n    return res.text();\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ list_dirs\n  // Lists immediate subdirectories of an absolute path on the server's filesystem.\n  // Returns { path: string, dirs: string[] }.\n  async function list_dirs(path) {\n    return request('GET', '/fs/dirs?path=' + encodeURIComponent(path));\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ get_data\n  async function get_data(filename) {\n    return request('GET', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ put_data\n  async function put_data(filename, data) {\n    return request('PUT', `/maps/${map_name}/data/${filename}`, data);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { init, list_maps, list_boxes, get_box, put_box, delete_box,\n           get_meta, put_meta, get_data, put_data,\n           list_src_files, get_src_file,\n           list_extra_src, get_extra_src_file,\n           list_dirs };\n})();\n",

      "content":"// Top-level app: connects everything, loads the map, drives the render loop.\n\nconst App = (() => {\n  let selected_id   = null;\n  let drag_box_id   = null;\n  let drag_offset   = { x: 0, y: 0 };\n  let drawing_wire  = null;  // { from_box, from_port, cur_x, cur_y }\n  let hover_port    = null;\n  let status_el     = document.getElementById('status');\n\n  // tool_mode: 'select' | 'erase-wire'\n  let tool_mode  = 'select';\n  let erasing    = false;\n  let erase_seen = new Set();  // wire signatures already queued for deletion this drag\n\n  // context menu\n  const ctx_menu = document.createElement('div');\n  ctx_menu.id = 'context-menu';\n  document.body.appendChild(ctx_menu);\n\n  function show_ctx_menu(screen_x, screen_y, items) {\n    ctx_menu.innerHTML = '';\n    items.forEach(item => {\n      if (item === 'sep') {\n        const el = document.createElement('div');\n        el.className = 'ctx-sep';\n        ctx_menu.appendChild(el);\n        return;\n      }\n      const el = document.createElement('div');\n      el.className = 'ctx-item' + (item.danger ? ' danger' : '');\n      el.textContent = item.label;\n      el.onclick = () => { hide_ctx_menu(); item.action(); };\n      ctx_menu.appendChild(el);\n    });\n    ctx_menu.style.display = 'block';\n    ctx_menu.style.left = screen_x + 'px';\n    ctx_menu.style.top  = screen_y + 'px';\n    // keep on screen\n    const r = ctx_menu.getBoundingClientRect();\n    if (r.right  > window.innerWidth)  ctx_menu.style.left = (screen_x - r.width)  + 'px';\n    if (r.bottom > window.innerHeight) ctx_menu.style.top  = (screen_y - r.height) + 'px';\n  }\n\n  function hide_ctx_menu() { ctx_menu.style.display = 'none'; }\n\n  // hide context menu on any click or scroll\n  document.addEventListener('click',    hide_ctx_menu);\n  document.addEventListener('keydown',  e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') hide_ctx_menu(); });\n\n  // {{{ status_msg\n  window.status_msg = function(msg, level = 'info') {\n    status_el.textContent = msg;\n    status_el.className   = 'status ' + level;\n  };\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ wire_sig\n  // Stable string key for a connection record, used to prevent double-erase.\n  function wire_sig(c) {\n    return c.from_box + '|' + (c.from_branch || '') + '|' + c.to_box + '|' + c.to_input;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ set_tool_mode\n  function set_tool_mode(mode) {\n    tool_mode = mode;\n    const era_btn = document.getElementById('tool-erase-wire');\n    if (era_btn) era_btn.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'erase-wire');\n    if (mode === 'erase-wire') {\n      Canvas.el.style.cursor = 'cell';\n      status_msg('click and drag to erase wires');\n    } else {\n      Canvas.el.style.cursor = '';\n      status_msg('');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ load_map\n  async function load_map() {\n    status_msg('loading…');\n    try {\n      const ids = await API.list_boxes();\n      const fetches = ids.map(id => API.get_box(id));\n      const all = await Promise.all(fetches);\n      // mutate the existing object so the draw_all closure sees the new boxes\n      Object.keys(Boxes.boxes).forEach(k => delete Boxes.boxes[k]);\n      all.forEach(b => { Boxes.boxes[b.id] = b; });\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('loaded ' + ids.length + ' boxes');\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('load error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ new_box_at\n  async function new_box_at(wx, wy) {\n    const id = 'box-' + Date.now().toString(36);\n    const box = {\n      id, label: 'New Box', kind: 'call',\n      ref: '', fn: '', inputs: [], connections: [],\n      ui: { x: Math.round(wx), y: Math.round(wy) },\n    };\n    try {\n      await API.put_box(id, box);\n      Boxes.boxes[id] = box;\n      selected_id = id;\n      Inspector.show(box, () => Canvas.mark_dirty(), () => delete_box(id));\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('create error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ render\n  function render() {\n    if (Canvas.start_frame()) {\n      const ctx = Canvas.ctx;\n      Wires.draw_all(ctx, selected_id);\n      Boxes.draw_all(ctx, selected_id);\n\n      // draw in-progress wire\n      if (drawing_wire) {\n        const src = Boxes.get_port_world_pos(drawing_wire.from_box, drawing_wire.from_port, 'output');\n        if (src) {\n          Wires.draw_bezier(ctx, src.x, src.y, drawing_wire.cur_x, drawing_wire.cur_y,\n            '#6c72a0', false);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    requestAnimationFrame(render);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // Mouse interaction\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {\n    if (e.button !== 0) return;\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    if (tool_mode === 'erase-wire') {\n      erasing    = true;\n      erase_seen = new Set();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // select mode: existing port / box / deselect logic\n    const port = Boxes.hit_test_port(w.x, w.y);\n    if (port && port.side === 'output') {\n      drawing_wire = { from_box: port.box_id, from_port: port.port_name,\n                       cur_x: w.x, cur_y: w.y };\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const box_id = Boxes.hit_test_box(w.x, w.y);\n    if (box_id) {\n      selected_id = box_id;\n      drag_box_id = box_id;\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[box_id];\n      drag_offset = { x: w.x - (b.ui?.x ?? 0), y: w.y - (b.ui?.y ?? 0) };\n      Inspector.show(b, () => Canvas.mark_dirty(), () => delete_box(box_id));\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    selected_id = null;\n    Inspector.hide();\n    Canvas.mark_dirty();\n  });\n\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    if (erasing && tool_mode === 'erase-wire') {\n      const wire = Wires.hit_test_wire(w.x, w.y, Canvas.cam.zoom);\n      if (wire) {\n        const sig = wire_sig(wire);\n        if (!erase_seen.has(sig)) {\n          erase_seen.add(sig);\n          // remove from local cache immediately for instant visual feedback\n          [wire.from_box, wire.to_box].forEach(id => {\n            if (Boxes.boxes[id]) {\n              Boxes.boxes[id].connections = (Boxes.boxes[id].connections || []).filter(\n                c => wire_sig(c) !== sig\n              );\n            }\n          });\n          Canvas.mark_dirty();\n          Wires.delete_connection(wire).catch(e2 =>\n            status_msg('erase error: ' + e2.message, 'error'));\n        }\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (drawing_wire) {\n      drawing_wire.cur_x = w.x;\n      drawing_wire.cur_y = w.y;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (drag_box_id) {\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[drag_box_id];\n      if (b) {\n        b.ui = b.ui || {};\n        b.ui.x = Math.round(w.x - drag_offset.x);\n        b.ui.y = Math.round(w.y - drag_offset.y);\n        Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('mouseup', async e => {\n    if (e.button !== 0) return;\n\n    if (erasing) {\n      erasing    = false;\n      erase_seen = new Set();\n      set_tool_mode('select');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    if (drawing_wire) {\n      const target_port = Boxes.hit_test_port(w.x, w.y);\n      if (target_port && target_port.side === 'input' &&\n          target_port.box_id !== drawing_wire.from_box) {\n        await Wires.create_connection(\n          drawing_wire.from_box, drawing_wire.from_port,\n          target_port.box_id, target_port.port_name\n        );\n      }\n      drawing_wire = null;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (drag_box_id) {\n      // persist position on mouseup\n      const b = Boxes.boxes[drag_box_id];\n      if (b) {\n        try { await API.put_box(b.id, b); }\n        catch(e) { status_msg('save position failed: ' + e.message, 'error'); }\n      }\n      drag_box_id = null;\n    }\n  });\n\n  // {{{ delete_box\n  // Strips all connection records referencing this box from other boxes first,\n  // then deletes the box. No confirmation — deletion is always immediate.\n  async function delete_box(id) {\n    const b = Boxes.boxes[id];\n    if (!b) return;\n    try {\n      // remove all connection records that reference this box from every other box\n      const other_ids = Object.keys(Boxes.boxes).filter(bid => bid !== id);\n      await Promise.all(other_ids.map(async bid => {\n        const box = await API.get_box(bid);\n        const before = (box.connections || []).length;\n        box.connections = (box.connections || []).filter(\n          c => c.from_box !== id && c.to_box !== id\n        );\n        if (box.connections.length !== before) {\n          await API.put_box(bid, box);\n          Boxes.boxes[bid] = box;\n        }\n      }));\n      await API.delete_box(id);\n      delete Boxes.boxes[id];\n      Inspector.hide();\n      selected_id = null;\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      status_msg('deleted ' + id);\n    } catch(e) {\n      status_msg('delete error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // Delete key: remove selected box or wire\n  window.addEventListener('keydown', async e => {\n    if (e.code !== 'Delete' && e.code !== 'Backspace') return;\n    if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT') return;\n\n    const sel_wire = Wires.selected_wire();\n    if (sel_wire) {\n      await Wires.delete_connection(sel_wire);\n      Canvas.mark_dirty();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (selected_id) await delete_box(selected_id);\n  });\n\n  // {{{ save_to_history\n  function save_to_history(server_url, map_name) {\n    const history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('soramech_maps_history') || '[]');\n    // deduplicate: remove existing entry for this server+map combo, then prepend\n    const deduped = history.filter(h => !(h.server_url === server_url && h.map_name === map_name));\n    deduped.unshift({ server_url, map_name });\n    localStorage.setItem('soramech_maps_history', JSON.stringify(deduped.slice(0, 20)));\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ switch_to_map\n  function switch_to_map(server_url, map_name) {\n    const su = server_url || localStorage.getItem('soramech_server');\n    localStorage.setItem('soramech_server', su);\n    localStorage.setItem('soramech_map',    map_name);\n    save_to_history(su, map_name);\n    API.init(su, map_name);\n    document.getElementById('map-label').textContent = map_name;\n    Inspector.hide();\n    load_map();\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ show_map_picker\n  function show_map_picker() {\n    Inspector.show_content('maps', async (container) => {\n      container.innerHTML = '<div class=\"fb-note\">loading…</div>';\n\n      const recent = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('soramech_maps_history') || '[]');\n      let available = [];\n      try { available = await API.list_maps(); } catch(e) {}\n\n      container.innerHTML = '';\n\n      // helper: collapsible group with a body element\n      function mk_group(label) {\n        let collapsed = false;\n        const wrap = document.createElement('div');\n        const hdr  = document.createElement('div');\n        hdr.className = 'fb-group-hdr';\n        const toggle = document.createElement('span');\n        toggle.className   = 'fb-group-toggle';\n        toggle.textContent = '▼';\n        hdr.appendChild(toggle);\n        const lbl = document.createElement('span');\n        lbl.className   = 'fb-header';\n        lbl.textContent = label;\n        hdr.appendChild(lbl);\n        const body = document.createElement('div');\n        hdr.onclick = () => {\n          collapsed = !collapsed;\n          toggle.textContent = collapsed ? '▶' : '▼';\n          body.style.display = collapsed ? 'none' : '';\n        };\n        wrap.appendChild(hdr);\n        wrap.appendChild(body);\n        return { wrap, body };\n      }\n\n      // helper: clickable map row\n      function mk_map_row(name, subtitle, onclick) {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className   = 'fb-file-row';\n        row.textContent = name;\n        if (subtitle) {\n          const s = document.createElement('span');\n          s.style.cssText = 'font-size:9px;color:#3a3f55;margin-left:6px;font-family:monospace;';\n          s.textContent   = subtitle;\n          row.appendChild(s);\n        }\n        row.onclick = onclick;\n        return row;\n      }\n\n      const cur_server = localStorage.getItem('soramech_server') || '';\n\n      // recent group\n      if (recent.length > 0) {\n        const g = mk_group('recent');\n        recent.forEach(({ server_url: su, map_name: mn }) => {\n          const sub = su !== cur_server ? su : null;\n          g.body.appendChild(mk_map_row(mn, sub, () => switch_to_map(su, mn)));\n        });\n        container.appendChild(g.wrap);\n      }\n\n      // available on this server\n      if (available.length > 0) {\n        const g = mk_group('on this server');\n        available.forEach(mn => {\n          g.body.appendChild(mk_map_row(mn, null, () => switch_to_map(null, mn)));\n        });\n        container.appendChild(g.wrap);\n      }\n\n      if (recent.length === 0 && available.length === 0) {\n        const note = document.createElement('div');\n        note.className   = 'fb-note';\n        note.textContent = 'no maps found';\n        container.appendChild(note);\n      }\n\n      // new / connect section\n      const sep = document.createElement('div');\n      sep.className   = 'section-label';\n      sep.textContent = 'open map by name';\n      sep.style.marginTop = '10px';\n      container.appendChild(sep);\n\n      const new_wrap = document.createElement('div');\n      new_wrap.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:4px;';\n      const new_inp = document.createElement('input');\n      new_inp.type        = 'text';\n      new_inp.placeholder = 'map name';\n      new_inp.style.cssText = 'flex:1;background:#0f1117;border:1px solid #2a2f45;' +\n        'border-radius:3px;color:#e8eaf6;font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;padding:4px 6px;';\n      const new_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      new_btn.className   = 'toolbar-btn';\n      new_btn.textContent = 'open';\n      new_btn.onclick = () => {\n        const name = new_inp.value.trim();\n        if (name) switch_to_map(null, name);\n      };\n      new_inp.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Enter') new_btn.click(); });\n      new_wrap.appendChild(new_inp);\n      new_wrap.appendChild(new_btn);\n      container.appendChild(new_wrap);\n    });\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ export_image\n  function export_image() {\n    const link = document.createElement('a');\n    link.download = 'soramech-' + Date.now() + '.png';\n    link.href     = Canvas.el.toDataURL('image/png');\n    link.click();\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // right-click on canvas: context menu\n  Canvas.el.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    hide_ctx_menu();\n\n    const s = Canvas.mouse_pos(e);\n    const w = Canvas.screen_to_world(s.x, s.y);\n\n    const box_id = Boxes.hit_test_box(w.x, w.y);\n    const wire   = !box_id ? Wires.hit_test_wire(w.x, w.y, Canvas.cam.zoom) : null;\n\n    const items = [];\n    if (box_id) {\n      const box   = Boxes.boxes[box_id];\n      const label = (box.label && box.label !== 'New Box') ? '\"' + box.label + '\"' : box_id;\n      items.push({ label: 'delete ' + label, danger: true, action: () => delete_box(box_id) });\n    } else if (wire) {\n      const branch_str = wire.from_branch ? ' .' + wire.from_branch : '';\n      items.push({\n        label:  'delete wire ' + wire.from_box + branch_str + ' → ' + wire.to_box,\n        danger: true,\n        action: () => Wires.delete_connection(wire),\n      });\n    } else {\n      items.push({ label: 'add box here', action: () => new_box_at(w.x, w.y) });\n    }\n\n    show_ctx_menu(e.clientX, e.clientY, items);\n  });\n\n  // {{{ init\n  async function init() {\n    let server_url = localStorage.getItem('soramech_server') || '';\n    let map_name   = localStorage.getItem('soramech_map')    || '';\n\n    if (!server_url || !map_name) {\n      server_url = prompt('Server URL:', 'http://localhost:7700') || 'http://localhost:7700';\n      map_name   = prompt('Map name:',   'hello')                || 'hello';\n    }\n\n    save_to_history(server_url, map_name);\n    localStorage.setItem('soramech_server', server_url);\n    localStorage.setItem('soramech_map',    map_name);\n    document.getElementById('map-label').textContent = map_name;\n    document.getElementById('map-label').onclick = show_map_picker;\n    API.init(server_url, map_name);\n    await load_map();\n    requestAnimationFrame(render);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);\n  return { load_map, set_tool_mode, export_image };\n})();\n",
      "startLine":1,
      "totalLines":497,
      "filePath":"/mnt/mtwo/programs/sora/soramech/assets/js/005-app.js",
      "numLines":497
    }
  }

      "content":"// Box rendering, layout, and hit testing.\n// Each box knows its world-space position; the camera transform is applied by the canvas.\n\nconst Boxes = (() => {\n  const BOX_W         = 180;\n  const BOX_HEADER    = 36;\n  const PORT_ROW_H    = 22;\n  const PORT_R        = 6;   // port dot radius in world units\n  const MIN_BOX_H     = 80;\n\n  const KIND_COLOR = { call: '#4a9eff', data: '#4caf7d' };\n\n  // Comparator branch colors: lt=orange, eq=blue, gt=green\n  const BRANCH_COLOR = { lt: '#ff8c42', eq: '#4a9eff', gt: '#4caf7d' };\n\n  // boxes: { [id]: box_data }\n  let boxes = {};\n\n  // {{{ box_height\n  function box_height(box) {\n    const n_in  = (box.inputs || []).length;\n    // comparator active: 3 output dots (lt/eq/gt); otherwise: 1 centered dot\n    const n_out = (box.comparand && box.comparand !== '') ? 3 : 1;\n    return Math.max(MIN_BOX_H, BOX_HEADER + Math.max(n_in, n_out) * PORT_ROW_H + 8);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ port_positions\n  // Returns world-space {x,y} for each port dot on a box.\n  // Output side: null-named single dot when no comparand; 'lt'/'eq'/'gt' dots when comparand set.\n  function port_positions(box) {\n    const bx = box.ui?.x ?? 0;\n    const by = box.ui?.y ?? 0;\n    const h  = box_height(box);\n    const inputs = box.inputs || [];\n\n    const in_pts = inputs.map((p, i) => ({\n      name: p.name, side: 'input',\n      x: bx,\n      y: by + BOX_HEADER + PORT_ROW_H * i + PORT_ROW_H / 2,\n    }));\n\n    let out_pts;\n    if (box.comparand && box.comparand !== '') {\n      // three comparator dots\n      out_pts = ['lt', 'eq', 'gt'].map((branch, i) => ({\n        name: branch, side: 'output',\n        x: bx + BOX_W,\n        y: by + BOX_HEADER + PORT_ROW_H * i + PORT_ROW_H / 2,\n      }));\n    } else {\n      // single output dot, vertically centered in the box\n      out_pts = [{\n        name: null, side: 'output',\n        x: bx + BOX_W,\n        y: by + h / 2,\n      }];\n    }\n\n    return { inputs: in_pts, outputs: out_pts };\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ draw_box\n  function draw_box(ctx, box, selected) {\n    const x = box.ui?.x ?? 0;\n    const y = box.ui?.y ?? 0;\n    const w = BOX_W;\n    const h = box_height(box);\n    const kind  = box.kind || 'call';\n    const color = KIND_COLOR[kind] || '#888';\n\n    // shadow when selected\n    if (selected) {\n      ctx.shadowColor = color;\n      ctx.shadowBlur  = 12;\n    }\n\n    // body\n    ctx.fillStyle   = '#1e2130';\n    ctx.strokeStyle = selected ? String(p.value) : '';\n        val_inp.placeholder = 'value…';\n        val_inp.className   = 'port-val-inp';\n        val_inp.addEventListener('input', async () => {\n          const new_val = val_inp.value === '' ? undefined : val_inp.value;\n          ports[i].value = new_val;\n\n          // a literal value and an incoming wire are contradictory — sever any wires\n          // feeding this port so only one source of truth exists\n          if (new_val !== undefined && current_box) {\n            const port_name = ports[i].name;\n            const box_id    = current_box.id;\n            const to_break  = (current_box.connections || []).filter(\n              c => c.to_box === box_id && c.to_input === port_name\n            );\n            if (to_break.length > 0) {\n              // remove from local box first so save() persists the clean state\n              current_box.connections = current_box.connections.filter(\n                c => !(c.to_box === box_id && c.to_input === port_name)\n              );\n              // remove from each source box on the server\n              await Promise.all(to_break.map(async conn => {\n                try {\n                  const src = await API.get_box(conn.from_box);\n                  src.connections = (src.connections || []).filter(c =>\n                    !(c.from_box === conn.from_box &&\n                      (c.from_branch ?? null) === (conn.from_branch ?? null) &&\n                      c.to_box    === conn.to_box &&\n                      c.to_input  === conn.to_input)\n                  );\n                  await API.put_box(conn.from_box, src);\n                  Boxes.boxes[conn.from_box] = src;\n                } catch(e2) {\n                  console.error('failed to sever wire from ' + conn.from_box + ':', e2.message);\n                }\n              }));\n              Canvas.mark_dirty();\n              status_msg('severed ' + to_break.length + ' wire(s) into port \"' + port_name + '\"');\n            }\n          }\n\n          save();\n        });",

    "originalFile":"// Inspector sidebar: shows and edits the selected box's fields.\n// Fires PUT to the server on every field change (autosave).\n// For call boxes, ref/fn are set via the file browser; inputs are read-only, derived from parsing.\n\nconst Inspector = (() => {\n  const panel  = document.getElementById('inspector');\n  const title  = document.getElementById('inspector-title');\n  const fields = document.getElementById('inspector-fields');\n\n  let current_box  = null;\n  let on_change_cb = null;\n  let on_delete_cb = null;\n\n  // {{{ hide\n  function hide() {\n    panel.classList.add('hidden');\n    current_box  = null;\n    on_delete_cb = null;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ save\n  async function save() {\n    if (!current_box) return;\n    try {\n      await API.put_box(current_box.id, current_box);\n      if (on_change_cb) on_change_cb(current_box);\n    } catch(e) {\n      console.error('autosave failed:', e.message);\n      status_msg('save error: ' + e.message, 'error');\n    }\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_row\n  function mk_row(label_text, input_el) {\n    const row = document.createElement('div');\n    row.className = 'field-row';\n    const lbl = document.createElement('label');\n    lbl.textContent = label_text;\n    row.appendChild(lbl);\n    row.appendChild(input_el);\n    return row;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_text_input\n  function mk_text_input(value, on_input) {\n    const inp = document.createElement('input');\n    inp.type  = 'text';\n    inp.value = value || '';\n    inp.addEventListener('input', () => { on_input(inp.value); save(); });\n    return inp;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_readonly\n  function mk_readonly(value) {\n    const el = document.createElement('div');\n    el.className   = 'field-readonly';\n    el.textContent = value || '—';\n    return el;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ mk_port_display\n  // Renders input ports as read-only name labels with an optional literal value field.\n  // Names are derived from source parsing and are not editable here.\n  function mk_port_display(ports) {\n    const wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    wrap.className = 'port-display';\n    if (!ports || ports.length === 0) {\n      const empty = document.createElement('span');\n      empty.className   = 'port-display-empty';\n      empty.textContent = '(none)';\n      wrap.appendChild(empty);\n    } else {\n      ports.forEach((p, i) => {\n        const row = document.createElement('div');\n        row.className = 'port-display-row';\n\n        // name is read-only — derived from function signature via file browser\n        const name_el = document.createElement('span');\n        name_el.className   = 'port-name-inp';\n        name_el.textContent = p.name || '';\n        name_el.style.color = '#9ea3c0';\n        row.appendChild(name_el);\n\n        if (p.type && p.type !== 'any') {\n          const type_el = document.createElement('span');\n          type_el.className   = 'port-type';\n          type_el.textContent = ':' + p.type;\n          row.appendChild(type_el);\n        }\n\n        // literal value input — empty means \"no literal\" (wire will supply the value)\n        const val_inp = document.createElement('input');\n        val_inp.type        = 'text';\n        val_inp.value       = p.value !== undefined ? String(p.value) : '';\n        val_inp.placeholder = 'value…';\n        val_inp.className   = 'port-val-inp';\n        val_inp.addEventListener('input', () => {\n          ports[i].value = val_inp.value === '' ? undefined : val_inp.value;\n          save();\n        });\n        row.appendChild(val_inp);\n\n        wrap.appendChild(row);\n      });\n    }\n    return wrap;\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ open_browser\n  // Replaces inspector content with the file browser.\n  // On function select: sets ref/fn/inputs from parsed signature (no outputs — single wire).\n  function open_browser() {\n    title.textContent = 'browse src/';\n    fields.innerHTML  = '';\n    FileBrowser.render(fields, (filename, fn) => {\n      current_box.ref    = filename;\n      current_box.fn     = fn.name;\n      current_box.inputs = fn.inputs.map(n => ({ name: n, type: 'any' }));\n      // outputs are not set — all boxes have exactly one output wire\n      save().then(() => show(current_box, on_change_cb, on_delete_cb));\n    });\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ show_content\n  // Renders arbitrary content into the inspector panel without a box context.\n  // Used by the map picker and any other non-box inspector views.\n  function show_content(title_text, render_fn) {\n    current_box  = null;\n    on_change_cb = null;\n    on_delete_cb = null;\n    panel.classList.remove('hidden');\n    title.innerHTML   = '';\n    title.textContent = title_text;\n    fields.innerHTML  = '';\n    render_fn(fields);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  // {{{ show\n  function show(box, on_changed, on_delete) {\n    current_box  = box;\n    on_change_cb = on_changed;\n    on_delete_cb = on_delete || null;\n    panel.classList.remove('hidden');\n\n    // title: editable label input + read-only id subtitle\n    title.innerHTML = '';\n    const lbl_inp = document.createElement('input');\n    lbl_inp.type      = 'text';\n    lbl_inp.value     = box.label || '';\n    lbl_inp.className = 'inspector-title-inp';\n    lbl_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { current_box.label = lbl_inp.value; save(); });\n    title.appendChild(lbl_inp);\n    const id_sub = document.createElement('div');\n    id_sub.className   = 'inspector-id-sub';\n    id_sub.textContent = box.id;\n    title.appendChild(id_sub);\n\n    fields.innerHTML = '';\n\n    // delete button — always visible at the top of the inspector\n    if (on_delete_cb) {\n      const del_btn = document.createElement('button');\n      del_btn.textContent = 'delete box';\n      del_btn.className   = 'delete-box-btn';\n      del_btn.onclick     = () => on_delete_cb();\n      fields.appendChild(del_btn);\n    }\n\n    // label is now the editable title — no separate field needed\n\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('kind', (() => {\n      const sel = document.createElement('select');\n      ['call', 'data'].forEach(k => {\n        const opt = document.createElement('option');\n        opt.value = k; opt.textContent = k;\n        if (k === box.kind) opt.selected = true;\n        sel.appendChild(opt);\n      });\n      sel.addEventListener('change', () => {\n        current_box.kind = sel.value;\n        show(current_box, on_change_cb, on_delete_cb);\n        save();\n      });\n      return sel;\n    })()));\n\n    // ref: editable text input + browse button to populate via file browser\n    const ref_wrap = document.createElement('div');\n    ref_wrap.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;';\n    const ref_inp = document.createElement('input');\n    ref_inp.type  = 'text';\n    ref_inp.value = box.ref || '';\n    ref_inp.style.flex = '1';\n    ref_inp.style.minWidth = '0';\n    ref_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { current_box.ref = ref_inp.value; save(); });\n    const browse_btn = document.createElement('button');\n    browse_btn.className   = 'toolbar-btn';\n    browse_btn.textContent = 'browse';\n    browse_btn.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';\n    browse_btn.onclick = open_browser;\n    ref_wrap.appendChild(ref_inp);\n    ref_wrap.appendChild(browse_btn);\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('ref', ref_wrap));\n\n    fields.appendChild(mk_row('fn', mk_readonly(box.fn)));\n\n    // inputs: read-only names from parsing, editable literal values\n    const in_sec = document.createElement('div');\n    in_sec.className   = 'section-label';\n    in_sec.textContent = 'inputs';\n    fields.appendChild(in_sec);\n    fields.appendChild(mk_port_display(box.inputs));\n\n    // output: single wire; optional comparator splits into lt/eq/gt\n    const out_sec = document.createElement('div');\n    out_sec.className   = 'section-label';\n    out_sec.textContent = 'output';\n    fields.appendChild(out_sec);\n\n    const cmp_row = document.createElement('div');\n    cmp_row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;';\n\n    const has_cmp = box.comparand !== undefined && box.comparand !== '';\n    const cmp_btn = document.createElement('button');\n    cmp_btn.className   = 'toolbar-btn';\n    cmp_btn.textContent = has_cmp ? 'comparing ×' : 'compare';\n    cmp_btn.onclick = () => {\n      if (current_box.comparand !== undefined && current_box.comparand !== '') {\n        delete current_box.comparand;\n      } else {\n        current_box.comparand = '0';\n      }\n      save().then(() => show(current_box, on_change_cb, on_delete_cb));\n    };\n    cmp_row.appendChild(cmp_btn);\n\n    if (has_cmp) {\n      const cmp_inp = document.createElement('input');\n      cmp_inp.type        = 'text';\n      cmp_inp.value       = box.comparand || '';\n      cmp_inp.placeholder = 'number';\n      cmp_inp.style.cssText = 'flex:1;background:#0f1117;border:1px solid #2a2f45;' +\n        'border-radius:3px;color:#e8eaf6;font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;padding:4px 6px;';\n      cmp_inp.addEventListener('input', () => { current_box.comparand = cmp_inp.value; save(); });\n      cmp_row.appendChild(cmp_inp);\n    }\n\n    fields.appendChild(cmp_row);\n  }\n  // }}}\n\n  return { show, hide, show_content };\n})();\n",

        "type":"text",
        "text":"When a literal value is typed into an input port field, the handler now:\n\n1. Finds all connections where `to_box` is the current box and `to_input` matches the port\n2. Removes them from `current_box.connections` locally before calling `save()` — so the PUT reflects the clean state\n3. Fetches and updates each source box to remove its side of the connection record\n4. Redraws the canvas so the severed wires disappear immediately\n5. Shows a status message counting how many wires were cut\n\nClearing the field back to empty restores the port to \"wire-fed\" mode — the wires won't reappear automatically, but new ones can be drawn."
